jobs.excerpt: e. l. f.  Beauty, Inc.  stands with every eye, lip, face, paw and fin.
jobs.description:
e.l.f. Beauty, Inc. stands with every eye, lip, face, paw and fin. Our deep commitment to clean, cruelty-free beauty at an incredible value has fueled the success of our flagship brand e.l.f. Cosmetics since 2004 and driven our portfolio expansion. Today, our multi-brand portfolio includes e.l.f. Cosmetics, e.l.f. SKIN, Well People - clean beauty powered by plants, Naturium - high-performance, biocompatible, clinically-effective and accessible skin care, and our newest brand, rhode skin - developed by Hailey Rhode Bieber, a line of curated skincare essentials, formulated for a variety of skin types and needs with high performance ingredients, it’s a daily routine that nourishes your skin barrier over time

In our Fiscal year 26, we had net sales of $1.6 Billion and our business performance has been nothing short of extraordinary with 30 consecutive quarters of net sales growth. We are the #2 mass cosmetics brand in the US and are the fastest growing mass cosmetics brand among the top 5. Our total compensation philosophy offers every full-time new hire competitive pay and benefits, bonus eligibility (200% of target over the last seven fiscal years), equity, flexible time off, year-round half-day Fridays, and a work-from-home environment. We believe the combination of our unique culture, total compensation, workplace flexibility and care for the team is unmatched across not just beauty but any industry.

Visit our Career Page to learn more about our team:

Position Summary

As Director, Technical Regulatory & Ingredient Science, you will be the organization's foremost authority on raw material qualification, ingredient-level compliance and technical documentation across e.l.f. brands and global markets. This is a new, high-impact role created to address a clear and growing need as we expand our business globally, supporting the increase in volume and complexity of ingredient questions, documentation requirements and cross-functional technical challenges.

The Director must possess deep technical expertise in ingredient and raw material chemistry; including polymer/surfactant chemistry, mineral/pigment chemistry and botanical/natural extract chemistry. You will drive independent ingredient assessment at a molecular level, determining classification and regulatory status, as well as exercising scientific judgment in qualifying materials and interpreting supplier documentation/data.

Responsibilities

Global Regulatory Compliance

  • Determine and maintain ingredient-level compliance globally, including new and novel ingredient technology.
  • Translate evolving global regulations into actionable guidance for R&D, Innovation and Product Development.
  • Lead ingredient-level Canada CEPA/Section 71 Surveys, CARB surveys, US/UK REACH compliance and monitor for new regulations, particularly during global expansion.
  • Monitor VOC compliance, ensuring formulations meet applicable VOC limits and that ingredient-level VOC data is available and documented for regulatory submissions and inquiries.
  • Oversee IFRA compliance for fragranced products, ensuring fragrance ingredients and concentrations conform to current IFRA Standards and that suppliers provide IFRA certificates and supporting documentation.
  • Guide EWG and Sorette certification, evaluating ingredient profiles, flagging restricted ingredients and ensuring the team maintains supporting documentation.
  • Serve as the technical point of contact to troubleshoot and resolve documentation gaps, regulatory queries and compliance challenges that arise during registration dossier preparation and submission.

Supplier & Manufacturer Documentation

  • Partner directly with contract manufacturers and raw material suppliers to secure, review and approve raw material and ingredient documentation.
  • Establish and enforce documentation standards and timelines with manufacturers and suppliers to mitigate risk.
  • Ensure the team uses internal IT tools to organize and track raw material documents across the portfolio. Leverage IT tools to run metrics.
  • Drive workflows and opportunities to manage changes to raw material/ingredients to maintain compliance against global standards.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Work cross-functionally with Regulatory, R&D, Innovation, Product Development and Legal to provide raw material and ingredient expertise that keeps pace with global demand.
  • Embed ingredient expertise into every stage of the product lifecycle.
  • Identify ingredient-related challenges early and provide technical solutions that keep projects on track and in compliance.
  • Educate and advise internal stakeholders on ingredient science topics, emerging regulations and compliance considerations.

Ingredient Science & Technical Assessment

  • Assess the chemical properties and structure-function relationships of ingredients across categories to advise on efficacy, performance and required ingredient testing for specifications, certifications of analysis etc.
  • Support the substantiation of formula safety profiles; with particular focus on ingredient-related claims and marketing claims with technical documentation and scientific rationale.
  • Ensure ingredient-level data is available and organized to respond to retailer, regulator and consumer inquiries.

Requirements:

  • MSc in Chemistry or a closely related scientific discipline.
  • 10+ years in a technical regulatory, ingredient science, or raw material compliance role within the Cosmetics or Personal Care industry.
  • Deep expertise in cosmetic and skincare ingredient chemistry; global cosmetic ingredient regulations.
  • Direct experience working with third-party suppliers and contract manufacturers, particularly in the EU and Asia.
  • Proven track record of raw material qualification, supplier documentation management and ingredient-level compliance at scale.
  • Strong understanding of how to support innovative ingredient and formula advancements.
  • Ability to translate complex technical and regulatory information into clear guidance for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with proven ability to influence and align cross-functional partners.
  • Experience supporting a multi-brand portfolio across color cosmetics, haircare, skincare, medical devices, tools and merchandise.
  • Experience scaling a raw material documentation database.
  • Knowledge of claim substantiation frameworks and experience supporting marketing and regulatory claims.
The base salary range for this role is listed above.
Total compensation includes base salary, annual company-based performance bonus, and equity. Under e.l.f.’s annual bonus program, employees are eligible to earn up to 200% of their target bonus when company performance exceeds defined goals. In addition, e.l.f. provides a variety of other benefits to employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a retirement savings plan, gender neutral parental leave, and unlimited paid time off. The amount of total compensation (including base salary) offered will be based on a wide range of factors, including geographic location, experience, specific skills, and qualifications.
Compensation components are subject to change at the company’s discretion

jobs.excerpt: Role OverviewPIC, a Genus PLC company, has an exciting opportunity.
jobs.description:
Role Overview

PIC, a Genus PLC company, has an exciting opportunity. We are looking for a Global Pig Resistant Product (PRP) Program Manager (remote).

This role leads the integration, coordination, and governance efforts of PIC's global PRP program. As PRP expands across multiple markets with unique regulatory, commercial, stewardship, and stakeholder requirements, this role ensures the program operates as one coordinated system rather than a collection of independent workstreams.

The Global PRP Program Manager maintains a holistic view of the PRP program, continuously connecting people, priorities, decisions, and workstreams to ensure the program remains aligned, adaptable, and positioned for successful commercialization. The role enables department and workstream leads to focus on their core responsibilities by removing barriers, simplifying cross-functional coordination, and creating the operational discipline needed to successfully scale PRP globally.

The successful candidate can work in a culturally diverse, fast-paced environment and establish priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain accuracy. The candidate can work autonomously as well as collaboratively across functional teams, demonstrating strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills. Success is measured through cross-functional alignment, effective governance, timely execution, proactive risk management, commercialization readiness, organizational accountability, and the successful expansion of PRP across global markets.

This position is based remotely in the United States, with travel approximately of 10% domestically.

The salary range for this position is $126,500 - $153,000 USD annually. The salary provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. Genus considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate's work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.

You Will

  • Serve as the primary coordinator and integrator across all PRP workstreams, ensuring alignment and execution as a unified global program.
  • Build and maintain strong cross-functional partnerships & relationships across commercialization, regulatory, legal, stewardship, supply chain, product development, quality, marketing, franchise, and leadership teams.
  • Lead the governance framework and operating rhythm for the PRP program, including meetings, reviews, decision-making processes, and reporting structures.
  • Identify, assess, and proactively manage program risks, dependencies, resource needs, opportunities, and organizational barriers to execution.
  • Drive organizational accountability by tracking decisions, commitments, action items, approvals, and contractual obligations through completion.
  • Develop and maintain standardized governance tools, dashboards, templates, reporting, and operational processes to improve visibility and consistency across the program.
  • Own and continuously improve the cross-functional PRP Market Readiness Framework, ensuring commercialization readiness across global markets.
  • Coordinate commercialization planning activities, scenario evaluations, and cross-functional readiness efforts to support strategic decision-making and market expansion.
  • Monitor evolving regulatory, commercial, operational, and market conditions and ensure program plans adapt while maintaining organizational alignment.
  • Maintain a comprehensive view of program progress, strategic decisions, lessons learned, and key documentation, enabling effective communication and organizational learning.
  • Facilitate communication and coordination among global markets, franchises, consultants, customers, and internal stakeholders to ensure insights are incorporated into program strategies and priorities.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives to enhance governance, commercialization effectiveness, scalability, cross-functional collaboration, and overall program performance.

Requirements

Basic Qualifications (required):

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Life Sciences, Project Management, Supply Chain or a related field.
  • Progressive years of experience in program management, commercialization, product development, operations, strategic planning, or related business functions.
  • Demonstrated success leading large, complex, cross-functional programs involving multiple functions, stakeholders, and business priorities.
  • Experience managing strategic business initiatives from planning through execution.
  • Proven ability to influence, align, and build effective working relationships across diverse teams without direct reporting authority.
  • Experience developing and managing governance frameworks, executive reporting, operating cadences, and decision-making processes.
  • Strong organizational, communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate complexity into actionable plans.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify risks, dependencies, resource constraints, and business impacts while proactively driving solutions.
  • Experience working within global organizations and coordinating activities across multiple regions, cultures, and functional teams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to support strategic decision-making in a dynamic environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's degree (MBA, MSc, or related advanced degree).
  • PMP, PgMP, Lean Six Sigma, or other project/program management certification.
  • Experience within animal health, agriculture, biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, medical devices, healthcare, or other regulated industries.
  • Experience supporting global product launches, commercialization programs, or market expansion initiatives.

Business Overview

Genus is an agricultural biotechnology pioneer. We are a global FTSE 250 company, headquartered in the UK, and listed on the London Stock Exchange. Genus PLC has a presence in over 70 countries and a global workforce of over 3,000 employees and growing. We are a worldwide leader in porcine and bovine animal genetics, partnering with farmers to transform how we nourish the world – a mission that is important to a sustainable future.

PIC currently supplies over 70% of the world’s top pork producers. We directly employ people in 18 countries worldwide and our products are available in more than 50 countries across the globe. We are a diverse team, ranging from scientists to sales teams, production personnel to customer service, and are all united by a passion for producing nutritious, affordable pork and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Our vision is clear: Pioneering animal genetic improvement to help nourish the world.

Benefits Overview

At Genus, we offer a competitive salary. Benefits include health, dental, vision, FSA/HSA, long and short-term disability, 401K, tuition reimbursement, paid holidays and ETO (earned time off). This position will have opportunities for growth.

Equal Employment Opportunities

Genus is an equal opportunity employer. In accordance with anti-discrimination law, it is the purpose of this policy to effectuate these principles and mandates. Genus prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Genus conforms to the spirit as well as to the letter of all applicable laws and regulations.

Recruitment Fraud Warning

jobs.title: Adventure Operations Specialist (Bulgaria)
jobs.excerpt: Co-founded by Peter Duncan, ex-UK Chief Scout and BBC Blue Peter man, and Alex Pazderski, an avid hiker and acclaimed expedition kayaker, we are among the best experts in organizing walking & cycling holidays and adventure trips for independently-minded people.
jobs.description:
Co-founded by Peter Duncan, ex-UK Chief Scout and BBC Blue Peter man, and Alex Pazderski, an avid hiker and acclaimed expedition kayaker, we are among the best experts in organizing walking & cycling holidays and adventure trips for independently-minded people. Starting in 2009 by developing several pioneering trekking itineraries in the Balkans, we now offer 800+ self guided walking holidays and cycling tours as well as a range of meticulously curated small group and privately guided tours, family and discovery trips.

The position's primary purpose is to provide exemplary post-booking service to our customers, most of which are located in the UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand and Ireland.

The Role

Your role will be to ensure that the customer has an unforgettable experience with us after booking confirmation to trip completion.

You will work closely with our Adventure Sales Specialists, who will handle new enquiries and bookings from initial enquiry to booking confirmation. After a booking is made, they will be arranging all the elements of the booking with our local suppliers (including hotels and local transfer companies) until booking confirmation.

Once the booking is confirmed, it is the Adventure Operations Specialists who take over from the Adventure Sales Specialists:

  • You will be dealing with all customer support requests and questions related to their trip during the entire period between the booking confirmation and departure
  • You will handle all booking change requests by customers and make the necessary rearrangements with our local suppliers (including making sure the changes are properly invoiced both by the local suppliers to us and by us to the customers)
  • You will be resolving trip issues effectively with minimum disruption to the customer
  • You will be quickly finding solutions to situations such as mistakes in the local supplier arrangements, accommodation closures and disruptions to travel schedules
  • You will be monitoring balance payments and making sure they are paid on time, and the amounts are correct
  • You will be preparing and sending pre-departure materials and travel documentation (including uploading them to our smartphone app) and making sure everything is properly organised and documented for the customer's trip
  • You will be taking shifts on the emergency phone line for customers who are currently on a trip
  • You will be the first responders to post-trip customer feedback and communicate it to the Sales and Products teams so that we constantly improve our products and service
  • From time to time, you will be supporting our sales team by preparing and sending custom itineraries and travel documentation to customers
  • You will be building relationships with existing local suppliers to ensure we are their partner of choice

Requirements

  • Experience in Operations in an adventure travel company, ideally specialised in self guided walking and cycling holidays, is highly desirable
  • Experience in fast paced reservations or operations roles where you have demonstrated your ability to understand customer needs and find solutions is mandatory
  • Understanding and sharing of our values related to Responsible Travel is mandatory
  • Experience with computer booking systems (ideally TourCMS), help desk and chat software (ideally Zendesk) is highly desirable
  • Experience with email-based customer service
  • Outstanding organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, English must be native or of equivalent level
  • Excellent email and phone manner and technique
  • Ability to work under pressure while maintaining accuracy
  • Ability to work efficiently without supervision
  • Friendly attitude, personal integrity and high standards of customer service

Benefits

  • Work from home
  • Flexible working time
  • Fixed base salary
  • 25 days of paid annual leave + bank holidays, increasing by one day every year until year 5
  • Great discounts for you and your friends/family members on all TNA trips
  • Outstanding learning and development opportunities
  • Great multinational team and a rapidly growing company

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

Staff Software Engineer, Backend (Platform - Identity IDV)

We're hiring a Staff Software Engineer to own the multi-year technical vision and architecture for Coinbase's identity verification platform within Platform. This platform powers the decision engine, vendor orchestration, and infrastructure that determines whether an identity is genuine at global scale - processing approximately 700K verifications per month across Retail, Prime, and Institutional business lines. You'll define the identity trust layer that every Coinbase product will be built on, leading a three-year arc from platform consolidation through vendor-agnostic orchestration to self-serve scalability for the next billion users.

What you'll do:

  • Own end-to-end architecture and technical direction for Coinbase's IDV platform - the decision engine, vendor orchestration layer, and verification infrastructure that all business lines depend on.
  • Lead platform consolidation by migrating all IDV onto a single decision-engine-driven platform, retiring 100+ legacy rules and fragmented paths, and eliminating single-vendor points of failure.
  • Design and build vendor-agnostic orchestration with automated, real-time routing and failover that selects the optimal vendor per request and dynamically balances fraud prevention (FAR) against user access (FRR/SCR).
  • Scale the platform to support every new product, region, and verification modality (document, biometric, liveness) with self-serve configuration so any Coinbase team integrates IDV without a dependency request.
  • Drive cross-team technical strategy and set the abstractions, APIs, and platform patterns that the broader Identity org builds on, influencing at the Staff level across multiple pods.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 8+ years of backend software engineering with a track record of deploying and operating large-scale production systems in regulated or fintech environments.
  • Proven technical leadership owning end-to-end design and delivery of complex, cross-team backend systems, including system design, architecture, API/data-model design, and production rollout.
  • Deep distributed-systems expertise spanning scalability, reliability, API design, and high availability for Tier-0 services.
  • Expert-level coding in Go (or equivalent systems language) with hands-on experience in gRPC/microservices, AWS, and Kubernetes.
  • Experience in identity, KYC, fraud infrastructure, vendor orchestration, or payments domains with the ability to turn ambiguous compliance and platform problems into actionable technical roadmaps.
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

jobs.description:
Investment Analyst
Remote (hiring worldwide) · Contractor · Full-time · Monthly salary: $4.000 - $5.000 USD

About the role
You'll support Kinship Ventures on two fronts. On capital formation, you'll prepare materials, track LP conversations and write the communications that move a raise forward. On investment work, you'll do the research, market mapping, diligence support and analysis behind our conviction. Much of the job is writing, and our investors expect a client-service standard of communication.

About us
Kinship Ventures is the venture platform co-founded by Moj Mahdara and Gwyneth Paltrow. We back the world's TAM creators: founders inventing new markets and building enduring companies. Our strategy has two parts. We back high-growth companies approaching scale, and we take early, conviction-driven positions in the next generation of category-defining founders. Moj is also the founder of Trolley, an operating platform for founder-led execution, and the former CEO of Beautycon Media.

What you'll do

  • Fundraising and LP support: draft LP updates, recaps and outreach, keep the LP pipeline current after every meeting, and help build fund decks, one-pagers, data room materials and newsletters
  • Research and diligence: build market maps, thematic research and investment theses, run primary research calls with operators, customers and experts, and support market sizing, benchmarking, financial analysis and investment memos
  • Deal support: coordinate diligence, data requests and document tracking, and keep deal materials, term sheets and cap tables current
  • Written communication: turn meetings into accurate recaps, and draft materials for LPs, founders and co-investors that need little editing

What you bring

  • 2 to 3 years in venture capital, investment banking, consulting, startup ops or strategy, or a founder's office
  • Direct exposure to fundraising, investor relations or LP communications
  • Exceptional written English and credibility on calls with senior investors. Writing is a primary filter for this role.
  • A solid base in financial modeling, market sizing, competitive analysis and accounting fundamentals, plus working familiarity with term sheets, cap tables and diligence
  • AI-native: fluent in Claude, ChatGPT, Notion and no-code automations, plus Excel, PowerPoint and Google Workspace
  • Sharp investment judgment: you form a point of view instead of just assembling data, you track everything and you finish what you start

How we work

  • Fast-moving and collaborative, working closely with a US-based team
  • A high-trust, high-intensity partnership, closer to a co-founder rhythm than a 9-to-5. Expect check-ins on weekends and outside normal hours when things are moving.
  • We need someone discreet with sensitive information, direct and honest, and steady under pressure

jobs.title: Compliance Analyst
jobs.excerpt: The Legal team at Integra Partners works cross-functionally to help achieve our mission of reducing friction in healthcare.
jobs.description:
The Legal team at Integra Partners works cross-functionally to help achieve our mission of reducing friction in healthcare. We are committed to working collaboratively, transparently, and efficiently to provide exceptional legal and compliance services to our internal stakeholders, health plans, and providers. We are committed to excellence in our work, a growth mindset and continuous improvement, and cultivating a deep understanding of the healthcare industry.

We are hiring a Compliance Analyst to be an integral member of the Legal team and ensure we meet and exceed all our compliance obligations. In this role, you will bring your previous compliance experience and knowledge to monitor for FWA issues and investigate and audit provider billing and UM auth request practices. Some of your key responsibilities will be researching providers, reviewing CMS alerts, as well as keeping up-to-date and managing compliance risks that impact our business and the DMEPOS industry. You will work closely with our Compliance Manager, Payer Division and partner with individuals at all levels of the company. If you are a self-starter, service-oriented, and able to interpret and communicate complex information, then this is an excellent opportunity as a next step in your career

JOB QUALIFICATIONS: KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES

The Compliance Analyst’s responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • The primary focus of this role will be to conduct audits of vendors and healthcare providers in support of our FWA monitoring processes
  • Run the Fraud, Waste, and Abuse investigation processes
  • Support the administration of the company’s Corporate Compliance program
  • Assign and monitor compliance training and keep detailed, auditable records
  • Collaborate with our credentialing, quality assurance, and network management teams to address any concerns and implement change as needed
  • Partner with health plan customers on audits of our business, draft and track audit processes and responses
  • Investigate compliance concerns and issues internally and externally
  • Ensure we are up to date with licensing and other filings with state agencies
  • Conduct Security Risk Assessments and present results to the compliance committee.
  • Work closely with our data security staff to address security issues that arise
  • Reports to our Compliance Manager, Payer Division

Your first 30 days

  • Within the first month, you will learn about Integra’s business, our policies and procedures, learn how Medicare and Medicaid guidelines impact our business, how we run our compliance programs, and be introduced to the teams with which you will partner cross-functionally.

Your first 60 days

  • Within your first 90 days working with the company, you will initiate audits of providers in our network, research current FWA events and respond to plan questions.
  • Your first 6 months
  • We expect that within six months you will have a strong grasp of the rules and regulations which govern our business. You will take ownership of audits and partner with teams on assigned compliance or security concerns. We expect that you’ll also be able to recommend ways in which we can improve our processes, procedures, and making sure we’re up to date with regulatory changes impacting the business.

EDUCATION: Bachelor’s degree

EXPERIENCE:

  • At least three years’ experience in Special Investigation Unit processes or similar roles; previous healthcare experience is required, DMEPOS experience preferred.
  • Strong understanding of fraud waste and abuse issues, healthcare credentialing, medical billing, HIPAA, and related legislation
  • Experience with data analysis and excellent user of Excel. Experience with Tableau a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and able to interpret and communicate complex information
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Working knowledge of medical billing processes
  • Excellent organizational skills, ability to manage multiple projects at once, follow through, and meet tight deadlines.
  • A commitment to provide high quality client service and a strong desire to build trusted advisor relationships with key clients and executives.
  • Ability to manage and handle sensitive and confidential information with the highest levels of integrity, ethical standards, discretion, and sound judgment.
  • Team player able to collaborate across various teams and levels and form strong working relationships
SALARY: 85,000.00/Annually

Benefits Offered

  • Competitive compensation and annual bonus program
  • 401(k) retirement program with company match
  • Company-paid life insurance
  • Company-paid short term disability coverage (location restrictions may apply)
  • Medical, Vision, and Dental benefits
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Sick Time
  • Paid company holidays and floating holidays
  • Quarterly company-sponsored events
  • Health and wellness programs
  • Career development opportunities

Remote Opportunities

We are actively seeking new colleagues in: Arizona, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Kentucky, Massachusetts, Michigan, North Carolina, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, and Washington.

Our Story

Founded in 2005, Integra Partners is a leading national durable medical equipment, prosthetic, and orthotic supplies (DMEPOS) network administrator. Our mission is to improve the quality of life for the communities we serve by reimagining access to in-home healthcare. We connect Payers, Providers, and Members through innovative technology and streamlined workflows affording Members access to top local Providers and culturally competent care. By focusing on transparency, accountability, and adaptability, we help deliver better health outcomes and more efficient management of complex healthcare benefits.

With a location in Michigan plus a remote workforce across the United States, Integra has a culture focused on collaboration, teamwork, and our values: One Team, Drive Results, Push the Boundaries, Value Others, and Build Community. We’re looking for energetic, talented, and dedicated individuals to join our team. jobs.description:
About this role:
Our Chief HR Officer clients find themselves challenged with the pace of change within the HR function and their respective organizations as companies continue to focus on developing digital dexterity, shifting business models and evolving customer and workforce expectations. With the support of their Executive Partner, our Gartner for CHRO clients adeptly assess the changes needed within their organization, achieve their goals more quickly and with a higher assurance of success. As an Executive Partner, you will have the opportunity to learn about and deliver solutions for the most complex talent and workforce challenges facing companies across all industries.

Partnering with the member includes developing, coaching and/or critiquing overarching HR and talent strategies; helping to develop and/or transform their HR teams/organizations, assisting/advising with the development and execution of critical initiatives such as workforce planning and development, employee experience, enterprise change management, and diversity and inclusion. Gartner for CHRO Executive Partners serve as accountability partners through delivery of research insights and personal experiences/expertise on key initiatives, priorities, and strategies.

What You’ll Do:

  • Provide executive advisory services to approximately 20 CHRO members who work across all industries and business models.
  • Work as a collaborative Gartner team member serving Gartner for CHRO members in conjunction with Team Client Managers and Account Executives
  • Participate in all phases of the member lifecycle: pre-sale, on-boarding, relationship management, delivery, review and renewal.
  • Responsible for member retention and for contributing toward growth in the region through direct support of Gartner Sales in prospect cultivation, account plan development and value demonstration activities.
  • Host and /or participate in periodic member activities, including strategy workshops, roundtables and webinars.
  • Define and deliver innovative solutions by assessing member needs and developing a customized value plan in accordance with overall Executive Program strategy and product deliverables.
  • Facilitate member interaction and peer collaboration through the Gartner for CHRO member community portal and assisted member connections.

What You’ll Need:

  • An undergraduate degree or Masters is preferred with 5+ years of experience working as a CHRO; 15+ years of experience in HR.
  • An in-depth understanding of the HR function and the role of the CHRO (including leadership, operations management, strategy and trends, use of metrics, etc.)
  • In depth understanding of the business value of HR and the alignment of business and HR strategies.
  • The Executive Partner will be an accomplished CHRO, working with the C-suite, the Board of Directors and a host of stakeholders with a broad base of expertise who has operated at a senior leadership level and driven change at all levels.
  • Gartner/(CEB) client experience preferred
  • Consulting background a plus
  • Experience consulting into the federal government on human capital issues is a plus

Who You Are:

  • Critical thinker and problem solver demonstrating the ability to assess our Member’s situations and provide actionable, outcome-based business/technical advice as well as the ability to leverage appropriate resources to help Members achieve results.
  • Excellent communication and relationship management skills, including experience working with C-level executives.
  • Ability to build strategic internal partnerships with key roles across the organization and positively impact change
  • This role is a Client-facing position that requires a high level of Executive presence and ability to quickly build trust and deliver value.
  • Demonstrate superior verbal and written communication skills as well as strong facilitation and presentation skills.

THIS IS A REMOTE POSITION THAT CAN BE LOCATED ANYWHERE IN THE UNITED STATES.

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

jobs.title: Strategic Implementation Consultant
jobs.excerpt: Who we areSamsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara’s Strategic Customer Success team advises and guides our largest customers, ensuring they adopt Samsara and continuously gain business value from our products. We are the trusted point of contact for Samsara’s strategic customers throughout their lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, advocacy, and renewal.

In this role, you will be part of our Implementation team, responsible for helping Enterprise customers deploy and adopt our IoT solutions for their fleet and industrial assets. Picking up where our sales teams leave off, you will own the customer relationship and ensure a successful deployment of Samsara's solution. Your customers span the entire range of businesses that power our economy, including trucking and transportation, food and beverage, passenger transit, utilities, school buses, and many others. All the while building relationships with the customer, helping them learn our system, and overall ensuring a successful customer relationship.

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a fast growing company from within.

This role requires exceptional customer-facing communication skills, the ability to quickly understand a customer's business, and comfort explaining technology products to both executives and day-to-day users. In addition to this, you will champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

May require travel to customer sites up to 10% of the time, including overnight stays.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Be on the front-lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform.
  • Manage the deployment of Samsara technology to large-scale customers, enabling customers to achieve quick time to value in their investment.
  • Create launch plans and a roadmap to increase product usage.
  • Track implementation progress, participation, product adoption, and account health.
  • Run training sessions, demonstrate Samsara’s technology, and work through challenges with executives and day-to-day users of the system across numerous use cases.
  • Juggle multiple customer engagements in parallel and work cross-functionally to deliver an exceptional experience for our customers.
  • Serve as a mentor to the wider Customer Success and Support teams.
  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to customers of all types.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 6+ years of experience in a senior Customer Success, account management, or strategic consulting role. Enterprise SaaS experience preferred.
  • This is a demanding position with high internal visibility, that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence.
  • Experience supporting or working with technical products.
  • Solutions-oriented with strong problem solving skills.
  • Excellent consultative skills with experience in end to end system implementations.
  • Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders: executives, Product and Engineering leadership, day-to-day users of our software.
  • Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment.
  • Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues.
  • Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards.
  • Experience serving and supporting large-scale business solutions at Fortune 500 companies.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$100,406—$153,409 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Executive Technology Services (ETS), is a membership-based organization serving over 7,000 CIOs / CxOs and senior IT leaders across 87 countries. These members (including Fortune 100 organizations benefit from the convenience of a single source of knowledge and insight focused on CIO-level challenges, service delivery in their context, the shared knowledge of the world's largest community of CIOs and Technology Leaders, and the assurance of Gartner objectivity and independence.   • Get a deep understanding of the members’ priorities and challenges. Help members find solutions and execute on their strategy by leveraging your own experience, Gartner’s capabilities, and the trends across our client base.

  • Define and deliver innovative solutions by assessing the member’s top Priorities and developing a customized service plan.

  • Build a strong partnership with Gartner’s Sales organization and collaborate with them to ensure strong member engagement and renewal of ExP business.

  • Present or facilitate at local ExP events

  • Our most successful Executive Partners have the ability to adopt best practices, follow established processes, and embrace feedback with a mindset of continuous improvement. Gartner Executive Partners have natural curiosity and share their knowledge and expertise with Executive Programs members.   • Experience with key business concepts such as revenue enablement & generation, market improvement, risk reduction, and launching a P&L and adding to the top line / substantial P&L responsibility.

  • Project to Product experience where new revenue streams were created.

  • Experience with Agile / DevOps / Emerging Technologies

  • Advanced critical thinking and structured problem-solving skills

  • High tolerance and an advanced ability to lead and manage ambiguous situations

  • Excellent relationship building and collaboration skills

  • Superior verbal, written, facilitation and presentation skills (Executive Presence)

  • Demonstrable sales and/or business development experience with CXO level executives

  • Expert skills at managing multiple priorities

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

The Global CT Portfolio Manager is responsible for building and maintaining a single CT portfolio strategy across the GE HealthCare CT business. CT product marketing is organized into four segments — PCCT, Ultra-Premium, Performance/Value, and Care Area (RT & Cardiac) — with additional coverage for Digital/Smart Subscription. Each segment Director is responsible for segment strategy, roadmap, launch content, and segment P&L.

This role brings those segment plans together into one portfolio strategy: unified portfolio positioning, a consolidated CT launch calendar, and an agreed order of priority across segments. Coordination is the core of the role. The Manager runs the planning cadence, launch sequencing, portfolio messaging architecture, campaign and event execution, budget coordination, and performance reporting required to turn four segment plans into one CT plan, working with the CT segment Directors to reach a shared portfolio view. Responsibilities are divided approximately evenly between portfolio strategy and marketing operations execution. Operational scope includes the CT launch calendar, campaign deployment, exhibits and events coordination, budget tracking, marketing technology, and performance reporting.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

Portfolio Ownership & Cross-Segment Integration

  • Shepherd the development of a cohesive, cross-segment CT portfolio narrative—bringing together the right leaders and teams to connect PCCT, Ultra-Premium, Performance/Value, Care Area, and Digital/Smart Subscription offerings to the needs of distinct customer segments.

  • Maintain the CT portfolio message architecture, ensuring segment positioning ladders up consistently and that new features and NPIs don’t result in gaps or overlaps between segments.

  • Serve as the single point of coordination across the segment Directors, converting peer-to-peer negotiation into a structured prioritization process.

  • Identify portfolio-level whitespace, cannibalization risk, and sequencing conflicts, and bring recommendations with clear trade-offs to the CMO for decision.

  • Ensure CT portfolio marketing activity adheres to healthcare industry regulations, corporate policies, privacy requirements, and brand standards, in alignment with the Downstream Marketing Manager.

Portfolio Planning & Launch Calendar

  • Own one CT portfolio launch calendar covering all segments, eliminating segment launch collisions and competing claims on shared channels, events, and field attention.
  • Run the annual and bi-annual CT marketing planning cadence in partnership with the CMO and segment Directors; consolidate segment inputs into a single portfolio plan aligned to corporate, AIS, regional, and commercial objectives.
  • Sequence launches, campaigns, and content drop against commercial, regional, and congress calendars.
  • Maintain portfolio-level launch readiness tracking and escalate slips early.

Campaign Operations & Performance Management

  • Own CT portfolio performance reporting; prepare portfolio reviews for the CMO and Marketing Leadership Team.
  • Ensure alignment between portfolio marketing objectives, lead generation activity, and commercial outcomes.
  • Partner with Downstream Marketing Manager on attribution, funnel performance analysis, and campaign ROI measurement for CT.

Financial & Resource Management

  • Coordinate the CT portfolio marketing budget process in partnership with Finance, the CMO, and segment Directors; consolidate segment budget inputs into one portfolio view.
  • Tracks spend, maintain forecast accuracy, and provide regular budget and variance reporting across CT marketing activity.
  • Manage ASTs, purchase orders, vendor onboarding, and agency and contract administration for portfolio-level programs.
  • Identify cost optimization and shared-investment opportunities across segments.

Events & Commercial Program Operations

  • Coordinate CT portfolio presence at trade shows, congresses, and customer events in partnership with the AIS exhibits & events team and the Downstream Marketing Manager.
  • Support planning, budgeting, vendor coordination, and logistics management; apply standard operating procedures for event planning and measurement.
  • Report on event effectiveness and business impact at the portfolio level.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of progressive product marketing, portfolio marketing, marketing operations, or commercial operations experience.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating across multiple product lines, segments, or business owners without direct authority.
  • Proven track record managing launch calendars, campaign execution, and marketing program operations end to end.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including preparing executive-level materials.
  • Ability to operate in a matrixed, global environment across multiple time zones.

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience within healthcare technology, medical devices, diagnostic imaging, healthcare IT, or another regulated industry.
  • Familiarity with CT or diagnostic imaging clinical workflows, customer segments, and buying centers.
  • Hands-on experience with marketing automation, CRM, and analytics platforms.
  • Experience supporting global marketing teams and regional commercial organizations.

The Center for Community Journalism, part of the USA TODAY Network, is seeking a dynamic and forward-thinking candidate to join its operation as a Sports Content Coach in the colleges space. The ideal candidate is an experienced journalist who is capable of editing copy, coaching writers to improve and managing sports journalists. The CCJ is a collection of more than 100 medium- and small-sized newspapers and associated websites in the USA TODAY Network, located geographically from Vermont to Washington state, from California to Florida. Its sports reporters cover local sports, including high school and college sports up to the major conference level. CCJ editors and content coaches manage and direct these journalists to help them best serve the audience available to their communities. The CCJ’s college beat portfolio includes major brands like Alabama, Duke, Florida, Georgia, Indiana, North Carolina, Notre Dame, Texas Tech, UConn and others. The ideal candidate will have AI and automation literacy and a willingness or experience in using it to enhance journalism. This position is remote and can be based anywhere in the US, except for Alaska and Hawaii or based at USA TODAY headquarters in McLean, Va. If you live near one of our local newsrooms, you may have the option to use that as a base of operations.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead a team of writers who cover sports local to their properties. Manage these writers and help them grow through coaching and feedback.
  • Teach them time management and how to identify winning story ideas.
  • Edit copy, often under tight deadlines, from writers across the country, including those who report to other editors and content coaches.
  • Be part of the CCJ’s high schools or colleges coverage leadership team, learning best practices to share with writers and contribute ideas to help improve coverage.
  • Use metrics and analytics to identify what is working in various local audiences and what is not, to best tailor our sports coverage to meet audience.
  • Coordinate and work with the other CCJ sports editors and content coaches, as well as others inside the company.
  • Be willing to work nights, weekends and sometimes holidays as needed.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's in communications, journalism, digital media or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • At least 3 years of experience working in a news organization.
  • Ability to identify stories that sports fans in local markets are talking about and able to leverage those to differentiate in competitive marketplace.
  • Strong news judgment, great communication skills and ability to multi-task in a fast-paced news environment.
  • Demonstrated commitment to producing and promoting journalism that is impactful and authoritative.
  • Experience using analytics to help shape coverage decisions and story execution.
  • Ability to manage, coach and motivate sports journalists to strive for improvement and growth.

Accenture is a leading solutions and services company that helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed across the enterprise, bringing together the talent of our approximately 786,000 people, our proprietary assets and platforms, and deep ecosystem relationships. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. Through our Reinvention Services we bring together our capabilities across strategy, consulting, technology, operations, Song and Industry X with our deep industry expertise to create and deliver solutions and services for our clients. Our purpose is to deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity, and we measure our success by the 360° value we create for all our stakeholders. Visit us at accenture.com.

  

As a Health Consultant, your primary responsibilities may include:  

Project Management and System Implementation

  • Lead the planning, design, and implementation of health systems, ensuring projects are completed on time, within scope, and within budget.

  • Develop detailed project plans, timelines, and resource allocations, coordinating closely with client and internal teams to meet project milestones.

  • Support process map development from current state to future state

  • Oversee workstream(s) to uphold business intent and delivery goals

​

Stakeholder Engagement and Client Management

  • Act as the primary point of contact for client stakeholders, managing expectations and providing regular updates on project progress, challenges, and successes.

  • Facilitate stakeholder meetings and workshops to gather requirements, address concerns, and ensure alignment with clinical and operational goals.

​

Performance Monitoring and Reporting

  • Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure system performance and user satisfaction, regularly tracking and reporting outcomes to clients and senior management.

  • Use analytics to identify trends and develop recommendations for continuous improvement for health systems

​

Executive Communications

  • Leverage storytelling best practices and frameworks to support executive messaging

  • Use data-driven insights to shape executive communications

  • Have strong written and verbal communication skills to navigate workstream ownership and project team communications

Team Leadership and Development

  • Lead and mentor a team of analysts, fostering a collaborative environment focused on high-quality system delivery and client satisfaction.

  • Provide guidance, training, and professional development opportunities to build technical expertise and project management skills within the team.

​

Industry Best Practices and Thought Leadership

  • Stay current on healthcare trends and regulatory changes, ensuring solutions meet the latest industry standards and best practices.

  • Contribute to thought leadership by supporting offering or business development; share perspective and actively engage with teams to progress point of views

Travel - as needed, up to 80%

Why should I join the Accenture Health team?     

  • Innovate every day. Be at the forefront of designing and delivering health technology solutions that push boundaries and create new opportunities for our clients.  

  • Lead with the industry’s best. Join an industry-recognized healthcare leader with more than 20,000 global healthcare professionals collaborating to drive enterprise-wide transformational projects on a global scale. Accenture has worked with more than 200 clients to deliver healthcare transformation to meet the diverse needs of patients and members.    

  • Learn and grow continuously. Harness unmatched training and professional development to help you build and advance your health, consultative and delivery skills. With learning resources, interactive classroom courses, real-life client simulations and ongoing mentoring available when you need it, you’ll expand your thinking beyond the core Workday implementation.  

Here’s what you need:  

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in an internal or external client facing consulting role with healthcare payer and/or provider clients

Bonus points if you have: 

  • Master's degree
  • Experience working with or leading global teams. 
  • Thrive in a diverse, fast paced environment. 
  • An advanced degree in the area of specialization.
  • Leadership experience, including team management and project oversight. 
  • Proficiency in data and interest in AI capabilities to support how your work gets done
  • Exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and presentation abilities.

jobs.description:
We Are:

Accenture’s SAP practice, and we live to see how this can transform the way we live and work. We are the industry-leader for building SAP solutions and we’re curious and always learning. We are assembling a talented team and providing our people with opportunities to gain new skills, training, and experience.

SAP technologies power these organizations with modern cloud-based and AI-enabled solutions, and Accenture is the undisputed market leader in this industry. We are continuously expanding our SAP team with advisory skills to continue to drive transformation at scale for our clients.

You Are:

You are an accomplished SAP transformationseniorleader who thrives in the complexity of large-scale business and technology transformations. You bring the vision, leadership, and execution disciplinerequiredto deliver enterprise SAP programs that drive measurable business outcomes while managing risk, cost, quality, and stakeholder expectations.

You are a trusted advisor to client executives and program leadership, capable of aligning business, functional, technical, data, testing, deployment, and change teams around a shared transformation vision. You excel at navigating ambiguity, managing large global delivery organizations, and ensuring programsremainfocused on value realization from strategy through deployment and stabilization.

You continuously seek opportunities to modernize delivery through AI, GenAI, automation, analytics, and data-driven decision making, helping organizations accelerate transformation while improving quality and delivery predictability.

Above all, youare passionate about helpingCG&S/Utilitiessuccessfully transform their businesses through SAP and emerging technologies.

The Work:

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of large SAP transformation programs, serving as the primary delivery leader accountable for execution, quality, financial performance, and business outcomes.

  • Partner with senior client executives to define transformation strategies, program roadmaps, governance models, and value realization objectives.

  • Establish and lead global delivery organizations across business, functional, technical, integration, data, testing, deployment, change management, and support workstreams.

  • Drive program planning, mobilization, estimation, staffing, governance, financial management, and execution across all phases of SAP S/4HANA implementations.

  • Manage program risks, issues, dependencies, scope, and stakeholder expectations while ensuring alignment to program objectives and delivery commitments.

  • Lead executive governance forums, steering committees, and stakeholder communications, providing transparent reporting and actionable recommendations.

  • Ensure adoption of SAP leading practices, Accenture delivery methodologies, quality standards, and governance frameworks to improve delivery outcomes.

  • Guide teams through major program milestones including design, build, testing, deployment planning, cutover, go-live, hypercare, and transition to support.

  • Drive delivery innovation by leveraging AI, GenAI, automation, and analytics to improve productivity, quality, risk management, and delivery efficiency.

  • Build trusted relationships with client executives and become a strategic advisor on SAP transformation, delivery excellence, and business value realization.

  • Support account growth through delivery excellence, executive relationship development, opportunity identification, and participation in sales and pursuit activities.

  • Support sales origination, proposal development, solution shaping, and business case creation for future SAP transformation opportunities.

  • Develop delivery assets, accelerators, and leading practices while mentoring the next generation of SAP program and delivery leaders.

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements

Here's what you need:

  • Minimum of 12 years of SAP delivery, program management, transformation leadership, or consulting experience.

  • Proven and established experience serving as Delivery Lead, Program Manager, Program Director, or Delivery Executive for large SAP transformation programs.

  • Minimum6years of experiencewith leadership roles inSAP transformation programs supportingCG&S/Utilitiescompanies

  • Minimumtwoend-to-end SAP S/4HANA implementations with accountability for planning, execution, deployment, and business outcomes.

  • Experience managing large global SAP delivery teams (100+ resources) across multiple geographies and delivery centers.

  • Strong understanding of SAP implementation methodologies, governance, testing, deployment, data migration, change management, and operational readiness.

  • Experience managing program financials, executive stakeholders, third-party vendors, and complex delivery risks.

  • ExperienceleveragingAI, GenAI, automation, or analytics capabilities to improve SAP delivery effectiveness and business outcomes.

  • Prior consulting or advisory experience supporting enterprise transformation initiatives.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years' work experience). If Associate’s Degree, must have equivalent minimum 6-year work experience

jobs.description:
In our Service Supply Chain offering, we leverage a combination of proprietary technology and client systems to develop, execute, and deliver BPaaS (business process as a service) or Managed Service solutions across the service lifecycle: Plan, Deliver, and Recover.

Join our dynamic Service Supply Chain (SSC) team and be at the forefront of helping world class organizations unlock their full potential.

We are currently seeking to hire a Product Management Specialist. This role owns the full product lifecycle — from setting strategy, vision, and roadmap to driving delivery across one or more digital domains.

The Product Management Specialist works cross-functionally with engineering, architecture, and business stakeholders to translate complex problems into clear product requirements and ship solutions in Agile environments. They measure and grow product impact through KPIs, analytics, and continuous discovery, while identifying opportunities for new digital offerings and market expansion.

Other responsibilities include:

  • Strategy & Vision Own product strategy, vision, roadmap, and delivery across digital domains; identify opportunities for new digital offerings, revenue growth, and market expansion.

  • Discovery & Stakeholder Engagement Lead product discovery sessions, stakeholder workshops, and requirements gathering to surface and align on customer needs and business priorities.

  • Requirements Definition Define and prioritize product requirements; translate business problems into detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, and product specifications.

  • Technical Collaboration Partner with architecture and engineering teams to assess technical feasibility and evaluate solution options.

  • Agile Delivery & Launch Drive product development from concept through deployment in Agile environments; support releases and adoption activities to ensure successful go-to-market execution.

  • Performance & Continuous Improvement Measure product success through business, customer, and operational KPIs; leverage user feedback, experimentation, and analytics to drive ongoing iteration and improvement.

Success in This Role:
This role is designed to drive the creation and launch of new digital products and services that deliver measurable business value. Within the first 2 years, the Product Manager will be expected to lead at least one net-new product or significant product capability from concept to market launch and support user onboarding and adoption efforts.
Success will be evaluated based on product delivery, launch execution, customer adoption, business impact, stakeholder satisfaction, and contribution to the broader product portfolio.

As business priorities evolve, career growth opportunities may include continued product ownership, expansion into larger product domains, or transition into other roles aligned to the individual's strengths and organizational needs as necessary.

You will be successful if you can:

  • Deliver products that solve meaningful customer problems.

  • Improve product adoption and measurable business outcomes.

  • Align business, technology, and operational stakeholders.

  • Create scalable, reusable digital capabilities.

  • Identify new growth opportunities and product innovations.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree.

  • Minimum of 6 years of experience in Product Management.

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience managing SaaS or enterprise software products.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Engineering degree in the fields of electrical or mechanical engineering.

  • Experience with Supply Chain, Service Lifecycle Management, Logistics, Aftermarket Services, Asset Management, Field Service, or Operations Technology.

  • Experience launching new digital products.

  • Experience working with Agile delivery teams.

  • Familiarity with AI, automation, analytics, or workflow orchestration solutions.

  • Exposure to enterprise integrations, APIs, and cloud platforms.

  • Ability to create and manage product roadmaps.

  • Consulting experience is a plus.

Professional Skills Requirements:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

jobs.excerpt: Do you thrive on managing complexity, taking ownership, and driving execution?
jobs.description:
Do you thrive on managing complexity, taking ownership, and driving execution?

Join our Application & Infrastructure Security Program Management team!

Partner with the best

As a Program Manager, you will collaborate cross-functionally to lead, structure, and successfully execute our most critical security programs. We are looking for a proactive problem solver—someone who doesn't just track schedules or take notes, but owns outcomes, dives deep to get clarity, and holds global teams accountable to execution.

As a Program Manager, you will be responsible for:

  • Proactive Problem Solving: Spotting potential risks early, identifying process bottlenecks, and taking early action to help keep projects on track.
  • Global Team Coordination: Managing timelines, tracking dependencies, and facilitating smooth collaboration across distributed, international time zones.
  • Driven to Get Clarity: Asking thoughtful questions, validating assumptions, and digging into the details until key stakeholders have necessary clarity.
  • Clear Communication & Documentation: Keeping project documentation, status reports, and stakeholder updates clear, organized, and up to date.
  • Process Improvement & Collaboration: Bringing strong initiative, learning from senior team members, and working as a supportive, reliable team player to refine team workflows.

To be successful in this role, you will:

  • Bring foundational experience driving cross-functional projects
  • Have 2+ years of experience in program management skills
  • Show strong self-management, taking initiative to drive daily progress and find answers without needing constant step-by-step direction.
  • Use great communication and organizational skills to keep stakeholders aligned, keep track of key details, and document decisions clearly.
  • Adapt comfortably when priorities shift, keeping a positive focus and maintaining project momentum.
  • Build strong relationships to motivate partners, help teams overcome day-to-day blockers, and stay persistent when challenges pop up.
  • Demonstrate good judgment and proactive planning to reliably deliver high-quality work.
  • Program Ownership & Execution: Taking personal accountability for project plans, tracking deliverables, and coordinating execution with cross-functional teams.

jobs.title: Account Executive- APAC
jobs.excerpt: Marsello helps retailers know their customers and keep them coming back.
jobs.description:
Marsello helps retailers know their customers and keep them coming back. We're growing across APAC, and we're looking for an Account Executive to help us win the next wave of retail brands.

You'll begin with a real head start. There's a steady flow of inbound leads from retailers who already want to talk. The challenge, and the fun, is going out and finding the ones who don't know about us yet. You'll convert inbound interest, build your own pipeline through outbound, and run demos that uncover needs retailers didn't know they had. You'll do it alongside a supportive, high-energy sales team that's in your corner.

If you know your way around SaaS, love the chase as much as the close, and want targets you can actually beat with a product retailers genuinely need, this is a role where you'll have the leads to hit your number and the freedom to smash it.

What you'll own

Inbound that's ready to go. Retailers come to us looking for a better way to keep their customers coming back. You'll pick up those leads, qualify them quickly, and turn warm interest into signed customers.

Outbound that's yours to grow. Beyond the inbound flow, you'll go after the retailers who should be on Marsello but aren't yet. You'll decide who to target, start the conversation, and build a pipeline that wouldn't exist without you. This is where great AEs make their mark.

The first conversation. For most prospective customers, you'll be their first real experience of Marsello. You'll run the demos, present the product, and ask the questions that get to what a retailer actually needs.

Your numbers. You'll carry a target and be trusted to hit it, and then to beat it, with a sales team that shares what works and celebrates the wins.

What we're looking for

  • A proven sales track record of hitting and beating targets, ideally in SaaS, retail, loyalty or marketing.
  • The discipline to work inbound leads quickly and well, and the drive to build outbound pipelines from scratch.
  • Natural confidence presenting and running demos online.
  • A tidy, well-run pipeline in a CRM.
  • A strong appreciation for technology, ideally marketing automation, cloud or SaaS, and genuine curiosity about how retailers use digital and marketing tools.
  • Excellent communication, both in writing and out loud.
  • A team-first attitude. You want to be part of a high-velocity sales team, not just a solo operator.

Why Marsello

We're a smart, close-knit team spread across New Zealand, Canada and Australia, and we back people to own their space. This role is remote, ideally based in Wellington.

Beyond the work itself, you'll get genuine flexibility in your working day, subsidised Southern Cross healthcare, a wellness allowance, a technology allowance, and even a day off for your birthday.
