jobs.excerpt: LISC is one of the country’s largest community development organizations, helping forge vibrant, resilient communities across America.
jobs.description:
LISC is one of the country’s largest community development organizations, helping forge vibrant, resilient communities across America. LISC works with residents and partners to close gaps in health, wealth, and opportunity so that people and places can thrive. We do this by acting as a conduit for grants, loans and equity--and by providing technical assistance and capacity building--to locally rooted organizations that carry out the work in communities.

About LISC Fund Management – Where community and capital grow together

LISC Fund Management (LFM) is a national impact investment platform that designs, raises, and manages mission-driven funds to expand access to capital for housing and small businesses in communities across the country. Drawing on LISC’s deep expertise in community development financing, LFM (a LISC subsidiary), connects private, public, and philanthropic capital to local initiatives that drive inclusive economic growth and long-term community stability.

As an SEC-registered investment advisor, LFM partners with cities, investors, developers, and community stakeholders to deliver innovative public-private solutions that balance measurable impact with responsible financial returns. Our work is grounded in the belief that capital, when thoughtfully deployed, can be a powerful tool for advancing opportunity and strengthening communities nationwide.

Our Vision

To become a national investment partner — delivering innovative public-private solutions that scale local investment, drive high impact, and generate responsible returns.

Our Mission

Harnessing LISC’s expertise in community development financing to expand investment opportunities in housing and small business — connecting capital to community initiatives and driving sustainable growth nationwide.

Our Core Values

Partnership • Opportunity • Performance • Stewardship • Innovation

These values guide how we collaborate, invest, manage risk, and measure success — ensuring accountability to our investors, partners, and the communities we serve.

How We Work

LFM operates as an integrated investment platform, aligning capital raising, investment execution, and long-term fund stewardship to deliver measurable impact and responsible returns. Our teams work collaboratively across the full fund lifecycle — from concept and capitalization through deployment, asset management, and reporting — ensuring continuity, accountability, and strategic alignment at every stage.

We bring funds to market through our Fund Development and Marketing department, building strong investor partnerships and clearly communicating both impact and performance. Our Fund Investment and Asset management department ensures disciplined underwriting, active portfolio oversight, and long-term value creation for communities and investors alike. Fund Management and Finance provides the financial rigor, transparency, and fiduciary oversight required of an SEC-registered investment advisor, while Operations and Administration ensure compliance, governance, and scalable internal systems that support sustainable growth.

Together, this integrated approach allows LFM to connect capital to community initiatives efficiently and responsibly — turning local investment into lasting, national impact.

Position Description

The Senior Associate, Underwriting & Fund Investments is an experienced affordable housing underwriter responsible for independently managing complex multifamily transactions from initial intake through underwriting, Investment Committee approval, and closing. The position is expected to manage active transactions at varying stages, applying strong credit judgment and financial analysis to evaluate affordable housing investments across LFM’s national portfolio.

The Senior Associate will lead lender-side underwriting of affordable multifamily transactions, including analysis of project economics, sponsor capacity, market conditions, public subsidies, and financing structures. The role requires the ability to identify and articulate key risks, develop appropriate mitigants, anticipate Investment Committee questions, and clearly co-present investment recommendations. Experience with HUD and Fannie Mae/Freddie Mac multifamily programs is particularly relevant, while experience with tax credits, New Markets Tax Credits, and equity investments is beneficial.

This is a senior individual contributor role requiring substantial independence, sound judgment, and the ability to move multiple transactions forward with limited oversight. The Senior Associate will also serve as a thought partner to the Senior Director, Underwriting, and collaborate closely with Fund Investments, Construction, Asset Management, Fund Management, Legal, borrowers, lenders, and other transaction partners. Success requires both technical underwriting expertise and LFM’s mission-oriented, collaborative approach to investment management.

Responsibilities

Underwriting and Financial Analysis (45%)

  • Independently manage the screening and underwriting active transactions at varying stages, primarily affordable multifamily rental housing investments.
  • Perform advanced financial and credit analysis, including historical and projected financial statements, project cash flows, sources and uses, development and operating budgets, debt service coverage, loan-to-value/loan-to-cost, and sensitivity analyses.
  • Evaluate proposed rents, income, vacancy, operating expenses, construction costs, market assumptions, and overall project feasibility.
  • Assess sponsor/developer capacity, organizational and ownership structures, market conditions, and transaction risks.
  • Evaluate complex affordable housing financing structures, including public subsidies and, as applicable, HUD, Fannie Mae/Freddie Mac multifamily programs, tax credits, New Markets Tax Credits, and debt and equity structures.
  • Review third-party diligence, including appraisals, environmental assessments, property condition reports, and other transaction-specific materials.
  • Identify material credit risks and recommend appropriate mitigants, including collateral structures, reserves, covenants, guarantees, and other structural protections.

Credit Presentation and Transaction Execution (40%)

  • Take ownership of assigned transactions across the full underwriting pipeline, from intake through Investment Committee approval and closing.
  • Prepare intake memoranda that clearly summarize the proposed transaction, preliminary structure, key risks, and recommendation for consideration by the intake committee.
  • Draft and review letters of intent, term sheets, and preliminary deal terms following intake approval.
  • Lead comprehensive due diligence and prepare credit memoranda that clearly articulate transaction structure, financial analysis, risks, mitigants, and investment recommendations.
  • Anticipate potential Investment Committee questions and areas of concern, conducting additional analysis as needed before presentation.
  • Co-present investment recommendations to Investment Committee and respond effectively to questions regarding credit, structure, assumptions, and risk.
  • Coordinate with borrowers, lenders, co-investors, counsel, local offices, and internal LFM teams to resolve diligence issues and keep transactions progressing efficiently toward closing.
  • Review closing statements and transaction documentation as appropriate and support accurate funding and transition to Asset Management.

Collaboration and Technical Leadership (15%)

  • Serve as a senior underwriting resource and thought partner to underwriting leadership, LISC local offices, and other LFM teams on transaction structure, credit considerations, and underwriting standards.
  • Manage assigned work independently, escalating material risks and issues appropriately and bringing forward potential solutions and recommendations.
  • Collaborate with Fund Investments, Construction, Asset Management, Fund Management, Legal, and other functions throughout the transaction lifecycle.
  • Support effective post-closing handoffs to Asset Management and provide underwriting analysis for extensions, modifications, workouts, or other portfolio matters when needed.
  • Contribute to the refinement and consistent application of underwriting tools, templates, processes, and internal guidelines.
  • Participate in pipeline reviews and cross-functional discussions related to deployment, transaction strategy, and portfolio performance.
  • Provide technical guidance, mentorship, or work review for more junior underwriting staff, as appropriate.

This position is expected to travel less than once per month, up to 15% annually.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 6–8 years of relevant experience in affordable housing finance, commercial banking, community development lending, or a related field, including significant experience underwriting affordable multifamily rental housing.
  • Experience independently underwriting complex multifamily real estate transactions from initial evaluation through credit approval and closing.
  • Prior experience presenting or co-presenting transactions to credit or investment committees.
  • Advanced proficiency in financial modeling, cash flow analysis, credit analysis, and Excel.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple concurrent transactions and exercise sound credit judgment with limited oversight.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex analysis and present investment recommendations clearly.
  • Preferred
    • Experience underwriting transactions across multiple U.S. markets or geographies.
    • Experience with LIHTC, New Markets Tax Credits, or other public subsidy structures.
    • Experience underwriting equity investments in addition to debt.
    • Experience mentoring or supervising junior analysts.

Compensation

LISC provides a competitive salary ($93,362-$116,703) and excellent fringe benefits for this position.

*Actual salaries may be based on several factors including, but not limited to, a candidate's skill set, experience, education, work location and other qualifications.

Our benefits include:

Medical, Dental, Vision Coverage: Comprehensive health plans for you and your family's well-being; Disability Insurance: Long-term and short-term coverage for peace of mind; Retirement Savings: Secure your future with our 401(k) and 403(b) plans; Generous Holidays: Enjoy ample time off to recharge and celebrate; Vacation, PTO, and Sick Days: Take advantage of flexible time-off policies to maintain work-life balance; Tuition Assistance: Pursue your educational goals with support from our tuition assistance program; Referral Program: Earn rewards for referring qualified candidates to join our team; Professional Development Opportunities: Grow and advance in your career with access to ongoing training and development programs tailored to your goals.

LISC is an equal opportunity employer. LISC does not discriminate in employment on account of actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military status or veteran status, unfavorable discharge from military service, physical or mental disability, protected medical condition as defined by applicable state or local law, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws and ordinances.

We will endeavor to make a reasonable accommodation to the known physical or mental limitations of a qualified applicant with a disability unless the accommodation would impose an undue hardship on the operation of our business.

We aspire to be the definitive home for next-generation superfans of music & culture. The future is a world where we’re undeniably the leader in social-first brand building. We’ve become the go-to platform for artists to amplify their stories, distribute their music, and partner with brands.

About Us

Low Battery is a network of nine social-first brands with an audience of over 50 million. We’re where the next generation of superfans comes for entertainment related to music and culturally relevant content. Our brands span music, fashion, gaming, news, and more.
@rap | What’s Next in Hip Hop & Culture.

Our Culture

Making our ambitious vision a reality will not be easy. So we don’t hide the truth…it’s not easy to work here. We’re bringing together a special team obsessed with their work and cultivating a culture characterized by many things, including but not limited to:
- Uncommon hard work and commitment;
-Unusual levels of autonomy and a builders mindset: solving > complaining;
- Obsession over our audiences;
- Refusal to compromise on standards for quality;
- Relentless accountability & ownership;
- Radical transparency + direct communication & feedback;
- Low ego and pursuit of truth (and goals), not looking good.
Our company culture will evolve over time, but many of these ideas are fundamental to what we do and who we are and, therefore, will not change. Every day, we strive to live as closely to these values as we can, and of course, it doesn’t always happen.
We’re early in the journey, paddling out to catch the big wave. So it’s an exciting time balanced by the reality that creating something special is uncommon and requires uncommon commitment. For those with similar ideals — come be uncommon with us!

The Opportunity

We're early and brand partnerships is the most important focus at the company. If you're not comfortable with ambiguity, hunting down opportunities and building from scratch in a competitive environment, this won't be the right role for you. If you're looking to inherit a book of business and be more of an Account Manager, this won't be the right role for you.
Your Mission: grow revenue by making the marketplace aware of Low Battery and building strong relationships with brand partners.

Outcomes (What You'll OWN)

  • Meet or exceed revenue targets on a quarterly and annual basis
  • Generate 5 new business pitches per week
  • Send 100+ outbound messages per week on Email & LinkedIN to generate new business

Responsibilities (What You'll DO)

  • Generate Revenue. Meet or exceed revenue goals on a quarterly & annual basis.
  • Prospecting. You’ll be a hunter required to build a book of business from scratch from defining target brands & contacts, using crafty outbound strategies on Email, LinkedIN, etc. to generate new business pitch opportunities.
  • Pre-sales: You’ll collaborate internally to ideate on proactive client opportunities, respond to RFPs, create pitch decks, rate cards and media plans. You’ll be required to draft narrative-driven pitch decks that convey our network, capabilities and value propositions effectively.
  • Pitching. You’ll be required to quickly get up to speed on our network positioning, pitch messaging and conveying value propositions to be able to lead sales calls on your own and drive revenue.
  • Post-sales: close a deal? You’ll own invoicing, client communications and collaborating across departments to oversee campaign execution, delivery and performance reporting.
  • Reporting: we can’t manage what we don’t measure. You’ll leverage spreadsheets and/or a CRM to track prospecting, meeting notes, pipeline & deal flow, etc.
  • Content & Product: you'll work closely with our product (content) teams to respond to RFPs and put together pitches. You'll also be on the front lines communicating our network & advertising products to the marketplace. You'll rapidly become an expert in our content & product offering and bring intelligence & feedback back to the organization.

What We're Looking for

  • 4+ years of direct sales experience in digital and social media.
  • Track record of success driving revenue through discovering, prospecting and closing NEW business.
  • Authentic & deep understanding of the social media landscape and a history of selling social.
  • Competitive: you're a hunter with the ability to build a book of business from scratch and comfortable under pressure.
  • Data-driven and comfortable with the latest technologies for lead sourcing, outreach and CRM reporting.
  • Craftsmanship: organized, systems oriented and someone who "tends the garden" for an efficient workplace.
  • High Agency: demonstrated examples of taking the initiative to solve problems and comfortable with the ambiguity that comes with an early stage company.
  • Creative: you're a dot connector who loves coming up with new media solutions for brands.
  • Exceptional communication both in writing and verbally when presenting to brands.
  • Willingness to travel as necessary to win new business.
  • Passionate about music, fashion, gaming and popular culture.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • A fully remote team
  • Annual team summits
  • Health Benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, etc.)
  • Yearly skills development budget

jobs.description:
REQUIRED: MUST have experience with Code Development + Computational Design and/or Geometry Processing. Applicants will not be considered without this experience.

About Us:

We are an MIT-born, venture-backed Silicon Valley startup building a real-life 'Jarvis'. An AI Copilot for design and manufacturing. Our goal is to utilize advanced AI, physics simulation, and computer graphics to reduce costs and improve engineering productivity across all steps of the design and manufacturing process.

On this Role:

This role is a mix of a few worlds coming together. You’ll be working with machine learning but not in a vacuum it’s applied to real engineering problems, working with 2D and 3D data from CAD, CAE, and CAM systems. A big part of the work is taking complex geometry, design workflows, and simulation data and figuring out how to turn that into something an AI system can actually understand and use.

We’re looking for someone who’s strong technically, especially in Python and ML, but also has the curiosity to dig into how things are designed and built in the real world. You might come from a research background or industry but either way you’re comfortable moving between theory and practical application. If you’ve spent time around mechanical systems or engineering design, that’s a big plus, because a lot of this role is about bridging that gap between advanced models and how engineers actually work day to day.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain geometry processing and simulation algorithms for engineering applications.
  • Build services for reading, processing, and writing 2D/3D engineering data.
  • Develop rendering modules for generating 2D/3D visual assets.
  • Curate and manage large-scale datasets for learning-based systems.
  • Implement and optimize post-training workflows for machine learning models.
  • Contribute to the development of domain-specific languages for engineering tasks.

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years of academic or industry experience in one or more of the following areas: Geometric Processing, Simulation, Optimization, Machine Learning, or Domain-Specific Languages.
  • Proficient in writing clean, modular, and maintainable Python code.
  • Experience with dataset creation and data pipeline development.
  • PhD or MS with a focus in Computational Design, Simulation, or AI.
  • Experience developing CAD/CAM/CAE software tools.
  • Experience developing or fine-tuning large language models (LLMs), including post-training methods such as quantization, pruning, distillation, or reinforcement learning.
  • Experience designing or implementing DSLs or compilers.

  • Build collaborative, cross-functional partnerships across executive leadership, Sales, and Product Management.

CALM FOCUS. We work in tech and build solutions for real estate. Both are fast-paced and stressful industries. But by focusing on the larger objective rather than rushing from one task to the next, we can create solutions our customers love.

ONE TEAM, ONE DREAM. Big problems require big solutions. We look at our customers’ experiences holistically and recognize that solving them requires collaboration across teams and our three affiliate companies — Homeward, Homeward Mortgage and Homeward Title.

InStride Health’s mission is to deliver specialty anxiety and OCD care that works for every kid, teen, young adult, and family who needs it. Through this mission, we are expanding access to insurance-based care, increasing engagement in treatment, and improving treatment outcomes.   • Embrace Community: We all belong. We are in this together, and we never worry alone. We believe in each other and recognize that every voice matters.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Clinical Research Scientist to join the Clinical Research Team at InStride Health. This role is ideal for an early-career doctoral level researcher who is passionate about advancing quality, safety, and clinical effectiveness through rigorous research and data-driven evaluation.

The Clinical Research Scientist will play a key role in clinical outcomes evaluation within a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment. The individual will work closely with clinical, operations, product, and data teams to monitor high standards of care delivery, support evidence-based decision-making, and strengthen organizational quality initiatives.

Responsibilities:

  • Participate in the design, execution, and quality assurance for clinical outcomes research initiatives
  • Manage, analyze, and interpret large clinical and operational datasets using appropriate statistical methodologies.

  • Assist with research protocol development, study implementation, and regulatory compliance activities including Institutional Review Board (IRB) submissions, amendments, and reporting requirements.

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, including scientific writing and presentation development.

  • Organized, attention to detail, and unwavering commitment to data integrity and continuous quality improvement.
  • Able to work independently, manage competing priorities, and thrive in a high-growth environment where the work is continually evolving.

  • Opportunity to join a mission-driven company that is changing the landscape of pediatric mental health treatment
  • Chance to make a far-reaching impact by helping children and families access desperately-needed, evidence-based care
  • Opportunity to work with talented and experienced team members who have devoted their lives to solving this problem
  • Fully virtual: work from the comfort of your home with periodic in-person retreats

  2. Building a mission-driven business that lasts. Specifically, we believe our commitment to a supportive culture improves innovation, decision-making, and efficiency.

We seek a results-oriented Product Manager to own the content tooling and communications execution layer of our SaaS B2B2C platform - the systems that create, manage, and deliver every message our clients send. This role covers the content management stack (headless CMS, templating, personalization, approval workflows) and everything downstream: the vendors and channels that get messages out through email, text, and letters. You will sit at the intersection of content operations, deliverability, and consumer empathy.

As the product owner, you will define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for content authoring and multi-channel delivery. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to give our B2B clients fast, compliant, self-serve control over what gets sent - and make sure it actually arrives.

The Role

You will own the pipeline that turns content into delivered messages. You will build the authoring and setup tools that let clients create, review, and send communications without needing engineering, and you will own the vendor and channel infrastructure that gets those messages out reliably and at scale.

What You'll Do - Content Management

  • Content Management: Own our content stack, such as Contentful or a similar headless CMS - content models, templates, and publishing workflows.

  • Empower the Client: Deliver clear, easy-to-use tools so clients can manage their own templates, dynamic variables, brand voice, and compliance language.

  • AI in Content Tooling: Bring AI into the authoring experience - drafting and rewriting copy, suggesting variants to test, checking tone and reading level, and flagging compliance risks before content ships.

  • Governance & Approvals: Build review, approval, and audit workflows that lock legally-reviewed language while allowing safe self-serve edits everywhere else.

  • Scale & Reuse: Drive reusable templates and personalization so content scales across clients, channels, and debt types without duplication.

What You'll Do - Vendors & Channels

  • Vendor Management: Own integrations and performance with delivery vendors such as Twilio, SparkPost, Lob and similar email, texting, letter and voice providers - including evaluation, onboarding, backups, and failover.

  • Deliverability: Drive sender reputation, domain and IP management, 10DLC and short code registration, and carrier analysis.

  • Channel Strategy: Define what each channel can and cannot do across email, SMS/MMS, letter, and phone-like channels, and how content shows up in each.

  • Monitoring: Build monitoring for send health, bounce and complaint rates, delays, and vendor cost, with clear visibility for internal teams and clients.

What You'll Do - Consumer Impact

  • Personalization: Partner with data science so content and channel choices fit each individual consumer.

  • Engagement Strategy: Move beyond delivery rates to real outcomes - measure how content and channel choices help consumers reach a positive financial resolution.

  • Experimentation: Run content and channel A/B tests, and feed what you learn back into templates and models.

Who You Are:

  • Experience: 3+ years in Product Management, with exposure to content platforms, CMS or marketing tools, or communications infrastructure. Fintech, debt collection, or other regulated financial services experience is a strong plus.

  • Content Tooling: Hands-on experience with a headless CMS or content platform (Contentful, Contentstack, or similar) - content modeling, templating, and publishing workflows.

  • Working with Contractors: Experience working with contractors or agencies - setting the work and the standards, and keeping the team on track.

  • Vendor & Channel Expertise: Working knowledge of email/SMS/voice delivery vendors, deliverability mechanics, carrier and ISP filtering, and messaging regulations.

  • The "Double-Sided" Mindset: Experience with B2B2C products, balancing business buyer needs with end-user experience.

  • Data Fluency: Comfortable working with engagement, deliverability, and segmentation data.

  • Soft Skills: Ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical client stakeholders clearly.

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business, or a related field.

  • Traditional/Roth retirement savings options

  • Company-paid disability and life insurance

  • Flexible Spending Account & Limited FSA

About Airship

Airship is trusted by world’s leading brands such as Alaska Airlines, BBC and The Home Depot to drive revenue growth and customer loyalty with exceptional cross-channel customer experiences. Today, brands are challenged to deliver seamless, unified customer experiences across a fragmented array of channels and devices— apps, websites, email, SMS, wallets and more.

Airship’s no-code, AI-powered platform was designed with non-technical, growth-focused teams in mind, making it easy to create, test and orchestrate hyper-personalized experiences across all channels. With the ability to easily enrich customer data and rapidly launch growth experiments, Airship enables brands to deliver consistent, meaningful interactions that accelerate conversion and foster deeper customer relationships.

We invite you to be part of our journey in building products and delivering services that touch millions of customers around the world every day.

To learn more about us, visit , read our blog or follow us on LinkedIn.

About the Role

Airship is looking for an Information Security Architect to own the design and evolution of our security architecture across cloud infrastructure, applications, and the CI/CD pipeline. You'll be Airship's technical authority on secure-by-design systems, partnering with Engineering, Platform, and Product teams to embed security into every phase of the development lifecycle.

This is a hands-on architecture role. You'll conduct threat modeling, perform architecture reviews, define security standards and reference architectures, and drive secure design patterns across Airship's GCP-based environment. You'll also evaluate emerging technologies, including AI and generative AI platforms, to identify security risks and define secure adoption patterns.

Why This Role

  • Depth over breadth. You'll focus on what matters most: securing Airship's cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines, conducting threat modeling, and shaping architecture decisions
  • GCP at the core. Airship runs on Google Cloud Platform. You'll work deeply with GCP-native security capabilities, defining guardrails, segmentation patterns, logging standards, and workload protection across the platform
  • Secure the pipeline, secure the product. CI/CD pipeline security is a primary focus. You'll design and implement controls that protect the software delivery lifecycle from code commit through production deployment
  • AI-forward security. You'll evaluate and secure AI and GenAI platforms, define usage patterns for AI-assisted development tools, and help establish security architecture for Airship's AI-enabled features
  • Fully remote, flexible culture. Airship's Digital First approach means flexible, remote work is the norm, with a team that collaborates across timezones and geographies every day
  • Room to grow. This role is a path toward senior security architecture, security leadership, or deeper cloud security specialization

What You'll Do*

  • Design, develop, and maintain Airship's security architecture, including reference architectures, secure design patterns, and technical security standards
  • Perform security architecture reviews for enterprise applications, cloud platforms, infrastructure services, and technology integrations, ensuring alignment with security standards and risk posture
  • Conduct threat modeling and technical risk assessments to identify security gaps and recommend mitigation strategies
  • Define and implement cloud security guardrails, network segmentation patterns, logging standards, and access control models across Airship's GCP environment
  • Partner with Engineering and DevOps teams to integrate security controls into the CI/CD pipeline, including secure build processes, container security, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) security, secrets management, and software supply chain integrity
  • Evaluate proposed architecture and design changes from engineering teams, analyze their security impact, and make recommendations
  • Assess emerging technologies (including AI platforms, generative AI tools, and AI-assisted development technologies) to identify security risks and define secure usage patterns
  • Develop security guidance for API security, application authentication (SAML, OAuth2), encryption, and identity and access management
  • Research security trends, emerging attack methods, and new classes of vulnerabilities to proactively reduce the risk of breach
  • Leverage AI-enabled tools and automation to improve security analysis, architecture review workflows, and threat detection
  • Partner with security tooling teams to evaluate enterprise security tools for architectural fit, integration models, and long-term scalability
  • Participate in the Security on-call rotation and respond to incidents
  • Provide technical security guidance for complex customer inquiries that require deep architectural expertise
  • Mentor colleagues across the organization on secure design principles and security best practices

*Duties described are not a comprehensive list. Additional tasks may be assigned from time to time, and responsibilities may be amended at any time at the sole discretion of the Employer.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of experience in information security, security architecture, cloud security engineering, or a related technical discipline
  • Deep expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) security, including native security capabilities, cloud architecture patterns, and workload protection
  • Hands-on experience securing CI/CD pipelines, including container security, IaC security, secrets management, and DevSecOps practices
  • Experience conducting threat modeling for complex, distributed systems using standard methodologies
  • Experience performing security architecture and design reviews for cloud-native applications and infrastructure

jobs.excerpt: This is an internal role at Weekday.  Not a role by a client.
jobs.description:
This is an internal role at Weekday. Not a role by a client.

  • Role type: Internship
  • Location: Remote
  • Duration: 3 months
  • Working days: Monday–Saturday
  • Stipend: ₹4,000–5,000/month
  • PPO if performance is satisfactory

Weekday is an AI-native recruiting platform. We are backed by Y Combinator and Venture Highway (now General Catalyst). We have built the largest white collar talent database in India and have built tools to run outbound recruiting campaigns to them.

Read this before you apply

This is not a glamorous role. It's careful, high-volume, detail-obsessed work — and the models we're building are only as good as the data you produce. You'll spend your day looking at documents and drawing bounding boxes around the right things: marking exactly where a field, a block of text, a table, or a signature sits on the page, over and over, correctly. It's precise, repetitive work, and it's the foundation the whole annotation project stands on. One sloppy box teaches the model the wrong thing.

If you get satisfaction from doing something exactly right, at pace, without cutting corners — you'll do well here. If you need constant variety and get bored by repetition, this isn't for you.

What you'll actually do

On any given day you might be:

  • Looking at documents and drawing accurate bounding boxes around the regions that matter — fields, text blocks, tables, stamps, signatures, whatever the project calls for
  • Labelling and classifying each box correctly according to the annotation guidelines
  • Keeping your boxes tight and consistent — same standard on document one and document one thousand
  • Flagging edge cases, ambiguous documents, and gaps or contradictions in the guidelines instead of guessing
  • Reviewing and correcting your own (and sometimes others') annotations to keep quality high
  • Helping refine the labelling process so annotation gets faster and more consistent over time

You'll be measured on accuracy, consistency, and throughput — how much high-quality annotated data you produce, not hours logged.

What we're looking for

  • You're precise and patient — you can draw the same clean box the hundredth time as well as the first
  • You sweat the details; a box that's slightly off or a wrong label bothers you
  • You take ownership. When a batch is yours, it's done right — no follow-ups needed
  • You follow guidelines closely but speak up the moment something doesn't fit them
  • You're comfortable with repetitive, screen-heavy work and a Monday–Saturday pace
  • You care about the quality of your work even when nobody's checking every box

What you get

  • A front-row look at how a venture-backed startup is built and run profitably
  • A real understanding of what goes into the data behind AI models — the part most people never see
  • Real ownership of the ground truth the project depends on
  • A PPO if you perform
  • Hands-on experience with the tools and habits that make you genuinely useful anywhere

jobs.description:
Job Summary

As a Web Developer supporting the VA's National Training and Support Program (NTSP) Quality and Data Informatics initiative, you will design, develop, modernize, and maintain SharePoint, Internet, and Intranet websites that serve VA staff, stakeholders, and Veterans across the federal healthcare ecosystem. You will play a critical role in ensuring digital content is accessible, compliant, and performant in alignment with VA standards and federal regulations. The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented, self-directed web developer who thrives in a structured federal contracting environment and takes pride in delivering inclusive, Section 508-compliant digital experiences that support the VA mission.

Primary Responsibilities

Design, develop, modernize, and maintain SharePoint, Internet, and Intranet websites in support of NTSP program operations and VA stakeholder needs. Conduct comprehensive website assessments and develop management plans, design templates, and visual mockups to guide site development and continuous improvement. Establish and maintain website user groups and access permissions, ensuring appropriate role-based controls and governance in alignment with VA security policies. Perform website coding and prepare digital content for posting in full compliance with Section 508 accessibility standards, the VA Style Guide, and applicable copyright and release documentation requirements. Monitor and report on website performance across accessibility, quality assurance, and search engine optimization (SEO) dimensions, implementing improvements as needed. Support the structured transition of website maintenance responsibilities to Government personnel at task order conclusion, including documentation, knowledge transfer sessions, and handoff materials.

Minimum Qualifications

Minimum of 4 years of relevant web development experience, including design, development, and maintenance of SharePoint and web-based platforms (a BA/BS degree may be substituted with 7 total years of relevant experience). BA/BS degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Web Development, or a related field required; 3 years of additional relevant experience may be substituted in lieu of degree. Prior experience working with federal agencies, VA programs, or other government healthcare clients strongly preferred; familiarity with VA digital standards and federal web governance frameworks is a plus. Ability to obtain and maintain a VA Personal Identity Verification (PIV) credential and successfully complete a VA background investigation as required for system access. Must be authorized to work in the United States; this position does not offer visa sponsorship. jobs.excerpt: HexCoded is an AI video studio: you should be able to make anything you can imagine.
jobs.description:
HexCoded is an AI video studio: you should be able to make anything you can imagine. We are a very small team building the tools that are reshaping how video, image and audio get made. Check out hexcoded.ai

What you'll actually work on

  • Make the content. Reels, shorts, posts, hooks, thumbnails, captions. Most of it made in HexCoded itself, posted in public.
  • Run our editors. We work with a bench of freelance video editors. You write the brief, pick the reference, chase the deadline, and send it back when it isn't right. Content nobody chases doesn't get made.
  • Fill the Discord. We have one. It's nearly empty. Getting people in there and keeping it alive is yours — inviting them, welcoming them by name, starting the conversation on the quiet days, and telling the rest of us what those people actually want from us.
  • Write the emails. All of them. The hello when someone signs up. The nudge that gets them to make their first ad. The note to people who drifted away. The announcement when we launch something. You write it, you send it.
  • Write the ads. You'll sit with the ad account, see which ads are doing well, and write the next batch. You won't control the budget. You'll be the one who knows why the winner won.
  • Watch the numbers. Views, saves, Discord joins, replies, signups. Not for a report. Because you can't get better at this without knowing which of your posts worked and which died.

What you'll bring

  • An account you've actually run. Yours, a friend's, a college club's, a page about something you love. Send us links and real numbers, including the posts that flopped.
  • Taste you can explain. Show you two thumbnails and you can say which one wins and why, in a sentence. "It just feels better" is where you start, not where you stop.
  • You already build things with AI. Not a chat tab you ask questions in. Actual work. You've had a model rename two hundred clips at once, pull a week of numbers into one place, write thirty versions of a caption so you could pick the best one, or make some small thing that saves you an hour every day. You'll do a lot of that here, including in Claude Code, which is Claude running on your computer where it can work on your files directly. You don't need to know it already. You do need to have used AI to save yourself real time, and be able to show us what you made.
  • Short, clear writing. Most of what you make is a few words a stranger reads once and judges us on.
  • You're properly online. You knew what happened on Instagram this week before anyone told you. You can name a format that died and say what killed it.

jobs.description:
Opportunity

ThermalWorks is seeking a high-caliber, full-time Technical Documentation Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will bridge first-principles thermodynamic concepts with the practical realities of our hardware to address the escalating cooling demands of modern, mission-critical data center applications. Rather than physical prototype deployment, this position focuses on the documentation lifecycle. Theoretical refrigeration knowledge is strictly essential, as you will be translating complex engineering designs and system behaviors into highly accurate support documents, manuals, and operational sequences for our product lines.

Thermal Works values efficiency and strives to maintain smooth operations. Our primary focus is on providing an integrated cooling system for data centers and commercial buildings that dramatically reduces the energy demand, water consumption and cost of cooling. jobs.description:
SDR I / SDR II

About Subsplash

Subsplash—The Ultimate Engagement Platform™ for churches, Christian ministries, non-profits, and businesses around the world, serves 14,000+ clients, creating impactful products, and delighting the 40 million real people who use our platform every day. Subsplash is one of the fastest growing companies in the U.S. (Inc. 5,000 Fastest Growing Companies in 2020) and has won awards for best mobile experience, been voted one of Seattle and Austin’s best places to work multiple years in a row, created some of the most downloaded apps of all time, and built enterprise software for world-class brands like XBOX, Microsoft, Samsung, Expedia, and Cisco; yet, at the end of the day, our passion is to equip churches to make a lasting impact in our world. Our team of 20+ mission-driven people who are committed to our core values of humility, innovation, and excellence has pioneered the market with over 30-firsts for the church market including the first-ever church mobile app.

Working at Subsplash is more than just a job; we are a team of people who are courageous, inventive, and passionate about doing meaningful work every day. Don’t take our word for it—head to Glassdoor and see for yourself!

About the Team

The Sales team at Subsplash is all about driving revenue and growing relationships with prospects and clients. We are constantly striving to find ways to connect with clients and fill their needs through our product, and communicate the value of what we offer. The Sales Team is a high-energy, Friday think-tanking, relationship-based, enthusiastic team with clear goals and incentives linked to team and company success. Sales likes a little healthy competition now and then, both on and off the spikeball court.

About The Role

As a SDR I or SDR II you will report to the Sales Manager. Both roles are focused on generating new business for Subsplash through sourcing and identifying organizations that will benefit from Subsplash services, building rapport with the gatekeepers, connecting with decision makers to set up meetings with our Account Executives, and demonstrating the value that Subsplash can deliver by helping them achieve their goals. Your primary objective is to focus on the best opportunities available to Subsplash in order to maximize MRR (Monthly Recurring Revenue) by generating and qualifying new leads for Account Executives. The Sales Development Representatives are a part of a growing team of people who are part super-sleuth, part bloodhound, part evangelist. Together, they find success for Subsplash and our clients by fostering relationships with prospects, identifying market trends and what success looks like for each organization, and partnering with them to reach their goals and make more fans of Subsplash.

Compensation

We're hiring at two levels for this role. Whether you're earlier in your sales career or you've already got some reps under your belt, there may be a place for you on our team!

Sales Development Representative I — You're newer to sales, but you're coachable, curious, and genuinely energized by connecting people with solutions that make their lives easier. You don't need to have all the answers yet — we'll invest in building the fundamentals with you. Base salary $40,000, with expected first-year OTE of $50,000–$60,000.

Sales Development Representative II— You've got 1–2 years of outbound sales experience, you know your way around a pipeline, and you have a track record of hitting your numbers. You're ready to contribute quickly and grow from there. Some level of familiarity with church dynamics and structures here is also a plus! Base salary $50,000, with expected first-year OTE of $60,000–$70,000.

Your interview process will help us find the right fit together!

Your Priorities

  • Utilize Salesforce, cold calling, and email to generate and source new sales opportunities.
  • Engage with curiosity utilizing the discovery strengths needed for a complete solutions pitch.
  • Pipeline management, through customized outreach strategies.
  • Identify prospect’s needs and note them in Salesforce for demo purposes after the lead hand-off.
  • Build relationships with prospects to qualify leads as sales opportunities.
  • Demonstrate being an introductory expert on Subsplash Platforms and services.
  • Set up meetings or calls with (prospective) customers and Account Executies
  • Report to the Sales Manager with weekly, monthly, and quarterly results.
  • Effectively use provided technology, and account information to generate interest from prospects.
  • Assess prospect needs and present appropriate solutions.
  • Convert prospects into warm leads by scheduling a demo call with Account Executives
  • Participate in team‐building and company‐growth activities.
  • Manage and track customer and transactional information in a CRM system.

Qualifications

Regardless of level, we're looking for people who bring:

  • Genuine enthusiasm for both technology and the communities we serve
  • Strong communication skills and an active listening approach
  • Resilience and energy in a fast-moving environment
  • A coachable mindset and a drive toward humility, innovation, and excellence
  • A desire to grow within a sales organization
  • Familiarity with church staff roles and dynamics is a plus at any level

Sales Development Representative I — If you're newer to sales, here's what we're looking for:

  • 0–1 years of sales or customer-facing experience
  • Demonstrated potential over proven metrics — we're evaluating communication, curiosity, and coachability
  • No CRM experience required; but a track record of quickly learning new systems and being tech savvy is ideal
  • Adjacent experience in customer service, ministry, volunteer leadership, retail, hospitality, etc

Sales Development Representative II — If you're coming in with more experience, we are looking for:

  • 1–2+ years of outbound sales experience, including cold calling, cold email, or pipeline management
  • A track record of meeting or exceeding quota or activity metrics
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce or a comparable CRM
  • Comfort articulating a value prop and handling early objections
  • Enough familiarity with a sales cycle to contribute quickly

Top Outcomes in Year 1:

  • Represent Subsplash’s products and services, starting with a comprehensive understanding. of the platform and leading to consumer research to identify how our solutions meet needs.
  • Generate leads and build relationships by nurturing warm prospects and finding new potential sales outlets.
  • Manage and maintain a pipeline of interested prospects and engage Account Executives for next steps.
  • Identify best practices to refine the company’s lead generation playbook.
  • Become an integral part of our revenue growth strategy.

Location

Subsplash currently has operations in 27 states across the US! As much as we would love to have employees in as many states and countries as we have clients, we are currently limiting hiring to the states we already operate in. As a result of that, this role is only available as a 100% remote position if you reside in one of the following states:

AL, AR, AZ, CO, FL, GA, ID, IA, IN, KS, KY, MO, MI, MN, NC, NM, OK, OH, OR, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WY.

Unfortunately, if you do not currently reside in one of these states, we are unable to consider your application.

Benefits

Generous Paid Time Off, Medical Coverage, Dental Coverage, Vision Coverage, short and long term disability and life insurance all free of charge, Competitive Compensation, 401k Matching, Professional Development, Top of the Line Equipment, Referral Program, Parental Leave, Family-Friendly Culture, and the chance to work side-by-side with thought leaders in emerging tech

Note: Employment with Subsplash is contingent upon satisfactory proof of employee’s right to work in the U.S., as required by law and upon completion of a basic background check and; Employment with Subsplash is considered “at will,” meaning that either the company or the employee may terminate the employment relationship at any time without cause or notice. We do not discriminate on the ground of race, color, religion, sex, age, disability or national origin, or genetic information in the hiring, retention, or promotion of employees; nor in determining their rank, or the compensation or fringe benefits paid them.

jobs.title: Client Delivery Operations Manager
jobs.excerpt: Wing is a fast-growing, Silicon Valley-based, venture-backed multinational startup.
jobs.description:
Wing is a fast-growing, Silicon Valley-based, venture-backed multinational startup.

We are looking for an exceptional, highly motivated individual to serve as a Client Delivery Operations Manager.

The Client Delivery Operations Manager is responsible for the day-to-day management, visibility, and operational health of Wing's end-to-end client fulfillment pipeline.This role ensures that opportunities and accounts move efficiently through each stage of the business, from Sales handoff, talent requirements, recruitment and staffing, candidate presentation, client selection, onboarding, launch, and early account stabilization.

The Client Delivery Operations Manager serves as the central operational owner of the pipeline, continuously monitoring movement, identifying bottlenecks, enforcing timelines, coordinating cross-functional teams, and resolving process gaps that could delay revenue, staffing, or client activation.

This is not primarily an administrative tracking role. The position is expected to actively manage the pipeline, challenge stalled items, drive accountability, escalate risks, and improve the underlying processes that keep the pipeline moving.

Key Responsibilities

    1. End-to-End Pipeline Management

    • Own the daily operational management of Wing's active pipeline.
    • Maintain visibility across every account and requirement from Sales handoff through successful launch.
    • Ensure every pipeline item has a clear status, owner, next action, and expected completion date.
    • Monitor accounts that are stalled, delayed, blocked, or at risk.
    • Proactively follow up with responsible teams to move accounts forward.
    • Ensure pipeline stages accurately reflect the actual operational status of each account.

      2. Pipeline Health Monitoring

      • Conduct daily reviews of pipeline movement and outstanding requirements.
      • Identify aging accounts, stalled stages, capacity issues, and process bottlenecks.
      • Flag accounts at risk of missing staffing or launch timelines.
      • Monitor pipeline volume against available recruitment, staffing, onboarding, and operational capacity.
      • Maintain clear visibility into what is entering, moving through, and exiting the pipeline.

        3. Cross-Functional Coordination

        Work closely with:
        • Sales
        • Customer Success
        • Talent Acquisition
        • Staffing
        • Onboarding
        • Training
        • Operations
        • Product or specialized service teams
        • Finance and other support teams when required
        • Ensure clean handoffs between departments and prevent accounts from being delayed because of unclear ownership or incomplete information.

          4. Sales-to-Operations Handoff

          • Review newly closed accounts and confirm that operational requirements are complete.
          • Validate role requirements, client expectations, staffing needs, timelines, and special conditions.
          • Identify incomplete, unrealistic, or unclear requirements before they create downstream delays.
          • Coordinate with Sales when clarification or expectation resetting is required.
          • Ensure specialized products or services follow the correct operational process.

            5. Staffing and Candidate Pipeline Oversight

            • Monitor recruitment and staffing progress against client requirements.
            • Track candidate availability, endorsement, interviews, client selections, replacements, and pending decisions.
            • Identify roles with insufficient candidate supply or prolonged staffing timelines.
            • Coordinate with Talent Acquisition and Staffing leadership on priority requirements.
            • Escalate accounts requiring intervention, sourcing adjustments, compensation review, or expectation management.

              6. Client Selection and Decision Management

              • Track candidates presented to clients and outstanding client decisions.
              • Ensure follow-ups occur within established timelines.
              • Identify accounts where client responsiveness is delaying fulfillment.
              • Coordinate with CSMs, OBS, Sales, or account owners when client intervention is required.
              • Maintain visibility into candidate rejection reasons and recurring selection barriers.

                7. Onboarding and Launch Readiness

                • Monitor accounts approaching onboarding and launch.
                • Confirm that staffing, documentation, equipment, access, training, schedules, and client requirements are ready.
                • Surface launch risks before they become client-facing issues.
                • Coordinate resolution between responsible departments.
                • Ensure accounts transition cleanly from pipeline management into normal account operations.

                  8. Pipeline Escalation Management

                  Serve as the first operational escalation point for pipeline-related issues. Examples include:
                  • Staffing delays
                  • Missing client requirements
                  • Candidate shortages
                  • Interview delays
                  • Client decision delays
                  • Incorrect Sales handoffs
                  • Compensation mismatches
                  • Training capacity concerns
                  • Onboarding blockers
                  • Ownership gaps
                  • System or CRM inaccuracies
                  • Accounts repeatedly moving backward in the pipeline
                  • Determine the appropriate owner, establish an action plan, and monitor the issue until resolution.

                    9. Pipeline Governance and Accountability

                    • Establish and enforce pipeline SLAs.
                    • Ensure teams update their respective pipeline stages consistently.
                    • Hold stakeholders accountable for overdue actions.
                    • Require clear next steps for every active account.
                    • Escalate repeated SLA breaches or operational blockers to leadership.
                    • Ensure pipeline meetings focus on decisions and corrective actions rather than status reporting alone.

                      10. Pipeline Reporting and Forecasting

                      Provide leadership with clear visibility into:
                      • Total active pipeline
                      • New accounts entering the pipeline
                      • Accounts staffed
                      • Accounts awaiting candidates
                      • Accounts awaiting client decisions
                      • Accounts scheduled for launch
                      • Aging by pipeline stage
                      • Average time spent per stage
                      • Staffing turnaround time
                      • Bottleneck trends
                      • At-risk accounts
                      • Projected launches
                      • Expected revenue activation
                      • Pipeline capacity and resource constraints
                      • Produce weekly and monthly pipeline health reports with clear recommendations and required leadership actions.

                        11. Process Improvement

                        • Continuously evaluate how accounts move through Wing's pipeline.
                        • Identify unnecessary steps, duplicated work, unclear ownership, and communication gaps.
                        • Design improved workflows and escalation protocols.
                        • Recommend automation opportunities.
                        • Partner with system owners to improve CRM and pipeline architecture.
                        • Standardize handoff requirements between departments.
                        • Document processes, SLAs, escalation paths, and ownership matrices.
                        • Measure whether process changes improve pipeline velocity and client experience.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong experience in operations, program management, revenue operations, staffing operations, customer success operations, or similar environments.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex workflows involving multiple departments.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Comfortable working with high-volume operational pipelines.

  • Strong understanding of SLAs, workflow management, escalation management, and process optimization.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and follow-through.

  • Ability to challenge teams constructively and drive accountability.

  • Strong written and verbal communication.

  • Experience using CRM, project management, reporting, and workflow management platforms.

  • Ability to interpret operational data and convert findings into actionable recommendations.

  • Able to travel to the Philippines as required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in BPO, outsourcing, staffing, recruitment, SaaS, or service-based organizations.

  • Experience managing client implementation or fulfillment pipelines.

  • Experience working across Sales, Recruitment, Customer Success, and Operations.

  • Familiarity with HubSpot, ClickUp, Power BI, or similar systems

  • Experience designing SLAs, dashboards, workflow automation, or operational governance.

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT QUINCE Founded in 2018, Quince was built to challenge the idea that nice things have to cost a lot.
jobs.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Founded in 2018, Quince was built to challenge the idea that nice things have to cost a lot. Our mission is simple: to make really high quality essentials for really low prices, produced fairly and sustainably. We believe everyone deserves exceptional craftsmanship and timeless design without the traditional markups. Quince is a direct-to-consumer (DTC) model that cuts out middlemen and leverages just-in-time manufacturing to minimize waste and maximize value.

Quince is a tech company disrupting the retail industry by putting AI, analytics and automation at the center of everything we do. Our unwavering commitment to excellence and company values guide our teams and actions:

  • Customer First: We prioritize customer satisfaction in every decision.

  • High Quality: True quality means premium materials and rigorous production standards you can feel good about.

  • Essential Design: We focus on timeless, functional essentials instead of chasing trends.

  • Always a Better Deal: Innovation and transparency ensure value for both customers and partners.

  • Social & Environmental Responsibility: We commit to sustainable materials, ethical production, and fair wages.

Quince partners with world-class manufacturers across the globe and serves millions of customers. With strong investor backing and a focus on sustainable growth, we are a company that is rapidly scaling while maintaining a commitment to quality, simplicity, and radical price transparency.

OUR TEAM AND SUCCESS

At Quince, you will be part of a high-performing team that is redefining what quality, value, and sustainability mean in modern retail. We are a destination for builders, innovators, and operators to come together and challenge the status quo. Our collective ambition is bold. We are creating an entirely new category and customer experience – one that democratizes luxury and provides high quality products at radically low prices. That mission demands a world-class team committed to excellence.

If you are motivated by impact, growth, and purpose, you will find a strong sense of belonging at Quince.

THE ROLE

Head of Planning

We’re looking for a Head of Planning to join our growing Operations team. You will play a critical role in optimizing Quince’s inventory performance by leading all Inventory Planning and Forecasting functions for a specific area of the business portfolio, TBD. In this role, you will own forecasting and replenishment for your business, driving optimal inventory turns, improve in-stock performance, and maximize return on investment. This is a senior individual contributor role with significant ownership and influence.

Because Quince’s business model is unique, this position will be equally unique in its execution—combining analytical rigor, strategic partnership, and active collaboration with merchandising, sourcing, technology, and vendor teams. This is a hands-on role that requires a high level of performance and execution, aligned with Quince’s operating principles.

Success in this position means working within and building best-in-class forecasting systems that balance product availability with working capital efficiency while supporting Quince’s mission to deliver luxury quality at radically low prices. As a part of the Planning team, this person will play a critical role in shaping future Planning processes at Quince, helping to architect the solutions and capabilities of tomorrow to support our rapid growth.

This role will report directly to a VP of Inventory Planning.

Responsibilities

  • Forecast items at the style-color-size level by week, achieving key performance indicators including in-stock rates, inventory turns, and return on investment.
  • Partner closely with the internal sourcing team and external vendors to collaborate on forecasts and maximize product availability.
  • Work directly with the technology team to develop and implement integrated, intelligent, and automated forecasting solutions.
  • Conduct analytics and root-cause analysis to identify opportunities for KPI improvement.
  • Collaborate with sourcing to model vendor relationships, terms, and risk profiles.
  • Build short-, mid-, and long-range inventory and replenishment plans that align with business strategy.
  • Present forecasts, strategies, and performance updates weekly to executives.
  • Manage and mentor one or more team members as the function scales.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Looking for candidates at the Sr. Manager level or above - Director-level preferred.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in inventory planning, merchandising, or related analytics/technology roles.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or Master’s in Supply Chain Management preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills, with proficiency in advanced Excel statistical functions.
  • Fluency with Google Suite and comfort working with large data sets.
  • Experience prototyping inventory optimization techniques and converting insights into scalable technology.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external partners to maximize opportunities and minimize risks.
  • Strong commitment to continuous improvement and operational excellence.
  • Proven ability to find, organize, and use data to draw actionable conclusions with minimal assumptions.
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment where established processes may not yet exist.

Preferred:

    • Insatiable curiosity and a desire to uncover insights that drive results.
    • Willingness to form and share informed points of view with peers and executives.
    • Ability to pivot quickly and thrive in a dynamic, startup-like environment.
    • Commitment to building scalable processes and industry-leading technology.
    • Exceptional presentation and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear recommendations.
    • Strong understanding of how forecasting impacts company priorities, objectives, and financial performance.
    • Bias toward leveraging technology for operational improvement.

Pay Range: $189,000 - $247,000

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

Requirements

The role

We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to support the continued growth and development of our engineering organisation.

The role combines people leadership, delivery management, process improvement, and hands-on software engineering. You will help engineers and teams perform at their best, while remaining close enough to the work to understand the practical challenges they face.

We expect approximately 20% to 40% of your time to be spent coding and building. This may include contributing to product development, creating internal tools, improving technical foundations, producing prototypes, or working alongside engineers on particularly difficult problems.

This is not a role for someone who has moved entirely away from software development. You should have at least 10 years of hands-on engineering experience and still enjoy building useful things.

Engineers you manage are receiving consistent, effective support and have greater clarity on expectations and their development. Performance concerns are being addressed fairly and promptly. Delivery is becoming more predictable without unnecessary process overhead.   • Engineering management practice: developing and improving how engineering management works at Vestd, including onboarding, succession planning, retention and ways of working
  • Hands-on engineering: contributing directly to software development for approximately 20% to 40% of your time, including production software, internal tools, prototypes or technical improvements that solve real problems
  • Technical credibility: coaching engineers, contributing to technical decisions, and maintaining the standards you expect from others by staying close to the work

What we’re looking for

Essential elements of this role

We cannot provide an exhaustive list of duties; additional duties may arise, but these will be core elements of this role.

  • At least 10 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with a strong track record of designing, building, shipping and maintaining production software.
  • Recent, practical development experience and the ability to contribute effectively to a modern codebase today, not just historically.
  • Proven experience managing software engineers in a growing technology organisation.
  • Strong technical judgement and the credibility to coach engineers and challenge technical decisions constructively.
  • Experience handling difficult conversations, performance concerns and career development.
  • Pragmatic approach to process: introduces structure where it helps, avoids bureaucracy where it does not.
  • Familiarity with PHP and Laravel, or experience with a comparable backend framework and a genuine willingness to work comfortably in that environment.
  • Impeccable attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • You must be comfortable with working in a remote-first environment

  • Experience managing engineering managers or technical leads
  • Experience working with distributed or remote engineering teams
  • Background in fintech, SaaS or a regulated environment
  • Experience helping an engineering organisation scale its management practices
  • Experience building internal tooling, prototypes or early-stage product

Culture fit

  • Thrives in a startup environment, ready to tackle diverse challenges with enthusiasm
  • Adaptable - open to taking on responsibilities beyond the defined role as needed
  • Passionate about contributing to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement

While the above describes the core responsibilities, this role may from time to time involve tasks beyond this list — as needed to respond to evolving business needs.

Benefits

What you can expect

Our culture is our backbone (BreatheHR named us one of the ‘Top 3 Companies in the UK for Company Culture’), and we take team happiness seriously.

Vestd strives to be as principled as possible. We’re all about Goal 8 of the United Nations ‘Sustainable Development Goals. This goal is about ‘Decent work and economic growth,’ and we consider it both with our external activities and internal workings.

We’ll do everything we can to help you grow in your role. In return, you’ll want to learn all about our industry and do all you can to help us continue leading it.

Vestd is remote-first, so in return for your commitment, diligence, and productivity, you’ll have a lot of autonomy during your working day. Some roles demand office hours (to fit our customers’ schedules), but we are committed to offering flexibility where possible.

Happy employees make for happy customers, as demonstrated in our five-star reviews. Vestd’s excellence has also been recognised by The Europas, The Fintech Awards London, The Hustle Awards, TechRound, and BusinessCloud’s Fintech50. See more about our awards here.

This could be the perfect opportunity if you’re an autonomous, self-driven individual passionate about contributing to a meaningful mission and value being part of a supportive, close-knit team.

Why work at Vestd?

Vestd is a great place to work. There are a range of benefits that you can look forward to as one of our folk (benefits vary depending on location):

  • This job is remote-first, although attendance is required twice yearly at our in-person get-togethers
  • A flexible environment to help you achieve the best work/life balance
  • An Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), of course! (After the qualifying period)
  • Monthly recognition scheme, where we celebrate our folk
  • Support with home working equipment*
  • A personal training and development budget to keep your career and professional growth on track
  • Private medical insurance (after the qualifying period)
  • Team retreats are held twice a year. They can include an overnight stay and focus on fun and team cohesion
  • Great team ethos, connect through regular team and company socials
  • 25 days annual leave plus one extra day per year of service (up to five days)

We’re looking for somebody with initiative who can focus on the business and their personal growth path. This is a great time to join our team, and it would be a superb role for the right person.

*At Vestd we provide our folk with the hardware and software required to support them in their role. As a remote-first business, we expect anyone applying for a job to have a suitable, quiet working space. You must have an appropriate desk/table and chair, with a reliable internet connection.

Equality, diversity and inclusion (EDI) at Vestd

At Vestd, we’re committed to building a respectful, inclusive, and diverse team. Trust is one of our core values; with that comes a commitment to fairness and transparency. We want to be open about our EDI efforts.

We wish to recruit people who are passionate about working in a diverse environment and who will support us to ensure that all colleagues are supported and included while working with us.

Research shows that while men are likely to apply when they meet 60% of a job’s requirements, women and individuals from underrepresented groups often apply only when they meet every criterion.

We understand the value of transferable skills and the unique perspectives that diversity brings. That’s why we encourage applications from candidates with unique strengths and experiences.


Our application process

We are accepting rolling applications for this role with no fixed end date - if you are interested in joining the Vestd folk, please apply when you can. We will respond to every applicant, but we may only screen some candidates depending on the number of applications received.

Our recruitment pipeline has a few stages, giving you plenty of opportunities to learn about Vestd as we take the time to find someone who is the best fit for the role. We aim to complete the selection process as efficiently as possible, and we are committed to making our candidate experience as inclusive as we can, so please get in touch with us if you require any information or support during the application process or need to ask for any adjustments.

A typical selection process might be:

  • Apply online
  • 20-minute screening call
  • 45-minute interview with the hiring manager and team member
  • Task-based assignment
  • 45-minute team cultural interview
  • 30-minute interview with the CEO

Please note that we record our interviews. These recordings are only viewed by the hiring team and once a role is filled, all recordings are deleted. We do not share any candidate information with anyone outside of Vestd at any time.

If you need any adjustments or support with your application, please let us know.

We are excited to receive your application.

When a role is filled, we will contact all other applicants to let them know.

This job is remote-first within India. You must be primarily India-based and eligible to work in the country.

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. We are hiring a motivated and detail-oriented Associate Counsel to join our Legal team.

As Associate Counsel, Product and Marketing, you will be a partner to your business colleagues and advise multiple Toast teams including product, engineering, marketing, compliance, and sales teams. You will learn Toast's products, strategies, and processes, and help the business identify and mitigate legal risk while helping Toast grow and evolve.

Our Legal & Compliance teams are primarily concentrated in Boston, New York, Washington D.C., San Francisco, and Chicago. Candidates residing in these areas will be prioritized, as they will benefit from closer proximity to colleagues and greater access to company resources and events.

  • Supporting the review of hardware product development, identifying legal risks in areas such as product labeling and regulatory certifications.
  • Supporting Toast's trademark portfolio development and enforcement efforts, including investigating potential third-party infringement, preparing cease-and-desist letters and takedown requests, and tracking matters through resolution.
