jobs.title: Développeur IBM i / System/36 - Télétravail - FS462
jobs.excerpt: Pourquoi rejoindre Fresche ?  Chez Fresche Solutions, nous ne nous contentons pas de maintenir les systèmes patrimoniaux : nous les transformons.
jobs.description:
Pourquoi rejoindre Fresche ? Chez Fresche Solutions, nous ne nous contentons pas de maintenir les systèmes patrimoniaux : nous les transformons. Depuis plus d'une décennie, nous sommes le partenaire de référence pour la modernisation et l'innovation sur IBM i. Nous offrons un véritable modèle de travail flexible (« travaillez d'où vous voulez » en Amérique du Nord), axé sur l'équilibre travail-vie personnelle et soutenu par une culture d'entreprise où nos valeurs ne sont pas de simples slogans, mais le moteur de chaque décision technique.

Sommaire du poste

Nous recherchons des développeurs IBM i System/36 d'expérience pour soutenir la modernisation d'applications patrimoniales IBM System/36. Les personnes retenues seront responsables de l'analyse des applications existantes, de la conversion des composants System/36 vers des technologies IBM i modernes, des activités d'assainissement de code (remediation) et de la validation fonctionnelle par des tests rigoureux.

Ce rôle exige une expertise technique approfondie de l'environnement System/36, d'OCL et de RPG II, ainsi qu'une expérience éprouvée dans la conversion d'applications patrimoniales vers CL et RPG IV (ILE RPG).

Responsabilités clés

  • Analyser les applications System/36 existantes, les séquences de travaux (job streams), les menus et l'enchaînement des écrans.
  • Convertir les programmes et processus OCL (Operational Control Language) vers le langage de contrôle IBM i (CL).
  • Convertir les applications RPG II vers RPG IV / ILE RPG tout en préservant la logique d'affaires et l'intégrité applicative.
  • Réviser et assainir le code converti afin d'améliorer la maintenabilité, la performance et la conformité aux standards de modernisation.
  • Réaliser les tests unitaires, les tests d'intégration et soutenir les activités d'acceptation utilisateur (UAT).
  • Investiguer, diagnostiquer et résoudre les anomalies relevées lors des phases d'assainissement et d'essais.
  • Moderniser les écrans et l'architecture des menus System/36.
  • Documenter le comportement des applications, les stratégies de conversion, les correctifs appliqués et les résultats des tests.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes techniques, les parties prenantes métier et les spécialistes en assurance qualité tout au long du cycle de modernisation.
  • Participer aux revues de code et contribuer aux meilleures pratiques techniques ainsi qu'au transfert de connaissances.

Compétences et expérience requises

Compétences techniques

  • Solide expérience pratique des environnements IBM System/36.
  • Vaste expérience avec le langage OCL (Operational Control Language).
  • Solide expérience en développement et maintenance RPG II.
  • Expérience concrète de conversion d'OCL vers CL.
  • Expérience concrète de conversion d'applications RPG II vers RPG IV / ILE RPG.
  • Expérience au sein d'initiatives de modernisation d'applications IBM i.
  • Maîtrise approfondie des traitements par lots (batch processing), de la gestion des files de travaux (job scheduling) et des architectures applicatives patrimoniales.
  • Expérience en assainissement de code post-conversion et en optimisation de la performance.
  • Expérience en planification et exécution de protocoles d'essais liés à la conversion.
  • Expérience dans la conversion et la modernisation d'écrans et de menus.

Compétences professionnelles

  • Fortes capacités d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes.
  • Aptitude à comprendre et traduire une logique d'affaires patrimoniale complexe en solutions IBM i modernes.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication orale et écrite.
  • Rigueur en documentation technique et sens aigu de l'organisation.
  • Capacité à travailler de façon autonome tout en s'intégrant efficacement au sein d'une équipe de projet.

Atouts

  • Expérience avec des outils de conversion automatique de code et dans l'assainissement post-conversion.
  • Expérience de modernisation d'applications IBM i de grande envergure dans les secteurs de la distribution, du commerce de gros, du manufacturier ou des ERP.
  • Familiarité avec les outils de développement IBM i, les systèmes de gestion de code source et les processus de gestion des changements.
  • Expérience active au sein de programmes d'envergure de transformation et de modernisation de systèmes patrimoniaux.

Livrables attendus

Les personnes retenues devront :

  • Mener à terme les conversions d'OCL vers CL.
  • Mener à terme les conversions de RPG II vers RPG IV / ILE RPG.
  • Assainir, optimiser et valider les applications converties.
  • Exécuter et documenter les campagnes d'essais.
  • Contribuer aux efforts de modernisation des interfaces (écrans et menus).
  • Rédiger la documentation technique et concevoir le matériel de transfert de connaissances.
  • Assurer l'atteinte des objectifs de livraison du programme de modernisation.

Exigences d'expérience

  • 7 ans et plus d'expérience en développement sur systèmes IBM Midrange.
  • 5 ans et plus d'expérience en développement et soutien sur System/36.
  • Expérience démontrée dans des projets de conversion et de modernisation applicative.
  • Bilan éprouvé de réalisations concrètes sur des mandats de conversion RPG et OCL en environnement IBM i.

Remarques complémentaires

Ce poste est spécifiquement axé sur la modernisation d'applications System/36 (OCL, RPG II, CL, RPG IV, assainissement de code, essais et conversion d'interfaces utilisateur). Une expérience portant sur la transformation avancée de formats source, la modernisation de bases de données relationnelles ou d'autres disciplines avancées n'est pas requise pour ce mandat.

About Foodsmart:
Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs.

Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money.

Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. This investment helps us expand our reach, particularly to low-income workers who are disproportionately affected by diet-related diseases.

At Foodsmart, our mission is to make nutritious food accessible and affordable for everyone, regardless of economic status. We are committed to a set of core values that shape our culture and work environment:

👥 Customer First - You start with the member and work backwards.
🚀 Make It Happen - You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards.
🤝 One Team - You collaborate with respect and commit as a group.

Working at Foodsmart means being part of a team that is passionate, supportive, and driven by a shared purpose. Join us in transforming the way people access and enjoy healthy food.

About the Role:
We're hiring a Staff Product Manager to own and scale Foodsmart's Food Access & Benefits platform — the product area that powers our expanding portfolio of food programs, health benefits management, and ancillary services that extend Foodsmart's impact beyond nutrition counseling. Health plans that service Medicaid and Medicare populations are increasingly looking to partners like Foodsmart who can manage the complexity of delivering complex and interconnected services associated with food benefit and food-as-medicine clinical intervention offerings to their members. Foodsmart is uniquely positioned to serve these client and member needs and we are aggressively building our product and service portfolio.

As the product lead for Food Access & Benefits platform, you'll be responsible for the systems and capabilities that underpin how members access food benefits, how employers and health plans administer those benefits, and how Foodsmart launches and scales new service lines in an environment with multiple stakeholders, regulatory considerations, and operational dependencies. You'll translate messy, multi-party operational complexity into clean, scalable product — launching new services that create real value for members & clients while driving impact on the business.

This role is ideal for a product leader who has launched products in operationally intensive domains — someone who can navigate the complexity of health benefits, food access programs, and partner ecosystems while bringing PM rigor and strategic clarity to a space that has historically been driven by operations alone. You’re also excited bringing new services to market, establishing product market fit, and driving meaningful impact for the business.

You will:

    Service Line Ownership & Product Execution

  • Own the roadmap for the Food Access & Benefits pod end-to-end — from discovery through launch and iteration — across food access programs, health benefits administration, and new service lines
  • Have the skills and capabilities to (quickly) become an expert in the Food & Food Benefits ecosystem through research, interviews and building relationships with thought leaders.
  • Translate complex operational workflows and multi-party requirements into scalable, well-defined product capabilities — building for repeatability rather than one-off implementation
  • Design and advocate for the member experience – turning something that can often times feel logistically burdensome into a moments of delight
  • Partner with Engineering, Partnerships, and Operations to define the systems architecture that allows Foodsmart to configure, launch, and manage benefits programs at scale across diverse client types
  • Balance the urgency of client-driven timelines with the discipline of building platform capabilities that compound over time
    • Client & Operational Collaboration
  • Design and own the product systems that configure, launch, and manage benefits programs for members and clients
  • Build the tools and workflows that Client Success, Partnerships, and Clinical Operations rely on to run food access and benefits programs
  • Partner with product marketing and commercial teams to shape go-to-market for new services

    • Platform & Strategic Contribution

  • Set the strategy for the Food Access & Benefits pod with full autonomy, while maintaining tight alignment with the CPO and cross-functional leadership
  • Advocate for operational scalability and configurability across all product decisions — building Foodsmart's capacity to offer more services to more clients with less implementation overhead
  • Influence adjacent pods and platform architecture to ensure food access and benefits capabilities are embedded appropriately in the broader member journey
  • Contribute to cross-pod planning and portfolio prioritization, bringing the service line and operational lens into broader roadmap discussions

You are:

  • Operationally fluent — you understand how complex, multi-party service programs actually run, and you build products that make them more reliable and scalable, not just more feature-rich
  • A structured problem-solver who brings PM rigor to operationally heavy domains — you document requirements clearly and manage dependencies explicitly
  • Comfortable with ambiguity in new service areas — you can define the problem space, identify what you don't know, and make progress with incomplete information
  • A trusted partner to operational and commercial stakeholders — you earn credibility by understanding their world deeply and delivering solutions that actually reduce their burden
  • Data-driven with strong execution instincts — you know when to move fast and when to slow down and validate, and you use metrics to tell the difference
  • Collaborative and low-ego: you build strong relationships across a complex stakeholder landscape and know when to lead versus when to align
  • A passion for addressing the chronic challenges associated with providing low income populations with proper food access and nutrition programs

You have:

  • 7+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time spent in B2B or B2B2C environments where you owned operationally complex product areas
  • A track record of launching new products or service lines end-to-end — not just iterating on existing features, but standing up net-new capabilities in complex operational environments
  • Direct experience working alongside Implementation, Operations, or Client Success teams to build products that real operational users depend on
  • Experience building and launching products in close partnership with commercial and go-to-market teams — including enablement, rollout planning, and post-launch iteration
  • Experience in AI-enabled product development processes and tools
  • Nice-to-Haves:
  • Experience with benefits management platforms, employer health benefits, or government health program operations
  • Exposure to food retail, food ordering, or supply chain partnerships in a digital health or consumer health context

About our benefits and perks:

✅ Remote-First Company

✅ Unlimited PTO

✅ Flexible & remote location

✅ Healthcare Coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)
✅ 401k & bonus

✅ Registered Dietitian Sessions

jobs.title: Strike Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Thanks for your interest in Oklo!  We are searching for a Strike Engineer to join our engineering team.
jobs.description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Strike Engineer to join our engineering team.

Position Description

The Strike Engineer is a senior, highly adaptable engineer who reports to the Engineering Strike Team Lead and takes ownership of Oklo's highest-priority, most ambiguous technical problems. This person moves between programs, builds context quickly, reduces problems to first principles, and stays accountable through verified resolution. Depending on the need, the Strike Engineer may serve as a hands-on individual contributor, technical lead, or interim manager. They establish a durable path, help staff the work, transfer ownership to the right long-term team, and then take on the next priority.

Specific responsibilities may include:

  • Embed in high-priority engineering programs and rapidly develop a working understanding of the system, constraints, stakeholders, and current failure modes.
  • Define problems from first principles by separating facts from assumptions, identifying the governing physics and interfaces, and reducing uncertainty to testable questions.
  • Work hands-on across design, analysis, prototyping, testing, manufacturing, software and data, systems integration, and field execution as the problem requires.
  • Establish a practical execution plan with owners, decision points, schedule, risks, and objective completion criteria, then drive the work through verified closure.
  • Diagnose technical and operational failures using data, experiments, direct observation, and disciplined root-cause analysis.
  • Make sound engineering tradeoffs under uncertainty while accounting for safety, regulatory requirements, quality, cost, schedule, operability, and manufacturability.
  • Temporarily lead a project or team when needed by clarifying priorities, coordinating cross-functional work, removing blockers, and communicating decisions and risks.
  • Help recruit and onboard permanent owners, then transfer stable scope with clear documentation, open risks, decisions, and next steps.
  • Create reusable tools, processes, design standards, or technical documentation when they will prevent recurring problems or accelerate future work.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, physics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 or more years of experience solving complex engineering problems from definition through design, execution, validation, and handoff.
  • Technical breadth across multiple engineering domains and deep expertise in at least one area such as mechanical, electrical, controls, software, systems, manufacturing, test, thermal-fluid, structural, or nuclear engineering.
  • Demonstrated ability to reason from first principles, challenge unsupported assumptions, and validate conclusions with analysis, tests, or operating data.
  • Hands-on ability to use the tools needed to move work forward, which may include modeling, CAD, calculations, test equipment, scripting, data analysis, or prototyping.
  • Experience leading cross-functional technical work without relying on formal authority, including stepping into temporary management responsibilities when needed.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including concise decision records, technical plans, risk summaries, and executive-level updates.

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Experience in the nuclear industry, advanced reactor development, commercial power generation, national laboratories, or another safety-critical energy environment.
  • Experience delivering hardware or integrated systems in a regulated, high-consequence, or quality-controlled environment.
  • Experience starting a new program, recovering a stalled project, or resolving a persistent technical or operational problem.
  • Experience with hardware-software integration, automation, controls, data systems, or test infrastructure.
  • Experience hiring, developing, or onboarding engineers and transferring work to a durable long-term owner.

Competencies

We are looking for a Strike Engineer who is:

  • Able to move across systems, mechanical, electrical, controls, software and data, manufacturing, and test work, while recognizing when specialist depth is required.
  • Able to change altitude quickly, from detailed technical work to project leadership and temporary people management, without losing clarity or accountability.
  • Passionate about clean energy
  • An optimist at heart
  • Passionate about making advanced fission a reality
  • Willing and able to learn quickly
  • Willing to think differently and do things in new ways
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment
  • Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving while not leaning only on what has been done before
  • Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems
  • An excellent writer who can write in a modern active voice, so make your cover letter compelling and write it well!
  • Able to communicate technical content and results verbally

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

About Oklo travel requirements:

Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.

About Oklo compensation:

Salary: $120,000-$170,000

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, bonuses, competitive pay, 401(k), health insurance (with employer contribution), HSA, FSA, flexible work hours, wellness credits, and other benefits.

This position may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control laws. Only applicants who meet the definition of a U.S. person under applicable laws may be eligible.

About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

#CHOP: Oklo’s Values
Collaboration: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.
Humility: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.
Ownership: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.
Pathfinding: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.

Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.

Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer

Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. Please be cautious of anyone claiming to represent Oklo who does not contact you from an official Oklo email address.

All legitimate communications from our recruiting team— including application updates, interview requests, and job offers — will come exclusively from an @oklo.com email. Oklo will never ask for sensitive personal information, payments, or account credentials during the hiring process.

If you receive suspicious outreach or have concerns about the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Oklo, please contact us through the official channels listed on our website.

About Aspira

For more than 40 years, Aspira has been the market-leading provider of software and services that help public agencies protect natural and cultural resources while making them accessible for all. Our platform supports everything from campground reservations to hunting licenses, helping millions of people discover, enjoy, and care for the outdoors.

We share our client partners’ mission: to steward resources for future generations, create opportunities for genuine enjoyment of the outdoors today, and expand access so more people can experience its benefits.

Aspira is transforming its technology and service model to give agencies more capacity and insight—streamlined tools, smarter automation, and better connections with their communities. Our goal is simple: make it easier for our clients to conserve what matters most and for their customers to enjoy it to the fullest.

FYI

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Aspira is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas, now or in the future.

As part of our hiring process, candidates may be required to complete an identity verification check conducted through Checkr, a secure third-party service provider. This step helps confirm the authenticity of applicant identities and supports a fair, secure hiring process for all candidates.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this notice and consent to the potential inclusion of an identity verification step as part of the interview process.

The Ideal Candidate

The Client Delivery Project Manager (PM) is a versatile, technically fluent, client-focused project management role responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering work across the full client lifecycle. This includes RFPs, contracting, implementations, platform transitions, production migrations, renewals, and ad hoc client initiatives.

As part of Aspira's PMO, Client Delivery Project Managers act as the operational backbone for client-facing work, partnering closely with Account Management, Product, Engineering, Transition, Implementation, Legal, Finance, and Leadership. They bring clarity to complex efforts, reduce risk during periods of change, and continuously improve how Aspira delivers for clients.

Key Responsibilities

Implementation & Platform Migration Management

  • Own a variety of implementation projects end-to-end, including feature implementations for existing clients, new client implementations, new platform migrations, and client transition-out projects.
  • Lead project kickoffs and maintain a regular governance cadence, including status calls, risk and issue tracking, and executive updates, to keep stakeholders aligned throughout each project.
  • Maintain detailed project plans, timelines, milestones, and dependency tracking across all implementation, migration, and transition-out work.
  • Identify risks, blockers, and decision points early; escalate and drive resolution to maintain momentum.
  • Manage change requests when project work expands beyond the signed Scope of Work, keeping the client and internal teams aligned on the impact to scope and timeline.
  • Coordinate end-user training, communication, and enablement materials so client teams feel confident and equipped to adopt new features, platforms, or transitions at go-live.
  • Own user acceptance testing coordination and go-live readiness sign-off, including a post-launch hypercare period to confirm stability before formal project close.
  • Ensure every implementation, migration, or transition-out project is organized, predictable, and client-centered.

End-to-End Client Lifecycle Management

  • Create a cohesive, consistent client experience across the full lifecycle, from RFP through implementation, migration, renewal, and (if needed) transition-out, coordinating with Aspira's internal teams throughout.
  • Serve as a continuity anchor for clients, ensuring smooth handoffs between lifecycle phases and teams.
  • Partner closely with Account Management to translate contracts, statements of work, and commitments into actionable, sequenced project plans, and maintain a strong working relationship with the client partnership team throughout.
  • Support ad hoc client initiatives by applying consistent project management practices to maintain predictability and quality.

RFP & Proposal Execution

  • Lead RFPs as formal projects, responsible for planning, sequencing, and execution.
  • Coordinate cross-functional contributors (Account Management, Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance, Leadership).
  • Assign writers and reviewers, track inputs and dependencies, and manage deadlines.
  • Review and edit responses for clarity, consistency, and alignment with client needs.
  • Plan and coordinate demos, including scoping, scripting, scheduling, and readiness tracking.
  • Continuously improve RFP processes through templates, standards, and repeatable workflows.

Revenue Growth & Upsell

  • Support upsell of previously released modules within the existing client base, partnering with Account Management to identify adoption gaps and build the case for expansion.
  • Create and maintain project templates for enabling existing modules, so features that have already been built can be turned on quickly without a full new implementation cycle.
  • Track module adoption across the client base and use that data to help prioritize which upsell opportunities to pursue next.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Act as a central point of coordination across Product, Engineering, Implementation, Transition, Account Management, and external partners.
  • Coordinate with external vendors and third-party partners involved in implementation or migration work, ensuring their deliverables stay aligned with the overall project timeline and scope.
  • Take ownership of resolving cross-team conflicts in priority or timing.
  • Maintain clarity around ownership, expectations, and timelines across all workstreams.

Documentation, Standards & Operational Excellence

  • Document end-to-end client lifecycle and implementation workflows for internal reference and onboarding.
  • Establish and maintain templates, playbooks, timelines, and best practices.
  • Maintain accurate, current project documentation, client records, and delivery artifacts so every project stays organized and easy to hand off.
  • Follow Aspira's PMO-established standards, templates, and processes, while contributing frontline project experience back into the PMO to continuously refine and enhance those methods.
  • Drive continuous improvement across internal workflows and cross-functional collaboration.

Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, cross-functional projects such as RFPs, implementations, migrations, or transitions.
  • Strong organizational, documentation, and process improvement skills.
  • Comfortable coordinating across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Clear, confident communicator with strong client-facing skills.
  • Adaptable, emotionally intelligent, and able to thrive in an evolving environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to quickly learn new technical concepts and systems, and to take ownership without waiting for direction.
  • Prior experience implementing or supporting SaaS platforms (implementation, onboarding, or platform migration work).
  • Working knowledge of data migration concepts: environment tiers (DEV/QA/UAT/PROD), data validation and reconciliation, cutover, and rollback planning.
  • Familiarity with the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including sprint or release cycles, backlog and ticket management, and QA/testing phases, sufficient to plan around and coordinate effectively with Product and Engineering.
  • Comfort reading and translating technical documentation, such as tickets, release notes, and migration plans, for non-technical stakeholders.

Desired Hardware and Software Competencies

  • Proficiency in Monday.com or an equivalent project management platform for day-to-day project management.
  • Proficiency in Jira, used to track engineering-owned work such as tickets and releases.
  • Experience with Confluence, Microsoft 365, or similar tools.

Desired Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • PMP, CAPM, or equivalent project management certification.
  • 3-5 years of project management, program management, or client delivery experience (SaaS, GovTech, services, or large-scale change initiatives preferred).
  • Exposure to system implementations or platform migrations requiring careful documentation and cross-team coordination.
  • Experience supporting RFP responses, proposal writing, or account growth and upsell initiatives.
  • Experience working within a PMO or standardized project governance structure.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum practices; Scrum Master or related certification a plus.

jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Marketing Analytics Director to lead the evolution of our marketing data stack and raise the analytical rigor of the entire marketing organization. This is a critical role for a builder-practitioner who works at the intersection of Data Science, Marketing Strategy, GTM, and AI Operations. You won't just report on the funnel. You will build the systems that make every analyst on this team sharper, including the AI agents themselves.

As the Marketing Analytics Director , you will be the lead architect of our data-driven growth engine, connecting high-level strategy with advanced technical execution. You will move beyond traditional reporting to build a self-sustaining marketing ecosystem, leveraging Google BigQuery, Grafana, and agentic AI to create a unified source of truth and a culture of analytical rigor. Your mandate is to move the needle on demand generation across the entire marketing funnel, while raising the standard for how analytical work gets produced, challenged, and shipped across the org.

You will architect a dual-track target-setting framework that balances high-velocity top-of-funnel growth with deep-funnel quality, ensuring GTM resources are directed toward high-converting user cohorts optimized for Grafana adoption and long-term retention.

You will be expected to engineer the underlying data schemas, design predictive models, and implement the BI frameworks that shape our global GTM strategy. We are looking for a technical expert who can translate complex data into clear executive-level direction and who proactively builds systems that prevent AI-generated noise from drowning out actual signals.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Strategic GTM Partnership: Serve as the primary strategic partner to the GTM Leadership team (VP of Demand Gen, VP of Regional and Events, Head of Marketing Ops, CMO, Revenue Operations, Sales leadership and more), translating complex data into a clear roadmap for demand generation and revenue growth.
  • Dual-Track Target Setting: Architect and own a sophisticated forecasting framework that balances top-of-funnel volume with high-intent lead quality, optimized for Grafana Cloud conversion and retention.
  • Predictive Modeling and ROI: Develop and maintain machine learning models (Attribution, MMM, LTV) to predict campaign impact and steer budget allocation toward the highest-ROI channels.
  • Data Warehouse Architecture: Oversee the structure of marketing data within Google BigQuery, ensuring a scalable single source of truth that connects product usage data with marketing touchpoints.
  • Causal Inference and Inflection Hunting: Move beyond descriptive analytics to perform causal inference and predictive trend analysis. When the data shows an anomaly, whether a 3-month spike, a regional dip, or a campaign that overperformed, isolate the window and dig in.
  • Executive Storytelling: Transform technical data outputs into clear, compelling narratives for the executive team and board. Deliver a succinct read and go deep where pushed.

Utilizing AI and Automation

  • Agentic Insights: Deploy LLM-powered agents (Claude Code, MCP-based tooling, or comparable) to monitor BigQuery datasets and automatically flag quality shifts in the funnel before they impact revenue.
  • Autonomous Workflows: Implement orchestration patterns (N8N, custom MCP servers, or equivalent) to build self-healing data pipelines and automated responses to market signals, such as automated spend shifts based on conversion anomalies.
  • Predictive Quality Scoring: Build and deploy AI-driven scoring models that separate high-value potential users from low-signal volume, helping Sales and Marketing prioritize effectively.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • 8+ years in Marketing Analytics, GTM Strategy, or Data Science, with at least 2 years in a lead architect capacity (IC track or player-coach; people management not required) within a high-growth SaaS or PLG environment.
  • Demonstrated history as a force multiplier. You can point to specific tooling, rituals, evaluator systems, or frameworks you built that made other analysts or the broader org measurably better. A portfolio of dashboards you personally produced is not sufficient.
  • Data Science and Engineering: Mastery of SQL and Python required. Deep experience architecting data environments in Google BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar warehouses.
  • Hands-on AI fluency as a builder, not a user. You have built and shipped agentic systems with Claude Code, MCP, or comparable tools. You understand where LLMs fail and how to design around those limitations. You have built evaluator agents, prompt-grading systems, or analytical quality tooling in production.
  • Automation Proficiency: Hands-on experience building complex logic and integrations using N8N, custom API orchestration, or MCP-based tooling.
  • Visualization and BI: Advanced proficiency in modern data stack visualization tools (Grafana, Looker, Tableau) to build executive-grade dashboards.
  • Strategic Acumen: Proven ability to create structure in highly ambiguous environments and build target-setting frameworks from scratch.
  • MarTech Ecosystem: Deep familiarity with connectivity between Salesforce, marketing automation, and product-led data streams.
  • Executive presence with experience presenting to executive and board audiences, including sound judgment about what data is and isn't ready to share up the chain.

Bonus Points For

  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative field (Data Science, CS, Statistics, Business Analytics). MBA or MS in Data Science is a significant plus.

Technology: PeopleSoft FSCM | PeopleTools | Oracle Database | WebLogic | Tuxedo | Linux | OCI/AWS
Focus: Enterprise Administration | Database Engineering | Automation | Upgrades | Integration | High Availability

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior PeopleSoft Administrator / Oracle DBA to manage, support, and modernize enterprise PeopleSoft FSCM Production and Non-Production environments.

This is a highly technical role spanning the PeopleSoft application stack, middleware, Linux infrastructure, Oracle databases, integrations, automation, and cloud environments. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining highly available, secure, and high-performing environments while supporting upgrades, migrations, implementations, and ongoing operational needs.

The ideal candidate brings deep hands-on experience with PeopleSoft Administration and Oracle Database, combined with strong knowledge of automation, disaster recovery, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise application integrations.

Responsibilities:

PeopleSoft Administration

  • Install, configure, administer, and support PeopleSoft FSCM environments across Production, Non-Production, and implementation environments.
  • Administer PeopleTools, PUM Images, Application Designer, Integration Broker, Process Scheduler, and related PeopleSoft components.
  • Perform PeopleTools, PUM, application, and database upgrades.
  • Use Deployment Packages (DPK) for PeopleSoft installation, configuration, and environment management.
  • Manage multiple PUM Images and coordinate application maintenance activities.
  • Perform environment refreshes, cloning, configuration, troubleshooting, and post-maintenance validation.
  • Support major PeopleSoft upgrades and infrastructure transitions, including analysis of customizations through compare reports.
  • Monitor and maintain application health and performance across the PeopleSoft technology stack.

Oracle Database Administration

  • Serve as a senior Oracle DBA supporting PeopleSoft FSCM and related enterprise applications.
  • Install, configure, patch, upgrade, and maintain Oracle Database environments.
  • Support modern Oracle Database releases, including 19c and newer versions where applicable.
  • Administer Oracle RAC, RMAN, Data Guard, and Oracle Enterprise Manager (OEM).
  • Design and maintain backup, recovery, high-availability, and disaster-recovery solutions.
  • Perform database performance tuning, including:
    • SQL optimization
    • Execution-plan analysis
    • Memory tuning
    • Resource utilization
    • Database health monitoring
  • Apply Oracle Critical Patch Updates (CPU), Release Updates (RU), and other security and maintenance fixes.
  • Perform database exports/imports, cloning, environment refreshes, and recovery activities.
  • Monitor database capacity, performance, availability, and storage utilization.

PeopleSoft Middleware & Application Infrastructure

  • Administer and optimize WebLogic, Tuxedo, Process Scheduler, and PeopleSoft application servers.
  • Configure, maintain, and monitor PeopleSoft web and application server environments.
  • Troubleshoot infrastructure and application issues involving:
    • Application Engine
    • Integration Broker
    • SQR
    • Process Scheduler
    • Change Assistant
    • WebLogic
    • Tuxedo

jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

You'll lead GitLab's Dedicated Infrastructure team, combining hands-on technical leadership with team development. Working with the team's Product Manager, you'll balance delivery speed and quality, guide architecture decisions, and lead the team through incidents.

You'll demonstrate ideas through proofs of concept, give team members meaningful feedback, and use data to make prioritization and risk decisions.

What you’ll do

  • Partner with the team's Product Manager to set clear priorities and deliver with quality and speed.
  • Maintain at least 99.9% availability for Dedicated infrastructure, strengthen security, and automate operations to support more tenants at scale.
  • Give your team clear direction and meaningful feedback, and build shared ownership of development and operations.
  • Improve the platforms and tools your team owns so feature implementers can manage their services in production through self-service workflows.
  • Recruit, onboard, and develop productive team members, supporting their growth and accountability.
  • Lead by example with proofs of concept and artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted approaches. Simplify processes and automate repetitive manual work.
  • Model effective incident management, lead timely resolution and escalation, and document and teach best practices across GitLab.
  • Use data to prioritize work, quantify impact, and manage risk and technical debt. Explain technical trade-offs to stakeholders to support their decisions.

What you’ll bring

  • A track record of building and owning large-scale distributed services, with the technical depth to evaluate architecture and guide technical strategy.
  • Experience with fleet management, Terraform, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and automated provisioning at a scale of 20 or more clusters.
  • Experience owning services with 99.99% availability service-level objectives (SLOs), and an understanding of the operational practices needed to sustain them.
  • Experience using AI tools to improve team productivity, with lessons learned from both successes and missteps.
  • Experience building and managing accountable, high-performing teams, including addressing underperformance and making difficult performance decisions when needed.

We build and operate the large-scale distributed infrastructure for GitLab Dedicated, our hosted software as a service (SaaS) platform. Our work centers on availability, security, fleet management, and automated provisioning across tenants. We also build self-service platforms and tools that enable feature implementers to own their services in production.

At GitLab, our mission is simple: to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world. We collaborate asynchronously, with autonomy, accountability, and transparency guiding how we work.

jobs.title: Corporate FP&A Manager
jobs.excerpt: Two Chairs is building a new kind of mental health system based on the idea that the status quo isn’t good enough.
jobs.description:
Two Chairs is building a new kind of mental health system based on the idea that the status quo isn’t good enough. Industry-best clinician experiences, better client outcomes, groundbreaking innovation, and access to the highest quality care are how we’ll raise the bar for the entire industry. With that, we're excited and honored to have been recognized as a 2025 Great Place to Work and 2025 Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare.

One of our company values is "Embrace Differences" and diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging are the principles guiding how we build our business and teams. We encourage interested candidates from all backgrounds to apply even if they don't think they meet some expectations of the role.

About the roleAs Two Chairs enters its next phase of rapid growth, we’re looking to add a FP&A Manager to our dynamic Finance team. You’ll work closely with the Head of FP&A, CFO, Controller, company leadership, and partners across our marketplace operations, talent acquisition, demand generation, and clinical teams to drive meaningful business impact and power our company-wide forecasting & planning. In helping the company scale rapidly and efficiently, you’ll build and improve systems and processes, setting the company up to support its rapid growth plans for years to come. If you have great attention to detail, love building process & systems, and are highly analytical, structured, and collaborative, this is your role!

You'll be responsible for leading headcount planning & budgeting, managing holistic expense & cash forecasting, supporting strategic initiatives (including the path to profitability), and developing highly scalable financial foundations.

Core Areas of Responsibility

  • Lead planning, budgeting & reporting (50%)
    • Collaborate with key stakeholders to develop accurate forecasts and financial models for all headcount & vendor investments, and establish core reporting packages for holistic functional and departmental budgets.
    • Lead the bi-annual corporate budgeting process, ensuring visibility and accuracy into assumptions for costs across all departments.
    • Support Leadership & Finance Team visibility into resource allocation, ensuring spend is aligned with financial targets and short- and long-term strategic priorities.
    • Partner with Accounting to provide timely analysis & insights into period-over-period and actual vs. forecast performance.
  • Design and build financial processes that are scalable and sustainable (30%)
    • Continuously evaluate our financial processes and systems: identifying areas for improvement, implementing best practices and recommending enhancements to streamline financial operations.
    • Scope, roadmap, and implement financial planning software (Pigment, Adaptive) that improves efficiency and visibility for plan setting & ongoing variance reporting.
    • Establish and rollout policies & processes to enable seamless headcount and vendor management.
  • Partner with People, Engineering, Product, Business Development, Operations, and other cross-functional partners to enable better business decisions (20%)
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for budgeting across the organization.
    • Work closely with other teams to build ROI-based business cases, and evaluate tradeoffs for new investments, aligning team needs and company priorities.

Impact and Success Indicators

Where you’ll make an impact in the first 90 days:

  • Serve as the primary budget lead for Two Chairs to various external stakeholders and vendors; manage and organize contracts, renewals, and responses in a timely and accurate manner
  • Partner with the key cross-functional stakeholders, such as People, Operations, and technical teams, to build effective, efficient systems for the company’s long-term growth; conduct due diligence and analysis on new systems and processes as appropriate
  • Partner with Accounting to deliver cash management and bank reviews
  • Support the finance team and broader organization with ad hoc projects

Where you’ll make an impact in the first year:

  • Lead a regular cadence of end-to-end budget reporting and analysis to provide better visibility for key stakeholders
  • Embed with the finance team to improve company margin by identifying areas of opportunity to build in efficiencies, aligning spend by department to revenue and growth outcomes
  • Identify, plan, and implement a robust planning system that can scale rapidly with our business
  • Manage and develop our Senior Financial Analyst, as a key contributor to a high performing FP&A team
  • Build a long-term plan for Planning & Budgeting at Two Chairs, including team growth and tech enablement, to support our 3+ year growth plans

You’ll be successful if you have:

  • 4+ years of experience in a FP&A, financial operations, or other highly analytical role at a high-growth startup/tech company, including 2+ years of people management
  • Knowledge of financial systems and processes, and an eye toward continuous improvement; exceptional attention to detail and a sense of pride in driving operational excellence
  • Experience with budgeting, vendor management, expense forecast vs. actuals reporting, and/or data tools
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple projects at once and build thoughtful, structured processes from the ground up
  • Adaptable and comfortable operating in fast-paced environments with high ambiguity and limited structure; bias toward action to create and build processes in a scalable way
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate actionable conclusions to various stakeholders
  • Highly collaborative with a team-first mentality, willing to roll up sleeves and dive in where needed; comfortable wearing many hats and managing competing priorities
  • Desire to work in a high-growth, mission-driven startup environment

Compensation & Benefits

The offer range is dependent on qualifications and experience. New hires can reasonably expect an offer between $145,000 and $161,000.

Additional perks and benefits:

  • Equity in a high-growth start-up
  • Paid time off, including nine paid holidays and an additional Winter Office Closure from Christmas Day (Observed) through New Year's Day
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) Retirement savings options
  • One-time $200 Work from Home reimbursement
  • Annual $1,000 Productivity & Wellness Stipend to support your personal and professional goals
  • Annual $500 subsidized company contribution to your healthcare FSA or HSA
  • Paid parental leave

Outreach Notice to Applicants

We are thrilled that you’re interested in joining our team! To ensure a consistent and equitable hiring process for all candidates, we kindly ask that you refrain from reaching out to current employees regarding the role, your application, or the interview process. Our talent acquisition team is committed to carefully reviewing all applications and will reach out directly if they decide to move forward.

If you need a reasonable accommodation, please let your recruiter know so our People Team can assist you.

All applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Responsibilities

Job Description Summary

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT THE WORKThe Course Builder takes a finished, approved course guide and builds the live course in the client's learning management system.
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE WORK

The Course Builder takes a finished, approved course guide and builds the live course in the client's learning management system. This is the step where a design document becomes something students can actually use, and it is more craft than data entry: consistency, accessibility and behaviour under real conditions all get decided here.

Work is contracted per course. Most builds are Canvas or Brightspace.

Most of the work is independent, but it is not isolated. You will work closely with the instructional designer who wrote the guide, and you should expect to be on a call with the client from time to time.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Build

Build the course in the LMS from the approved course guide: modules, pages, assignments, quizzes, discussions, files and navigation, following the client's template and structure.

Work in batches. Most courses are built in two or more passes rather than all at once, so you will be building one batch while the designer is still finishing the next.

Package and embed interactive content, including SCORM and xAPI packages from Articulate Rise or Storyline, and H5P activities built directly in the LMS.

Apply client branding and keep it consistent: banners, icons, page structure, naming conventions and formatting.

Check accessibility: alt text on images and graphics, colour contrast, heading structure, reading order, keyboard navigation and accessible media controls. Remediating accessibility defects in your own build is part of the work, not a change order.

Test the build. Confirm links work, quizzes score correctly, embedded content renders across devices and browsers, and nothing is left unpublished that should be live, or published that should not.

Meetings and collaboration

Attend client calls and project meetings as necessary, or as stated in your contract. On several of our projects the client reviews the built course live, and the builder is the person who can answer what was done and why.

Process

Work the fixes list with the designer and the lead. Fixes get logged in one place, not by email or chat, and you confirm each one before sign off.

Keep your build status current in the project system so the PM and the designer can see where a course actually is.

Flag what you cannot resolve. If the course guide is ambiguous or an activity cannot be built as specified, raise it rather than guessing or quietly leaving it out.

HOW THE ENGAGEMENT WORKS

Contracted per course under a work for hire agreement. Deliverables are owned by the client.

Paid a fixed fee per course at defined milestones, on acceptance. Not hourly, no timesheet.

A defined number of fix rounds is included in the fee. The count and the turnaround we expect from you are stated in your contract. Fixes arising from your own build errors are not a separate round.

Build work is calendar driven and often compressed. A batch lands and the build window is short, because the client's review date does not move when the designer is late.

You will be given access to the client's LMS, which may come with its own rules. Some clients provide guest or limited accounts, and we will tell you what you can and cannot do in them.

You will work in our systems too: Google Workspace, Slack, and the project system.

We use AI assisted build tooling on some projects. You do not need to bring it, but you do need to be willing to work within the process we use, including our rules about client content and external tools.

We expect a reply to email and Slack within one business day during an active build window.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING

Hands-on experience building courses in Canvas or Brightspace, including quizzes, assignments and graded items.

Experience with SCORM or xAPI packages and how they behave once uploaded into an LMS.

Real attention to detail. This role is noticed when it is done badly and invisible when it is done well.

Working knowledge of accessibility requirements (WCAG 2.1 AA) and how to meet them in an LMS rather than in theory.

The discipline to follow a template and a build guide exactly, and to ask when something is unclear.

Availability for occasional scheduled calls, including client-facing ones, during US business hours.

Candour about what you have not built. If you have never built an H5P activity or never packaged a Storyline file into Brightspace, tell us in the application. We will still want to talk to you. Finding out mid-project is the problem.

NICE TO HAVE

H5P experience, particularly interactive content types built natively in Canvas: matching, sorting, drag and drop, interactive video and branching scenarios. This is a current gap on our team and is genuinely valuable.

Articulate Rise or Storyline, enough to publish and troubleshoot a package rather than to author from scratch.

Basic HTML and CSS for cases where the LMS editor is not enough.

Experience with Cidi Labs DesignPLUS or similar Canvas design tools.

Experience using AI assisted build tooling.

Experience finishing a build someone else started.

startup.

CharterUP is transforming the $365 billion global group transportation and mobility market with an AI native platform that powers modern charter, shuttle, and emerging autonomous vehicle operations. Trusted by many Fortune 500 companies, CharterUP connects enterprises, institutions, and event organizers with thousands of vehicles nationwide, while increasingly serving as the operating system for large scale shuttle and transit programs across airports, campuses, industrial sites, and major events.

Through real time availability, transparent pricing, intelligent routing, and AI driven dispatch and optimization, CharterUP replaces a fragmented and opaque industry with automation, accountability, and scale.

Why Join Us

  • Growth Opportunities: As a hyper growth company and one of the fastest-growing companies recognized by Inc., there’s no better time to join our dynamic, growth-stage organization.

  • Funding and Stability: Our $60 million Series A funding was just the start—we’re poised for even greater expansion, and you can be part of this exciting journey. CharterUp has achieved this growth profitability and efficiently, ensuring long-term stability.

About the Role

Title: Revenue Operations Associate

Reports to: Director of Revenue Operations

Location: Remote, US

We are searching for a Revenue Operations Associate who loves translating big picture strategic goals into actionable tooling, automation, and analysis outputs. This is a great role for someone who wants to shape a rapidly-scaling B2B and B2C marketplace business and who enjoys learning new technologies on the job. We’re looking for a transversal thinker who is curious and intrepid.

You’ll be a driving force behind ensuring our multi-segment Sales team can push the pace, looking each day to improve their efficiency and effectiveness, and to ensure management visibility into key metrics and trends. You will also build and refine the automations that intelligently score and assign leads and accounts, ensure smooth client handoffs between internal teams, streamline proposal-handling, and ensure we can use leading indicators to make decisions proactively.

Reporting to the Director of Revenue Operations, this role is critical to helping us ensure alignment across our Sales segments, Finance, Marketing, and Partner and Service Operations.

What You’ll Do

  • Collaborate with sales unit leaders and executive leadership to define, document, and manage the end-to-end revenue process, identifying bottlenecks and areas for optimization.
  • Design, implement, and document standardized processes for lead-to-opportunity, opportunity-to-close, and post-sales activities.
  • As a secondary administrator for our revenue stack (centered on Salesforce and Outreach), configure and customize our instance, lead projects to enhance integrations with other services, and ensure data integrity. Contribute to the revenue stack tech roadmap, ensuring that we can stay nimble as we continue to scale.
  • Develop and maintain key performance indicator (KPI) dashboards and reporting across Sales, Account Management, Support and other revenue-related functions to provide actionable insights into revenue performance.
  • Own monthly commission calculation, data review process and Cost of Sales analysis.
  • Analyze and assist in setting annual and quarterly revenue targets, forecasting, and compensation plan design.
  • Provide regular forecasting support, working closely with sales leadership and finance to improve forecast accuracy and pipeline visibility.
  • Conduct deep-dive analysis on pipeline health, sales productivity, campaign effectiveness, and customer churn/retention.

What You’ll Bring

  • A bachelor's degree, and 4+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Business Operations, preferably within a B2B SaaS environment. Experience in a marketplace business is a plus.
  • Enviable analytical skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations. Advanced Excel/GSheets skills and some experience with SQL.
  • Expert-level proficiency as a CRM Administrator (Salesforce required; certification not required), and demonstrated experience managing an integrated tech stack, including sales engagement (we use Outreach), marketing and process automation, AI, and other analytics products.
  • Superb communication and personal organization, with a knack for helping translate concepts and breaking down broad needs into actionable projects. You’re able to recommend solutions and then bring them to life.

Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.
Our vision: A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.

About the Role:

You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. We’re looking for a Group Product Manager to lead Wrike’s Core unit - the product area at the heart of how customers plan, structure, manage, and scale work in Wrike.

In this role, you will lead a unit of five product teams and manage a team of five Product Managers. You will define the vision and strategy for Core Wrike going forward, balancing three critical forces: increasing product power, preserving ease of use, and evolving the experience to be suitable for the AI-native future.

This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who can combine strong product judgment, people leadership, customer empathy, and strategic prioritization. You will help shape the foundation of Wrike’s product experience while developing a team of PMs into stronger strategic product leaders.

Your Impact:

  • Set the Core strategy: Define and evolve the vision, strategy, and priorities for Wrike’s Core unit, ensuring the product remains powerful, scalable, easy to use, and ready for AI agents collaboration as well as for human.
  • Lead a multi-team product area: Manage five Product Managers across five teams, ensuring clarity of ownership, strong decision-making, and consistent product quality across the unit.
  • Prioritize ferociously: Balance customer requests, enterprise needs, technical investments, usability improvements, and long-term strategic bets — with a clear view of what matters most.
  • Enable AI-native R&D: Contribute to building the processes, tooling, and mindsets needed for the R&D organization to scale output and outcomes by 10x with AI-native ways of working.
  • Develop the PM team: Coach, mentor, and grow Product Managers, helping them to achieve the next level.

Your Qualifications:

  • Product leadership experience: Proven experience leading product managers or managing a complex product area with multiple teams and stakeholders.
  • Strong core PM craft and customer-centric mindset: Deep understanding of product discovery, customer validation, roadmap strategy, prioritization, metrics, and product delivery.
  • Enterprise SaaS experience: Strong knowledge of B2B SaaS and enterprise customer needs, including scalability, adoption, usability, configurability, and change management.
  • Strategic prioritization: Ability to make hard trade-offs across incomparable investments, customer escalations, technical complexity, and long-term platform direction.
  • Cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management: Ability to align teams and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, GTM, and executive leadership.
  • People management skills: Experience coaching, mentoring, hiring, developing, and managing performance of product managers.
  • Excellent UX judgment: Ability to balance power and simplicity in complex product experiences.

Standout Qualities:

  • Experience in B2B SaaS enterprise products in collaboration or productivity area
  • Practical understanding of AI-native product development and agentic workflows.
  • Visionary mindset and ability to redefine complex products vision
  • Strong technical fluency and ability to partner effectively with engineering leaders.

Our Work Style:

  • Core product impact: You will shape the foundational Wrike experience used by customers every day to manage work at scale.
  • Strategic complexity: The role requires balancing power, simplicity, customer demand, technical depth, and AI-readiness in one of Wrike’s most important product areas.
  • People leadership scope: You will directly develop a team of five PMs and influence the product culture of a larger R&D unit.
  • AI-native transformation: You will help define how Core Wrike evolves for a future where AI changes how teams create, structure, and manage work.
  • High visibility: Your decisions will influence Wrike’s product direction, customer value, and long-term competitiveness.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Sick Leave Compensation (5 Paid Uncertified Sick Days)
  • Parental Leave: 18 Weeks Maternity / 4 Week Paternity
  • 2 Volunteer Days
  • Medical Insurance (Employees + Dependents)
  • School Allowance (Up to €600/month for school aged kids)

What’s Next?

  • Final interview with the CPO

Your recruitment buddy will be Alexandra Vorobyova, Lead Recruiter.

Who Is Wrike and Our Culture

We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.

Hybrid work mode


Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.
While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.

Our persona

💚 Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too!

Our culture and Values

We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

🤝 Collaborative

We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

🎨 Creative

We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.

💪 Committed

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - GenAI
jobs.excerpt: About EnvatoAt Envato, we empower creative pros to thrive.
jobs.description:
About Envato

At Envato, we empower creative pros to thrive.
We're here to help creatives bring their ideas to life, supercharge their workflows, and equip them with an unparalleled toolkit they can use anywhere. With unlimited access to world-class assets, innovative AI tools, and hands-on tutorials, we deliver what creatives need today - and are continually evolving our offering. As AI transforms the creative landscape, we’re committed to building what’s next for the future.
We’re a purpose-driven company and we’ve long embraced flexible, inclusive ways of working. We’re proud of the connected culture we’ve built across our global team. Our values: Customer First, Build our Future, Make it Happen and Embrace Diversity guide everything we do, shaping how we work and grow.
You can read more about us on our blog, including news of our acquisition by Shutterstock Inc in 2024.

Build the next generation of creative tools with AI

Generative AI is changing how creative work gets made. At Envato, we’re building for that shift.

We help millions of creative professionals find the assets and tools they need to create. Now we’re bringing generative AI deeper into that experience, helping customers generate, edit and customise content as part of their everyday workflows.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager - GenAI to help turn that opportunity into products creative professionals genuinely want to use.

This is a role for someone who is already deep in the world of GenAI. You’re using the tools, exploring new models and paying attention to what is changing. You’re curious about what the technology can do, but just as interested in whether it solves a real customer problem.

What you’ll do

  • You’ll work within Envato’s broader GenAI strategy, owning a defined product area and taking initiatives from discovery through to launch and iteration.
  • You’ll spend time understanding customer problems, exploring product opportunities and working out where generative AI can meaningfully improve creative workflows. That means using customer research, product data, experimentation and your own hands on understanding of GenAI to make decisions about what we should build, test, improve or stop.
  • You’ll get hands on with the technology too. You’ll experiment with emerging models, use AI to explore concepts and prototype ideas, and build a practical understanding of what different models can and can’t do.
  • Then you’ll work closely with Design and Engineering to turn the strongest ideas into high quality experiences, balancing creative quality and customer experience with model performance, reliability, scale and cost.
  • And the work doesn’t stop at launch. You’ll define how success is measured, understand how customers are actually using what we build and use evidence to keep improving it.

What we’re looking for

  • You’re an experienced Product Manager who has owned complex customer facing product initiatives from discovery through to launch and iteration, ideally in SaaS, technology or AI.
  • You have strong practical fluency in generative AI and generative media. You understand models, APIs and emerging capabilities well enough to work closely with technical teams, and you’re comfortable using AI yourself to prototype, explore and test ideas.
  • You’re also interested in creative people and how creative work actually happens. Our customers are designers, filmmakers, editors and creators. You need to understand the difference between an AI output that looks impressive in a demo and one that is actually useful in professional creative work. Experience with creative products or tools would be particularly valuable.
  • You can take customer, technical and commercial information and turn it into clear priorities and product decisions. You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, making trade offs and working autonomously without needing every step mapped out for you.
  • You’ll work closely with teams across Product, Design and Engineering, so you’ll also need to communicate clearly, build alignment and bring people with you.

    • Why Envato?

  • Because there aren’t many roles where you get to work at the intersection of creative professionals, generative AI and a global product already used at scale.
  • We’re not interested in adding AI somewhere because we can. We want to work out where it genuinely makes creative work better.
  • And there is still a lot to figure out. That’s the interesting part.

Life at Envato

• Flexible Working: remote-first across Australia or New Zealand with flexibility for you to manage work and life as you need
• Work from Anywhere: apply to work in another location for up to 3 months per calendar year.
• Connection Budget: an annual budget to connect with the team IRL where and when possible.
• Learning Budget: study leave and an annual budget for you to put towards your learning and development.
• Home Office Allowance: a contribution towards your set-up and a monthly allowance to support work from home costs.
• Wellbeing: access to a holistic assistance program that provides support in many areas of life and health.
• Volunteer Leave: 2 days per calendar year to volunteer and give back to the community.
• Parental Leave:20 weeks paid primary carer leave, and 6 weeks paid secondary carers leave.
We appreciate the time you’ve taken to apply to Envato and we're committed to responding to every applicant.
By submitting your application you are agreeing to our Privacy Policy. If you would like to understand how we handle personal information before submitting your application, please read through our Privacy Policy.
Research shows candidates from neurodiverse and underrepresented backgrounds often only apply for roles if they meet all the criteria. We like to make our hiring decisions based on lived experience, so if you’re keen to apply and need reasonable adjustments please let us know.

Sodali & Co is a recognized global capital markets stakeholder advisory firm, serving over 2,000 clients in more than 65 countries. The Firm operates out of three global headquarters in New York, London, and Sydney and is supported by 12 regional offices in major financial capitals around the world.

Sodali provides a full suite of shareholder, sustainability, and strategic communications advisory services that, together, enable the Firm to deliver clients differentiated insights, integrated expertise, and bespoke advice to address complex interconnected issues, identify and capitalize on strategic opportunities, and drive successful business outcomes.

  • Shareholder Advisory services include M&A Advisory, Activism Preparation and Defense, Board Governance Services, Corporate Governance Advisory, Proxy Solicitation, Capital Markets Intelligence, Global Debt and Bondholder Services, and Stakeholder Research.

The Germanic team of Sodali & Co advises some of the most prominent listed companies across Germany, Austria and Switzerland on high-profile matters relating to corporate governance, investor relations, shareholder engagement, ESG and sustainability.
