Who we are

Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Central Ohio, we’re a privately-owned, independent healthcare navigation organization. We believe that no one should have to navigate the cost and complexity of healthcare alone, and we’re on a mission to make healthcare simpler and more effective for our millions of members. Our big-hearted, tech-savvy team fights to ensure that our members get the care they need, when they need it, at the most affordable cost – that’s why we call ourselves Healthcare Warriors®.

We’re committed to building diverse and inclusive teams – more than 2,000 of us and counting – so if you’re excited about this position, we encourage you to apply – even if your experience doesn’t match every requirement.

About the role  

Quantum Health integrates with a wide variety of partners through data exchanges and API interactions. The Manager, Vendor Integration Engineering leads the team of Vendor Integration Engineers responsible for designing, delivering, and supporting those integrations. This is a player-coach role: you will hire, coach, and develop a team of technical integration engineers while remaining hands-on enough to review integration specifications, lead the hardest escalations, and set the technical standards the team works to.

You will own the intake, prioritization, and delivery of vendor integration work across a portfolio of partners and client onboardings, partnering closely with Client Engagement executives, onboarding project managers, Product, Engineering, and Data teams. Success in this role requires both strong technical depth in data integration (ETL, SQL, APIs, file transport) and the leadership skills to build a high-performing, client-facing technical team.

Location: This position may work remotely anywhere in the United States of America or may work hybrid from our Dublin, Ohio location.

What you’ll do (Essential Responsibilities)

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Vendor Integration Engineers, including hiring, onboarding, goal setting, performance management, and career development. Build bench strength and reduce single points of failure across the integration portfolio.

  • Own the delivery of vendor and partner integrations end to end - intake, technical discovery, scoping, prioritization, build, testing, go-live, and transition to steady-state support. Hold the team accountable to committed dates and quality standards.

  • Set and enforce technical standards for integration design, including data exchange formats (e.g., JSON, XML, CSV), transport methods (e.g., REST, SOAP, SFTP), data mapping and transformation patterns, error handling, and documentation. Review integration specifications and designs produced by the team.

  • Serve as the escalation point and L3 owner for integration incidents, driving triage, root cause analysis, corrective action, and long-term stability planning. Partner with infrastructure, development, and vendor teams to resolve production issues.

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership by reviewing complex SQL and stored procedures, ETL pipelines (SQL Server Integration Services and comparable tools), and monitoring and alerting configurations - and by working directly in the technology when the situation calls for it.

  • Partner with Client Engagement executives and onboarding project managers to translate client and business requirements into actionable technical plans, provide realistic effort and timeline estimates, and represent integration readiness in onboarding and implementation forums.

  • Manage capacity, workload, and resourcing across the team, balancing new client onboardings, partner enhancements, and production support commitments. Surface risks and trade-offs early with clear recommendations.

  • Own executive-level and vendor-facing communication on integration status, risk, and performance - including participation in vendor performance reviews, where you provide technical insight on integration health, incident history, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with external vendor and partner technical teams, establishing clear communication channels, governance cadences, and accountability for vendor deliverables against contractual and operational expectations.

  • Partner with Legal, Security, and Compliance teams to ensure all vendor integrations adhere to data privacy regulations (e.g., HIPAA), secure authentication practices, and internal governance and change management policies.

  • Drive continuous improvement and automation across the integration function — reducing manual handoffs, standardizing reusable patterns and templates, improving observability, and contributing to architecture and process enhancements.

  • Define and report on operational metrics for the team, such as delivery cycle time, on-time onboarding readiness, incident volume and mean time to resolution, and integration reliability.

  • Other duties as assigned.

What you’ll bring (Qualifications)

  • Education:Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

  • 2+ years of experience leading technical teams (people management, team lead, or equivalent), with demonstrated success hiring, coaching, and developing engineers.

  • 5+ years of hands-on technical experience in data integration, ETL, or data engineering.

  • 3+ years of Relational Database experience (SQL Server preferred), including proficiency in T-SQL and stored procedures.

  • 3+ years of ETL experience (SQL Server Integration Services preferred), including exposure to data orchestration tools like Apache Airflow.

  • 3+ years of demonstrated experience working with external partners or vendors in a direct client-facing capacity.

  • Demonstrated experience using AI to accelerate workflows and ensure quality.

  • Demonstrated experience with Cloud technologies like AWS or GCP.

  • Strong understanding of Relational Database concepts (i.e. normalization, constraints, etc.) and Data Warehouse concepts.

  • Good understanding of Web Technologies including APIs and SSO.

  • Proven ability to manage competing priorities and delivery commitments across multiple concurrent projects and stakeholders.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate technical detail for executive and non-technical audiences.

  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and serve as a liaison between technical and business partners.

  • Protect and take care of our company and member’s data every day by committing to work within our company ethics and policies.

  • A high degree of personal accountability and trustworthiness, a commitment to working within Quantum Health’s policies, values and ethics, and to protecting the sensitive data entrusted to us.

Preferred Experience

  • Vendor management, contract, or SLA oversight experience.

  • Data modeling experience.

  • Cloud integration experience.

  • Experience within healthcare, healthcare technology, or other regulated industries.

What’s in it for you:

  • Coverage: Health, vision and dental featuring our best-in-class healthcare navigation services, along with life insurance, legal and identity protection, adoption assistance, EAP, Teladoc services and more.
  • Retirement: 401(k) plan with up to 4% employer match and full vesting on day one.

About AI Acquisition

AI Acquisition is the global category leader in AI service provider enablement. Operating globally with the US as its primary market, our unique hybrid of Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) and AI marketplace has achieved explosive growth by connecting AI agencies with qualified enterprise opportunities at scale. We combine proprietary AI orchestration tools with proven enterprise SaaS infrastructure to deliver immediate value to small and medium businesses worldwide.

We’re revolutionizing the way entrepreneurs build businesses by brokering AI tools to business owners eager to succeed. Whether through our AI Agency Incubator, AI Accelerator, or AI Agency Launchpad, we provide the systems, training, and support to help our members achieve rapid success.

The Role

We are looking for a Head of Marketing Technology & Automation to take absolute ownership of our end-to-end marketing infrastructure. This is not a traditional virtual assistant or ticket-taking role. We are hiring a true Technical Operator—someone who will look at our marketing landscape, independently design the strategy, and execute the architecture completely free of day-to-day oversight.

You aren't just completing tasks; you own the systems layer of all marketing funnels—tracking, attribution, reporting, funnel pages, multi-step automations, and global email infrastructure.

Today, this execution layer requires too much internal oversight. We are hiring a sharp, high-agency leader who can be handed a one-line business objective and trusted to return a fully mapped, tested, and operating technical solution. This is a full-time, remote position ideal for a data-driven technical manager who wants to build robust, AI-accelerated marketing systems at scale.

Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure Ownership & Strategy: Act as the technical architect for all marketing funnels. Autonomously design, implement, and audit data pathways without needing micro-management from leadership.
  • Tracking, Attribution & Financial Reconciliation: Implement and structurally maintain comprehensive attribution tracking (Meta pixel + Conversions API, GTM server-side tagging, GA4); define and enforce strict UTM frameworks; ruthlessly debug data or numbers discrepancies between ad platforms, our CRM (Close), and payment gateways (Whop/Stripe) end-to-end.
  • Reporting & Anomaly Detection: Build, own, and maintain marketing campaign dashboards. Guarantee 100% data fidelity, proactively deep-diving into analytics anomalies and fixing root-cause tracking bugs before leadership ever has to ask.
  • Funnel Operations: Oversee and optimize high-converting landing pages, VSL pages, opt-in forms, and complex multi-path booking flows across our page builders. Set up clean split-testing parameters ensuring zero leakage in data recording.
  • Advanced Automation & System Architecture: Architect and manage robust n8n webhooks and multi-branch workflows connecting external forms, Close CRM, Slack, Google Sheets, and our email platform—ensuring strict error handling and automated fallback paths are built natively into every execution loop.
  • Email Ops & Deliverability Architecture: Direct the execution of multi-step behavioral email sequences and system triggers within our ESP. Own long-term list hygiene, technical exit conditions, domain isolation, and overall deliverability metrics.
  • AI Orchestration: Aggressively leverage AI agents and advanced prompt engineering to accelerate team output; identify key areas in our pipeline where AI steps can scale throughput or operational intelligence.
  • Future Scope: Take full technical ownership of the marketing operations department, with the runway to hire, structure, and directly manage junior technical VAs/contractors as we scale.

Requirements

Ideal Candidate Profile

    • Ownership & Operator Mindset (Non-Negotiable): You have a proven track record of owning marketing technology stacks entirely without oversight. You have personally managed a technical team or solo function for a fast-growing agency/SaaS, setting up complex tech ecosystems from scratch. You think like a business owner, not a component builder.
    • High Horsepower & Agency: Given a highly ambiguous brief, you fill the gaps with sensible architectural choices, explicitly document your core assumptions, flag uncertainties, and ship completely functional results first time round.
    • Automation Mastery: Extensive hands-on depth in advanced workflow automation tools (n8n strongly preferred; Make/Zapier acceptable only with a portfolio proving complex, multi-branch builds, heavy webhook parsing, custom API requests, and built-in error trapping).
    • Deep Tracking Fluency: You can tell a specific technical war story about a severe numbers mismatch between an ad platform and a CRM that you independently tracked down, debugged, and resolved via server-side tagging or webhooks.
    • Code Literacy: Highly comfortable working with custom REST APIs, raw JSON data manipulation, and webhooks. Scripting familiarity (HTML, JavaScript, or Python) is a significant plus.
    • Async-Native Communicator: Absolute fluency in written and spoken English. You communicate with precision, utilize concise written technical updates, and record brief, context-rich Looms to align teams across time zones.

Nice to Have

    • Based in Eastern Europe (or highly aligned with US Eastern/Central daytime hours).
    • Direct, hands-on experience with Close CRM, Whop/Stripe, and GTM server-side tagging.
    • Prior experience directing, hiring, or quality-controlling marketing VAs.
    • Technical alignment with digital info-product, coaching, or high-ticket community funnels.

Benefits

What’s In It for You

  • Training Provided: You’ll receive full support to succeed in your role, including onboarding process training, hands-on guidance using Asana and Slack for project coordination, and ongoing mentorship from senior technical leads.
  • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere with a stable internet connection while maintaining professional async-native structures.
  • Skill Growth: Gain elite experience in AI orchestration, advanced automation (n8n), and high-level marketing operations.
  • Supportive Team: Join a collaborative environment that values technical curiosity, blunt direct feedback, and professional growth.
  • Real Impact: Your builds directly power the growth of our members, optimize funnel mechanics, and scale the overall organization.

Ready to Grow With Us?

If you’re organized, technically minded, and ready to help us shape the future of AI-driven marketing, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now by submitting your CV and a short note about why you’re a great technical fit. We’re excited to welcome the right person to our team!

    • Plan the safe migration off legacy V1 services onto vNext, one path or feature at a time, with rollback at every step.
  • The agent-driven engineering system
    • Design how work flows from idea to production with agents: spec → plan → task breakdown → agent implementation → automated checks → human review → deploy.
    • Own the standing context agents load every session:AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, architecture rules, coding standards, skills, MCP servers and hooks. Review changes to them like code.
    • Maintain the golden module template (our TaskBoard reference module) so a new module goes from scaffold to QA in days.
    • Set the automated guardrails agents must pass: typecheck, lint, dependency-boundary rules, contract tests, row-level-security tests, secret scanning, conformance checks.
    • Decide which agent, model and mode fits which task, and track cost, speed and defect rates per workflow.
  • Quality, security and operations
    • Review the highest-risk agent changes yourself: authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, payments/credits, infrastructure and data migrations.
    • Threat-model new modules and AI features (prompt injection, credential leakage, abuse of lab environments).
    • Define SLOs, observability and incident practice for the platform; make sure every environment can be rebuilt from infrastructure-as-code (Bicep/Terraform).
  • AI product architecture
    • Architect AI-powered product features such as the AI Trainer (realtime voice, screen understanding, lab validation tools) and Lab Studio (AI-generated labs, guides and checks).
    • Choose and integrate model providers (Azure OpenAI, Anthropic and others), with evaluation suites, guardrails and cost controls.
  • Leadership
    • Coach developers on spec writing, agent orchestration and critical review.
    • Work with product, the .NET core team and partners on roadmap and trade-offs; explain them clearly to non-engineers.

Requirements

Must have

  • Deep, current experience with both halves of our stack: ASP.NET Core/C#/SQL Server and Angular on one side; TypeScript, React/Next.js and Python on the other. You can read any of it fluently and spot what an agent got wrong.
  • Proven architecture of multi-tenant SaaS: tenant isolation, RBAC/entitlements, white-labelling, API versioning.
  • Strong identity and security fundamentals: OAuth 2.0/OIDC, Azure AD B2C or Entra, session design, OWASP Top 10, secrets management.
  • Azure in production: Container Apps or AKS, App Service, Front Door or App Gateway, Key Vault, managed identities, Bicep or Terraform.
  • Demonstrated daily use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor agent mode, Copilot agents or similar) to ship production systems, including multi-agent/parallel workflows.
  • Experience writing specs and acceptance criteria precise enough that an agent can build from them, and standing instructions that keep a codebase consistent across many agent sessions.
  • Clear written English: ADRs, specs and review comments are your main output.

Nice to have

  • Built MCP servers, agent skills or custom agent tooling; experience with the Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK or similar.

  • Learning-platform or lab-platform domain: LMS, LTI 1.3, assessments, cloud sandboxes, Guacamole/RDP consoles.

  • Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform ou environnement cloud conteneurisé ;

  • CI/CD : GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions ou équivalents ;

  • observabilité : Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, Langfuse ou équivalents ;

  • bases de données et stockage : PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, stockage documentaire ou équivalents ;

  • tests unitaires, tests d’intégration, tests de non-régression et évaluation de réponses IA.

  • expérience OCR, extraction de données ou analyse de documents ;

Rejoindre ASI, c’est intégrer une entreprise à taille humaine, reconnue pour son expertise en transformation digitale, data et IA.

Vous interviendrez sur des missions concrètes, auprès de clients grands comptes, sur des sujets en forte croissance : IA générative, RAG, agents IA, plateformes conversationnelles, industrialisation des usages, gouvernance des données et sécurité.

Position Summary:

As thePrincipal Scientist Algorithm Lead you will provide end‑to‑end scientific and technical leadership for clinical‑grade NGS diagnostic algorithms, with a primary focus on oncology and liquid biopsy applications. This role owns algorithm design, analytical validation, design control, and regulatory readiness, with an emphasis on improving sensitivity, robustness, and reproducibility across complex variant classes.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the full lifecycle of clinical NGS algorithms under design control, including requirements definition, risk analysis, traceability to analytical claims, and design change impact assessment.
  • Architect and lead automated analytical validation frameworks spanning accuracy, precision, sensitivity/LOD, specificity, linearity, and robustness for SNVs, indels, CNVs, structural variants, gene fusions, and RNA‑based assays.
  • Define algorithm‑level error models, performance budgets, and acceptance criteria, driving systematic improvements in low‑VAF detection, background suppression, and assay‑specific artifact mitigation.
  • Establish statistically rigorous approaches for truth set construction, reference materials, in silico mixing, and synthetic data generation to support scalable and reproducible validation.
  • Serve as final technical authority on algorithm changes, including re‑validation scope, documentation strategy, and regulatory impact.
  • Lead development and optimization of variant calling and signal extraction algorithms for DNA‑and RNA‑based assays, including ultra‑deep sequencing and challenging genomic regions.
  • Develop and track NGS‑based quality control metrics at the read, molecule, sample, and assay levels (e.g., coverage, uniformity, duplication/UMI yield, error rates, contamination, noise profiles) to monitor analytical performance and stability.

As a Senior Product Manager at Chooose, you will own the end-to-end product vision, roadmap, and execution for your domain. You’ll work with a core team of engineers and designers to build products that enable the largest aviation fuel suppliers and fuel buyers to accelerate their lower carbon fuel business processes.

We’re looking for someone who is energized by ambiguity, deeply curious about the frontier of AI in enterprise products, and passionate about building products that balance technical depth with intuitive user experiences. You’ll need to be hands-on with prototyping and comfortable translating complex systems into clear, user-centered solutions.

  • Drive high-velocity execution with a distributed team of engineers and designers

  • Prototype rapidly using tools like Cursor to accelerate the product development lifecycle and fast-forward to production-ready products

  • Stay deeply plugged into AI tooling, industry trends, and emergent applications, filtering signal from noise and applying it accelerate execution for the Product team

  • Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization such as Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Sales, Account Management, and Operations

What you bring to the table

  • BA/BS in a technical or analytical field (e.g. Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Analytics, Mathematics, Physics, Applied Sciences, or related)

Who You Are

You are a detail-oriented, experienced medical coder who understands that accurate coding is just one part of a healthy revenue cycle. You bring strong outpatient coding expertise along with hands-on experience in AR follow-up, denial resolution, and payment posting. You’re comfortable digging into claims, identifying issues, and following them through to resolution while maintaining accuracy and compliance. You communicate confidently with payors, patients, providers, and teammates, and you know how to make complex billing questions easier to understand. You thrive in a remote environment where you can take ownership of your work, manage competing priorities, and keep things moving. Most importantly, you care about getting it right - for our providers, our patients, and the business.

Who We Are

Oasis Health Partners (Oasis) is building healthier communities by advancing primary care. We partner with patients, providers, and plans to provide personalized, local care for seniors in towns across America. We believe that patient needs come first, and that primary care is the foundation of patient-centric healthcare. With Oasis, patients receive better access and care. Providers receive the data, resources, and expertise to be successful in value-based care arrangements. Payors get the benefit of a solution that improves performance, drives growth, and reduces the total cost of care in hard-to-engage markets.

Together, we will boldly advance primary care for those that need it most. We are excited for you to join us on this journey. We invite you to be a part of Oasis, where you will discover we listen first, do the right thing, build things together and go all in --- while having fun! 

Your Role

Oasis is building a strong, scalable Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) offering to support independent and community-based primary care practices. As a Medical Coder/AR Specialist, you will play a vital role in keeping the revenue cycle moving - from accurate outpatient coding and clean claim submission through payment posting, AR follow-up, and denial resolution. You will work across the billing lifecycle to identify and resolve issues that could delay or impact reimbursement, while also serving as a resource for providers and patients when coding or billing questions arise. Your work will help reduce revenue leakage, improve collections, and create a better experience for the practices and patients we serve.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assign accurate CPT, ICD-10, and HCPCS codes for outpatient encounters based on provider documentation
  • Enter and manage charges within eClinicalWorks (eCW)
  • Post insurance payments, adjustments, and denials accurately based on EOBs/ERAs
  • Review, submit, and track claims through the full billing lifecycle
  • Conduct AR follow-up on unpaid, denied, or underpaid claims with insurance payors
  • Identify and resolve coding-related denials; resubmit corrected claims as needed
  • Work aging AR reports to reduce outstanding balances and days in AR
  • Communicate with payors (calls, portals, correspondence) to resolve claim issues
  • Answer incoming patient calls regarding account balances, explain charges, and address billing questions professionally
  • Collaborate with providers and billing staff to clarify documentation and coding questions
  • Stay current on payor policies, coding guideline updates, and compliance requirements

Investment In Our Team

We invest in the personal and professional success of our team. We take care of our people and offer robust benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401k, and generous time off plans. We are committed to supporting your growth with a development program that starts with onboarding and continues throughout your career. As an inclusive, passionate, and diverse team, you will partner with professionals who understand the importance of high-value, high-impact patient care. 

About You

  • Certified Professional Coder (CPC) certification required
  • Minimum 2 years of recent experience in AR follow-up and denial management
  • Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience working in eClinicalWorks (eCW)
  • Demonstrated experience with outpatient medical coding
  • Experience posting insurance payments, including EOB/ERA processing, adjustments, and write-offs
  • Experience communicating directly with patients regarding account balances, charges, and billing questions
  • Strong working knowledge of CPT, ICD-10, HCPCS, and payor billing requirements
  • Working knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payor guidelines
  • Strong attention to detail with a commitment to coding accuracy and compliance
  • Ability to independently manage priorities and follow work through to resolution in a remote environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Reliable internet access and the ability to maintain a HIPAA-compliant remote workspace
Hourly Pay Range
$24—$29 USD

The salary range listed reflects the full compensation range for this role level at Oasis and is designed to support growth over time. Actual offers may vary based on a candidate’s skills, experience, and alignment with the scope of the role. Offers near the top of the range are uncommon and generally reflect exceptionally deep, directly relevant experience.

  • Collaborate with Payroll, HRIS, IT, and business stakeholders to ensure data integrity, system support, and process efficiency for incentive tracking and payouts.
  • Support the annual merit increase, bonus planning, and compensation review processes

Communication and Change Support

  • Prepare clear plan documents, participant communications, leader guides, and training materials so incentive programs are easy to understand and consistently administered.

Compliance and Governance

Other Duties

  • Strong expertise in incentive modeling, scenario analysis, payout logic, and financial forecasting.
  • Experience tracking incentive performance and conducting ROI, trend, and effectiveness analyses to support plan decisions.
  • Ability to translate business strategy into practical incentive designs that motivate the right behaviors and are operationally sustainable.

Director, Medical Science Liaison (West Coast)

Kyverna is seeking a highly motivated Director, Medical Science Liaison (MSL), who will engage scientifically with health care providers and medical and scientific experts to support the Medical Affairs Team’s strategic priorities and plans across Western United States. The Director MSL must have deep clinical/medical expertise to serve as a trusted resource to our external experts and internal teams and will embody Kyverna’s core values: Stay True to Why, Collaborate to Accelerate, Lead with Clarity, Boldly Innovative, and Own the Outcome.

LOCATION: Preferred locations Northern CA, NV, UT, TX, CO

TERRITORY: Western USA

REPORTS TO: Senior Director, Field Medical

TRAVEL: up to 50%

Responsibilities

    • Provide strategic leadership for Kyverna’s Field Medical function across Western USA, setting the vision, priorities, and operating framework for regional scientific engagement and external collaboration.
    • Develop, lead, and maintain high-impact, long-term relationships with healthcare professionals, key opinion leaders, clinical investigators, academic research centers, professional societies, and patient advocacy groups to position Kyverna as a scientific and clinical thought partner.
    • Serve as a senior scientific ambassador for Kyverna’s cell therapy platform and autoimmune disease portfolio, driving sophisticated, compliant scientific exchange to advance disease understanding, therapeutic adoption, and evidence-generation needs.
    • Shape and influence Medical Affairs strategy by synthesizing high-quality field insights, including protocol feedback, treatment landscape evolution, unmet needs, real-world practice patterns, and competitive intelligence to inform clinical development, commercial planning, and lifecycle management.
    • Provide senior oversight and partnership with clinical trial sites to anticipate and resolve barriers to identification, screening, enrollment, and retention
    • Support commercial site activation, operational readiness, and optimal study execution as a member of site activation team.
    • Oversee regional scientific activities such as advisory boards, congress planning, symposium support, investigator meetings, and scientific engagement initiatives; represent Kyverna at major international conferences as a senior leader.
    • Support evaluation and development of investigator-initiated trials, scientific collaborations, and research partnerships, ensuring alignment with Kyverna’s medical strategy and organizational priorities.
    • Build and mentor a high-performing regional MSL organization, including talent acquisition, training, coaching, and performance management to achieve excellence in scientific engagement and field execution.
    • Ensure strategic alignment and cross-functional collaboration with Clinical Development, Safety, Regulatory, Commercial, Market Access, and Corporate Affairs, acting as a key advisor and scientific resource for internal leaders.
    • Maintain deep and current expertise in autoimmune disease, cellular therapy, neuromuscular disorders, and emerging scientific literature to guide internal strategy and external engagement.
    • Champion compliance, ethical scientific exchange, and adherence to all applicable laws, regulations, and company policies; ensure regional consistency in messaging, medical governance, and documentation practices.
    • Ability to travel extensively across the region (up to 50 percent), including occasional weekends and short-notice requests, to fulfill leadership responsibilities.

Qualifications

    • 10+ years of progressive Medical Affairs experience with at least 5 years in a senior management or field leadership role, within neuromuscular therapeutics.
    • Advanced scientific or medical degree (PhD, PharmD, MD, or equivalent) required.
    • Demonstrated success developing and executing regional or global Medical Affairs strategies, including scientific engagement, evidence generation, and cross-functional alignment.
    • Strong expertise in Myasthenia Gravis or related neuromuscular disorders strongly preferred. Expertise in neuroimmunology disorders also highly desirable.
    • Proven ability to build, lead, mentor, and inspire high-performing MSL or field-medical teams.
    • Exceptional verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to convey complex science and influence senior stakeholders.
    • Highly strategic thinker with strong operational discipline; demonstrates independent judgment, adaptability, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
    • Strong collaborative mindset with a track record of successfully partnering across Clinical Development, Regulatory, Commercial, and Executive Leadership teams.

The Engineer receives direction on assignment objectives and complex features and is responsible for executing work using established plans, standards, and federal requirements.

This position contributes to the development of purposeful, high-quality electrical designs that support federal clients, including military, government, and mission-critical facilities. The Engineer collaborates closely with multidisciplinary teams to deliver reliable, code-compliant, and constructible solutions while supporting project scope, schedule, and budget.

Job Description Summary



As Executive Director, Enterprise Experience Planning & Integration, you will connect people, functions, and processes across Novartis—aligning Marketing, Patient Services, Medical, Advocacy, Access, Field Sales, Digital Engagement, and Enterprise Partnerships—to reduce fragmentation and deliver a seamless experience across the patient lifecycle. In this role, you will build the connective tissue across functions, lifecycle stages, and organizational boundaries by establishing governance, operating models, and ways of working that unite diverse stakeholders around shared priorities, translate enterprise strategy into coordinated execution and measurable outcomes, and create consistency with Integrated Experience Planning leads within the Customer Experience Planning & Optimization team. Success will require you to influence across a complex matrix without direct authority, strengthen organizational alignment, and advance a more connected One Novartis experience for patients, caregivers, and customers.

This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. (there may be some restrictions based on legal entity). Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the hiring manager. This position will require up to 10% travel.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Establish an enterprise view of customer and patient journeys and refine how Novartis improves them through connected, creative, and empathetic experiences.
  • Ensure key enterprise functions are represented in experience planning and priority initiatives, connecting planning and execution across Marketing, Patient Services, Medical, Advocacy, Access, Field Sales, Digital Engagement, and Enterprise Partnerships.
  • Identify and address gaps, silos, disconnects, and unclear ownership, coordination, or accountability that create fragmented customer and patient experiences.
  • Champion patient and caregiver perspectives across strategy, experience design, content, support, access, and engagement initiatives.
  • Strengthen continuity across the patient lifecycle—from clinical trial participation through diagnosis, access, treatment initiation, adherence, ongoing support, and long-term engagement—reducing friction at critical journey stages.
  • Advance approaches that deepen sustained engagement with patient communities, particularly in rare and specialty conditions.
  • Establish governance that aligns leaders around shared customer and patient priorities, facilitates cross-functional decision-making when ownership, priorities, or resources are unclear, and monitors commitments and outcomes through shared measurement frameworks that support consistency, compliance, and quality at scale.
  • Support priority launches and enterprise initiatives requiring cross-functional coordination, maintaining alignment to shared customer and patient experience priorities from planning through execution.
  • Define and track shared customer and patient experience outcomes; provide visibility into enterprise adoption, alignment, and execution performance; and identify risks, dependencies, and opportunities requiring leadership attention.
  • Develop frameworks, processes, tools, transitions, and handoffs that strengthen cross-functional collaboration and coordination and enable scalable enterprise alignment and execution, while operating in accordance with Ethics, Risk and Compliance policies and procedures and ensuring others do the same.

Essential Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in related field is required; Master of Science and/or MBA preferred.
  • 10+ years of demonstrated experience identifying opportunities and driving solutions to create an orchestrated customer journey.
  • 5 years of demonstrated experience using data, insights, behaviors, and analytics—along with customer engagement, social media, and CRM—to optimize customer experiences through journey mapping, personalization, and content required.

  • Experience with media and content testing to analyze effectiveness of integrated communications in HCP or DTC category marketing.

  • Experience leading a Marketing transformation & vision within pharma/biotech/Life Sciences.
  • Strategic and analytical thinking, as demonstrated by key projects/initiatives.

  • Leadership of large-scale teams (over 50+: including matrixed, virtual, and multi- layer).

jobs.excerpt: Cornerstone Building Brands is looking for an experienced Field Service Representative to serve as a technical subject matter resource for post-shipment claims, material shortages, and field installation issues involving pre-engineered metal building systems.
jobs.description:
Cornerstone Building Brands is looking for an experienced Field Service Representative to serve as a technical subject matter resource for post-shipment claims, material shortages, and field installation issues involving pre-engineered metal building systems. This role independently investigates complex field conditions by comparing information from builders and erectors with architectural and structural drawings, approval and erection drawings, bills of material, shop details, order history, manufacturing data, and shipping documentation. The Field Service Representative works across Engineering, Drafting, Manufacturing, Sales, Project Management, Logistics, and Customer Service to identify root cause, determine the appropriate corrective action, create accurate replacement or shortage orders, and communicate resolution to the customer. You will report to the Manager, Field Services.

  • Manage assigned post-shipment technical claims, shortages, back charges and field issues from initial intake through final resolution, balancing customer impact, project schedule, cost, and business risk.
  • Lead fact-based investigations with builders, erectors, contractors, and internal teams by collecting and validating photographs, field measurements, material identification, installation sequence, site conditions, and supporting documentation.
  • Read, interpret, and cross-analyze architectural drawings, structural plans, approval drawings, erection drawings, shop details, bills of material, project specifications, change orders, production records, and shipping documentation to determine the facts of each claim.
  • Apply advanced knowledge of complete PEMB systems, including primary framing, secondary framing, bracing, roof and wall panels, trim, framed openings, fasteners, accessories, finishes, and typical erection sequence.
  • Determine the scope and likely cause of field issues, including potential shortages, fabrication errors, detailing or drafting discrepancies, engineering questions, shipping damage, customer changes, erection practices, back charges or jobsite conditions.
  • Develop corrective action plans with the appropriate internal functions. Route repair, field modification, and structural questions to Engineering, then communicate approved technical direction to the customer and erector.
  • Create and validate shortage and replacement orders with the correct part numbers, quantities, dimensions, material specifications, gauges, finishes, colors, fabrication requirements, shipping priority, and delivery information.
  • Coordinate complex resolutions across Engineering, Drafting, Manufacturing, Quality, Sales, Project Management, Logistics, Delivery Coordination, and Customer Service. Establish clear owners, required actions, and completion dates.
  • Communicate technical findings, responsibility determinations, limitations, and next steps in clear language. Manage difficult customer conversations while maintaining credibility and professional relationships.
  • Exercise independent judgment when information is incomplete or conflicting. Identify the correct technical questions, determine when additional review is required, and escalate structural, safety, high-cost, repeat, or schedule-sensitive issues.
  • Maintain complete and accurate case records in the CRM, including the reported condition, documentation reviewed, investigation findings, decisions, corrective actions, responsible parties, customer communications, and final resolution.
  • Meet established response and resolution expectations by prioritizing cases, providing proactive status updates, and following open actions through completion.
  • Analyze recurring claim and shortage trends, provide root-cause data, and recommend process, product, documentation, manufacturing, or training improvements to reduce repeat issues.
  • Support periodic on-site investigations, customer meetings, training, and team meetings. Travel is expected to be approximately 10 percent based on business needs.
  • Serve as a technical resource to customers, erectors, internal partners, and less-experienced team members by sharing PEMB knowledge and practical field experience.
  • High school diploma or equivalent experience required.
  • Technical education, certification, or degree in construction, drafting, engineering technology, architecture, manufacturing, or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 5 years of progressive experience in the pre-engineered metal building industry, or an equivalent combination of directly related education and experience.
  • Advanced working knowledge of PEMB components, construction methods, erection practices, manufacturing processes, and the interaction between building systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to read and interpret architectural drawings, structural plans, approval and erection drawings, shop details, bills of material, and project specifications.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting technical investigations, identifying root cause, developing corrective actions, and resolving issues involving multiple internal and external parties.
  • Ability to evaluate incomplete or conflicting information, ask the correct technical questions, make sound decisions within the role’s authority, and recognize when Engineering or leadership review is required.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical information to builders, erectors, customers, manufacturing teams, and business partners.
  • Strong organization and case-management skills with the ability to manage multiple complex claims, deadlines, and customer commitments in a remote work environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Word, CRM systems, and ERP or order-entry platforms such as Oracle or comparable systems.

Role Title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer

Role Type: Contractor (~15hrs/week)

Location: Remote

We are engaging Senior Mechanical Design Engineers to contribute to a customer's project involving complex CAD assembly exploration and AI advancement. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Required Skills

  • Design intent & assembly reasoning

  • Parametric modeling depth

  • Mechanism & kinematic sense

  • GD&T & tolerance judgment

  • CAD tools expertise

Scope of Work

  • Analyze and dissect multi-part mechanical assemblies to identify critical design decisions, constraints, and potential failure points that challenge expert reasoning.

  • Formulate challenging, non-obvious technical questions that test real-world mechanical design judgment, ensuring relevance and difficulty beyond junior-level understanding.

  • Validate and document defensible, exact answers directly from CAD models, ensuring clear traceability and accuracy.

  • Review AI-generated outputs, pinpoint breakdowns or inaccuracies in mechanical reasoning, and suggest targeted improvements.

  • Flag ambiguous, trivial, or unanswerable questions, refining or sharpening them for clarity and precision.

  • Thoroughly document edge cases and sources of disagreement within answers to maintain strict verifiability.

  • Communicate findings and reasoning in clear, professional written and verbal form to support continuous project improvement.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional experience creating and overseeing multi-part mechanical assemblies from concept, not just from existing drawings.

  • Mastery in at least one major parametric CAD tool (SolidWorks, Creo, NX, CATIA, Inventor, Fusion, Onshape, or Solid Edge).

  • Demonstrated experience in teaching, mentoring, or leading — whether through formal instruction, leading design reviews, or coaching engineering teams.

  • Expertise in design intent, assembly reasoning, mechanism and kinematic analysis, and robust GD&T/tolerance judgment.

  • Background in at least one discipline: industrial machinery and automation, robotics, automotive and heavy equipment, aerospace and defense, medical devices, consumer products, or tooling and fixture design.

  • Exceptional written English communication skills — your documentation directly influences project deliverables.

Bonus: Experience with FreeCAD, advanced GD&T/tolerance analysis, or formal design review leadership.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Desired:

Location

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

*Please note the salary range information provided applies only to candidates residing in California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State due to local requirements. Compensation for candidates in other locations will be discussed during the hiring process. Please note that hiring for this role is not restricted to the locations listed above.

CertiK works with banks, regulators and regulated financial institutions that adopt digital assets. We build regulatory technology for these markets, and we are hiring a lead product manager to own what we build next for these clients.

  • 5–8 years in B2B product management, ideally in fintech, regtech, compliance software or at a regulated financial institution

  • Domain experience in financial crime, AML or transaction monitoring, blockchain intelligence, or risk and surveillance products, whether as a product manager or from inside a compliance function

jobs.description:
At Clover Health, we are committed to providing high-quality, affordable, and easy-to-understand healthcare plans for America’s seniors. We prioritize preventive care while leveraging data and technology through the Clover Assistant, a powerful tool that helps physicians make informed health recommendations. By giving doctors a holistic view of each member’s complete health history, we ensure better care at a lower cost—delivering the highest value to those who need it most.

Clover’s Payment Integrity team is responsible for ensuring claims are paid accurately, consistently, and in accordance with applicable requirements. We’re looking for a Payment Integrity Analyst who brings strong Medicare Advantage claims and reimbursement knowledge, investigative judgment, and the ability to translate claims data into defensible findings.

In this role, you’ll investigate potential payment inaccuracies, evaluate claims populations identified through SQL analysis, and determine whether the evidence supports a payment issue or a correctly adjudicated outcome. You’ll research applicable requirements, work through claim histories and exceptions, and help turn validated findings into actionable recommendations and repeatable audits.

You’ll work closely with the Senior Manager, who will lead complex SQL development, investigation priorities, and validation methodology. You should be comfortable independently running and adapting existing queries, using AI tools thoughtfully, and taking ownership of assigned investigations from initial review through a documented recommendation.

As a Payment Integrity Analyst, you will:

  • Investigate potential payment inaccuracies using Medicare Advantage adjudication and reimbursement knowledge to interpret claims data and explain payment outcomes.
  • Review claims populations identified through SQL analysis and distinguish supported payment discrepancies from valid exceptions, data issues, and correctly adjudicated claims.
  • Research applicable CMS/NCCI and other coding guidance, provider contract terms, benefit documents, and internal payment policies and configuration requirements. Identify effective dates, applicability, and unresolved source conflicts.
  • Analyze claim and line detail, payment components, adjustments, reversals, and related claim history to understand what occurred and assess the expected payment outcome.
  • Independently run SQL queries and make targeted changes to dates, filters, and claim selections.
  • Actively seek evidence that could disprove a suspected issue, including correctly paid comparison claims, exceptions, and alternative explanations.
  • Document the applicable sources, validation steps, exclusions, supported payment impact, and unresolved questions clearly enough for another reviewer to reproduce the conclusion.
  • Use approved AI tools to support research, query interpretation, and documentation while verifying sources, factual claims, and analytical outputs.
  • Review and audit outputs from audit tools, identifying false positives and refining rules to improve precision.
  • Prepare findings for review and support downstream recovery evaluation, operational resolution, and Compliance/Legal review as needed.
  • Contribute to recurring audits, monitor previously validated issues, and recommend improvements to investigation and testing processes.

Success in this role looks like:

  • Within the first 90 days, you’ve developed a working understanding of Clover’s claims data, payment integrity workflows, and validation approach. You’re independently running and making basic adaptations to existing queries, completing assigned claim reviews, and documenting findings and open questions clearly.
  • Within six months, you’re taking ownership of defined investigations with limited day-to-day direction, identifying exceptions and alternative explanations, and preparing source-supported recommendations for review. You’re also contributing to recurring audits and helping improve the team’s testing and documentation practices.
  • Over time, your work helps the team identify and validate payment inaccuracies more efficiently, reduce false positives, and translate supported findings into payment corrections and sustainable controls.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewThe MRO Advisory Solutions team is expanding beyond its current assessment offerings into performance improvement and analytics consulting.
jobs.description:
Overview

The MRO Advisory Solutions team is expanding beyond its current assessment offerings into performance improvement and analytics consulting. The Consultant role owns the analytical and project execution core of new advisory offerings: the data collection and analysis, the deliverables, the workplan, and the day-to-day partner engagement that makes each engagement land.

These offerings are new and pre-launch. That makes this a build role as much as a delivery role: the Consultant executes the pilots, instruments them against defined success criteria, brings back structured evidence about what should change, and helps convert what works into repeatable delivery assets so each offering can scale past its first few partners.

Responsibilities

1. Analysis and Deliverables · ~45%

Owns the analytical core of every engagement — the Collect and Analyze phases, and the authorship of key deliverables.

  • Assemble and validate the engagement data set: this could include registry data (STS Adult Cardiac Surgery, NCDR CathPCI, TVT; NAACCR for oncology), read-only EMR review, Market Analytics, benchmark data, and partner-supplied operational and financial data
  • Run the quantitative analysis each offering requires — this could include things like outcomes, length-of-stay, and adverse event variation; physician-level variation and documentation gaps; performance against public benchmarks; patient migration and leakage; competitive and market position
  • Build the financial impact analysis: ROI and cost-impact modeling, revenue sizing, and growth opportunities
  • Conduct the qualitative work — stakeholder interviews, surveys, and workflow review — and synthesize it against the quantitative findings
  • Author draft findings, prioritized action blueprints, scorecards, and implementation or growth roadmaps in collaboration with the Advisory Lead and other team members
  • Build and maintain the analytical assets each offering depends on: this could include data request templates, calculation and risk-adjustment logic, benchmark data sets, and performance trackers

2. Engagement and Project Management · ~30%

Runs the day-to-day of 16- to 24-week engagements, projects may run concurrently.

  • Build and maintain project workplans, including milestones, owners, dependencies, and status
  • Serve as primary day-to-day partner contact for working-level and mid-management stakeholders
  • Lead client-facing meetings for their engagements — kickoffs, working check-ins, and final presentations
  • Facilitate working sessions and stakeholder interviews; hold partner-side owners accountable to deadlines
  • Surface delivery risk, scope creep, and stakeholder resistance to the Advisory team early enough to act on
  • Coordinate internal contributors across Clinical Services, Product, and other teams as projects require

3. Offering Build and Pilot Execution · ~25%

Supports delivery of pilot offerings and helps shape what scaled offerings look like

  • Support Business Development with offering-specific content and fit assessment during partner conversations
  • Capture partner feedback and make recommendations on what should change in each offering to move from pilot to scaled offerings — phase length, data requirements, deliverable format, scope, etc.
  • Document where an offering needs technology or data support and route as needed
  • Convert what works into repeatable delivery assets: methodology documentation, deliverable and workplan templates, and enablement material for future delivery staff

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE — FIRST 12 MONTHS

  • Runs data collection, analysis, and deliverable creation without day-to-day direction
  • All assigned projects completed within their contracted phase windows, with any extension attributable to partner-side issues rather than controllable delivery-side issues
  • Recommendations are traced to a defensible, clinically- or operationally-grounded finding with solid financial implications outlined
  • Physician and clinical stakeholders engage with the findings rather than dispute the data
  • At least one offering materially revised — phase length, data requirements, or deliverable format — because of what execution revealed
  • Brings a point of view to offering design and scaling discussions rather than only executing decisions made elsewhere

Qualifications

Required

  • 3+ years in healthcare consulting or a related field, and 2–3+ years in an operational, quality, or performance improvement role within a health system
  • Cardiovascular registry depth: STS Adult Cardiac Surgery Database, NCDR CathPCI
  • Working knowledge of hospital clinical quality programs and registry data, or direct experience working with clinical quality or registry data

jobs.excerpt: About SynapticureAs a patient and caregiver-founded company, Synapticure provides instant access to expert neurologists, cutting-edge treatments and trials, and wraparound care coordination and behavioral health support in all 50 states through a virtual care platform.
jobs.description:
About Synapticure

As a patient and caregiver-founded company, Synapticure provides instant access to expert neurologists, cutting-edge treatments and trials, and wraparound care coordination and behavioral health support in all 50 states through a virtual care platform. Partnering with providers and health plans, including CMS' new GUIDE dementia care model, Synapticure is dedicated to transforming the lives of millions of individuals and their families living with neurodegenerative diseases like Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, and ALS.
Synapticure’s Cognitive Care team delivers personalized, comprehensive care to patients and caregivers navigating memory and cognitive disorders, from early-stage mild cognitive impairment to advanced dementias. Our clinicians combine evidence-based medicine with technology-enabled care coordination to simplify access and ensure patients receive expert, compassionate support wherever they live.

The Role

Synapticure is seeking a Telehealth Cognitive Care Neurologist to provide expert clinical care for patients living with Alzheimer’s disease, dementia, and related cognitive disorders. In this role, you will conduct comprehensive virtual evaluations, diagnose and manage complex neurodegenerative conditions, and collaborate closely with interdisciplinary team members—including advanced practice providers (APPs), behavioral health specialists, and care coordinators—to ensure a seamless and supportive patient experience.
As a Cognitive Neurologist, you will play a critical leadership role in both direct patient care and clinical oversight, supervising APPs across multiple states and ensuring adherence to clinical standards and telehealth regulations. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in cognitive neurology including memory disorders, thrives in a virtual care environment, and is passionate about expanding access to specialized neurological care for patients and families across the country.

The Day to Day

  • Conduct virtual consultations, cognitive assessments, and diagnostic evaluations for patients with Alzheimer’s disease, dementia, mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and related conditions
  • Supervise and collaborate with Advanced Practice Providers (APPs) across multiple states, providing clinical guidance and ensuring adherence to practice standards and state regulatory requirements
  • Develop individualized, evidence-based care plans that incorporate pharmacologic management, cognitive therapy recommendations, and supportive care strategies
  • Oversee the prescription of medications, ordering of diagnostic tests, and interpretation of results as part of comprehensive patient care
  • Collaborate with behavioral health clinicians, care coordinators, and other interdisciplinary team members to optimize care continuity and quality outcomes
  • Participate in case conferences and team meetings to review complex cases and contribute to clinical decision-making
  • Stay current with emerging therapies, including anti-amyloid and disease-modifying treatments for dementia, and support patient education regarding these options
  • Support caregiver engagement and education, helping families understand disease progression, treatment plans, and available resources
  • Document all encounters accurately and promptly in the electronic health record (EHR), ensuring compliance with telehealth and regulatory standards
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of Synapticure’s cognitive care protocols, leveraging technology to streamline care delivery and enhance patient experience

    • Research, Innovation, and Clinical Trials

    At Synapticure, we believe that advancing dementia care requires not only excellence in clinical practice but also active participation in research and innovation. As part of our Cognitive Care program, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with leading research organizations and industry partners to bring cutting-edge therapies to patients through clinical trials and real-world evidence initiatives. Our clinicians contribute to the design and implementation of studies evaluating new diagnostic tools, biomarkers, and disease-modifying treatments for Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias. Physicians interested in academic engagement will also have opportunities to lead or co-author research publications, present findings at conferences, and mentor team members in evidence-based practice development—all while working in a forward-thinking, mission-driven healthcare environment.

Minimum Qualifications

  • MD or DO from an accredited institution
  • Completion of a residency in Neurology, with fellowship training in Behavioral/Cognitive Neurology or equivalent experience strongly preferred
  • Board certification in Neurology (ABPN) required
  • Active, unrestricted medical license in at least one U.S. state; multi-state or IMLC eligibility preferred
  • 3+ years of clinical experience managing patients with memory or cognitive disorders
  • Demonstrated proficiency in telemedicine platforms and digital tools for conducting virtual neurological evaluations

jobs.description:
【公司简介】

我们是全球最早也是最成熟的数字资产平台之一，服务于全球数千万用户。我们始终位列全球Top交易所之列，提供涵盖数千种数字资产的全面交易和财富管理产品。我们拥有遍布全球主要金融中心的数千名员工，秉持远程优先、高度自主的企业文化，吸引着那些在快节奏、高挑战性环境中蓬勃发展的优秀人才。

【岗位职责】

一、行情与实时数据系统

1.负责 Web3 行情系统的后端架构设计与开发，覆盖链上行情、DEX 池子数据、订单簿、成交流、K 线等多类实时数据的采集、清洗、聚合、存储与分发。

2.构建低延迟、高吞吐、可水平扩展的实时计算链路，保障行情数据在高并发场景下的稳定性、一致性与时效性。

3.设计并实现实时数据推送服务（WebSocket / gRPC Streaming 等），支撑前端、策略、交易等下游业务对实时行情的消费需求。

二、链上数据中台建设

1.负责链上数据中台的整体设计与落地，构建从节点接入、区块解析、事件解码到结构化存储的完整数据链路。

2.负责区块、交易、事件日志的解析与解码（Log Decode、Trace 解析、内部交易还原等），将原始链上数据转化为业务可消费的结构化数据。

3.抽象多链数据模型，沉淀通用的解析框架与数据资产，支撑行情、交易、钱包、预测市场等上层业务。

4.构建实时数据监控与报警机制，覆盖节点健康度、数据延迟、数据完整性、解析异常等关键指标。

【任职要求】

一、技术基础

1.5 年以上后端开发经验，语言 Java 或 Go 均可，熟悉 Java 者更佳

Java 方向：3 年以上 Java 实战经验，熟悉 JVM 调优、并发编程，掌握 Spring 生态。

Go 方向：3 年以上 Golang 实战经验，精通并发模型（Goroutine / Channel）、标准库及主流框架（Gin / Go-zero / Gorm）。

2.熟练掌握微服务架构与分布式系统设计（消息队列、分布式锁、熔断限流、幂等设计等）。

3.精通 SQL / NoSQL 数据库优化，熟悉 Redis 缓存设计及 Kafka 异步处理。

4.具备实时计算系统的落地经验，熟悉状态管理、背压、容错、Exactly-Once 等机制；使用过 Akka 或 Pekko、Reactor（或 Project Reactor / RxJava）、Redis Stream。

5.至少 3 年 Web3 开发经验，理解区块链基本原理（共识、P2P、Gas / 手续费模型等），熟悉交易流程与合约交互机制。

6.熟悉主流公链交互机制，要求熟悉 EVM 与 Solana；熟悉 Move / Sui 者优先。

7.具备链上数据中台、行情系统或类似数据平台的项目经验，熟悉 Log Decode、ABI 解析、Trace / Internal Tx 处理等，主导过多链数据模型抽象或通用解析框架的建设。

8.主导过中大型后端系统或数据平台从 0 到 1 的架构设计与落地。

具备较强的学习能力，能快速跟进新技术、新公链、新协议，并判断其在业务中的实际价值与落地路径。

二、AI 工程能力

1.日常使用 AI Coding Agent 开发，并有相应工程沉淀。

2.具备搭建 Agent Harness、编写 Skills / Prompts 的实践经验。

3.了解 MCP、Tool Use、RAG、Eval 等概念及其工程落地边界。

【加分项】

1.有大数据实时与离线计算经验（Flink、Spark、Storm 等），熟悉 Lambda / Kappa 架构。

2.有 DEX（Uniswap V2 / V3、Curve、Raydium、Orca 等）池子状态维护、价格计算、聚合行情相关经验。

3.有 MEV、Mempool 监听、抢跑保护等相关经验。

4.有时序数据库（如 TimescaleDB、Druid、ClickHouse）在行情场景下的落地经验。

5.有围绕 AI Coding 的内部工具、Skill 库、Agent 工作流等沉淀经验。

6.有开源社区贡献或技术博客输出。

PSI Medical Monitors provide medical input to global clinical studies and advise the teams and business partners, while always focusing on patients' safety and well-being.

Home-Based in Argentina

Responsibilities:

  • Acts as the primary point of contact for all parties on all trial-specific medical and safety-related questions
  • Provides input for responses to regulatory authorities and Institutional Review Boards (IRBs)/Independent Ethics Committees (IECs) on trial-specific medical and safety-related questions
  • Monitors trial participant safety
  • Participates in trial participant recruitment boost and retention activities
  • Presents on medical matters at kick-off and investigator meetings
  • Trains trial team in the therapeutic area and medical aspects of the protocol
  • Develops and reviews trial-specific documents within the scope of medical monitoring
  • Manages ongoing trial risks related to medical monitoring
  • Performs ongoing medical review of the operational clinical trial database; provides support to Medical Reviewer(s) assigned to the trial
  • Reviews protocol deviations
  • Reviews RAE reports, writes and/or reviews SAE narratives, supports Pharmacovigilance team with outstanding safety queries, interacts with sponsor on site safety issues
  • Reviews IND/SUSAR Safety Reports, updates/amendments to essential trial records, and annual IND reports with sponsor data (per sponsor request)
  • Participates in management of trial-related committees (e.g., independent data monitoring committee (IDMC)/adjudication committees) as described in the corresponding trial-specific charter(s)
  • Supports Pharmacovigilance, Medical Data Review and Data Management with reconciliation of safety and operational clinical trial databases
  • Reviews clinical study reports (CSRs), including safety narratives and tables, figures, and listings (TFLs)
  • Provides medical expertise on an as-needed basis in trials where medical monitoring is not a contract deliverable
  • Prepares for and participates in trial audits, follows up on audit findings
  • Participates in feasibility assessment of potential and ongoing trials in the country/region
  • Participates in bid defense meetings and other interactions with clients
  • Acts as a medical expert and provides therapeutic expertise to other PSI departments
  • Medical Doctor degree required
  • Experience as a practicing Gastroenterologist (minimum of 10 years)
  • Clinical Research experience preferred
  • Full working proficiency in English and Spanish
  • Proficiency with MS Office applications
  • Communication, presentation and analytical skills
  • Problem-solving, team and detail-oriented

As part of PSI's Medical Monitoring team, you will join our international group of medical professionals, build a career on the frontline of medical science and use your knowledge and expertise to help bring new medications to patients that need them.

PSI is a leading Contract Research Organization with more than 30 years in the industry, offering a perfect balance between stability and innovation to both clients and employees. We focus on delivering quality and on-time services across a variety of therapeutic indications.

我们拥有遍布全球主要金融中心的数千名员工，秉持远程优先、高度自主的企业文化，吸引着那些在快节奏、高挑战性环境中如鱼得水的优秀人才。我们正在构建下一代互联网的金融基础设施——我们正在寻找杰出的专业人士加入我们，共同塑造这一未来。

关于这个方向
这块业务覆盖合约跟单、CFD 跟单、美股实盘跟单，以及现货网格、马丁策略、期限套利等机器人业务，同时正在探索 AI 对话策略方向。这不是一个维护功能列表的岗位。我们需要一个真正理解交易行为、能在产品复杂度和用户理解之间找到平衡点的人。

你会负责什么
1、深入研究新手、进阶、和专业用户如何在跟单、机器人和自建策略之间做选择，并将洞察转化为产品决策
2、与工程、量化研究、AI、风控、设计、运营等团队协同，澄清需求取舍，持续推动产品高质量上线
3、持续追踪跟单交易、量化工具和 AI 投资类产品的前沿动态，形成自己的判断，而不是机械复制功能
4、围绕量化策略方向，推动经典机器人策略优化、策略参数可理解性设计、AI 策略探索、策略表现与归因展示等功能落地
5、围绕跟单交易方向，优化交易员发现与信任体系、跟单配置与风控体验、多品类跟单建设、仓位透明度与信任信号设计

我们希望你具备
1、对交易行为和金融产品有真实兴趣，进入复杂领域时能快速找到核心逻辑，而不是停留在表面功能
2、有较强的独立驱动力；需求不清晰时，你会主动定义目标、厘清路径，而不是等待被推动
3、能理解风险决策场景下的用户心理：为什么用户会选择某个交易员、中途关掉机器人、调整参数或彻底失去信任
4、有清晰的产品判断力：一个跟单界面或策略配置页面有没有把复杂信息讲清楚、风险展示是否会造成误导，你能看出来
5、具备良好的跨职能沟通能力，能在技术、量化研究、风控和业务之间建立共识，而不只是在中间传话

加分项
1、有跟单交易、社交交易（Social Trading）、交易机器人或量化平台类产品的完整项目经验

2、对跟单或量化策略其中一个方向的交易工具有浓厚兴趣，是主流平台产品的重度用户

3、有 AI 产品方向的思考或经验，理解自然语言交互如何与专业金融工具结合

4、有用户研究、数据分析或 A/B 实验经验，能将行为数据转化为产品洞察

jobs.title: Web3 研发工程师（资深）— 交易询价方向
jobs.excerpt: 【岗位职责】一、交易聚合与路由1. 负责 Web3 聚合交易系统的后端架构设计与开发，整合多条公链、多个 DEX 及做市商流动性来源。 2.
jobs.description:
【岗位职责】

一、交易聚合与路由

1.负责 Web3 聚合交易系统的后端架构设计与开发，整合多条公链、多个 DEX 及做市商流动性来源。

2.设计并实现路由算法与最优路径选择策略，平衡价格、滑点、Gas、成交概率等多目标。

3.负责交易构造、签名、广播、状态追踪的完整链路，保障高并发与网络拥堵场景下的稳定性与成功率。

二、询价与做市商接入

1.设计并实现询价（RFQ / Quote）系统，接入链上池子、链下做市商、CEX 等多类报价源。

2.负责做市商接入协议的设计与实现，覆盖报价订阅、更新、成交确认与风控校验。

3.构建报价质量评估与做市商分级机制，动态调整路由权重。

三、高并发与低延迟

1.优化询价、路由、交易链路的端到端延迟与吞吐能力。

2.设计交易风控与限流机制，覆盖滑点保护、价格偏离、重放保护、Gas 异常等场景。

【任职要求】

一、技术基础

1.5 年以上后端开发经验，3 年以上 Golang 实战经验，精通并发模型（Goroutine / Channel）、标准库及主流框架（Gin / Go-zero / Gorm）。

2.熟练掌握微服务架构与分布式系统设计（消息队列、分布式锁、熔断限流、幂等设计等）。

3.精通 SQL / NoSQL 数据库优化，熟悉 Redis 缓存设计及 Kafka 异步处理。

具备低延迟、高并发系统的设计与优化经验。

4.至少 3 年 Web3 开发经验，理解区块链基本原理，熟悉交易流程与合约交互机制。

5.熟悉主流公链交互机制，要求熟悉 EVM 与 Solana；熟悉 Sui / Ton 者优先。

熟悉交易构造、签名、广播、Nonce 管理、Gas 策略等链上交易全链路，具备主网交易系统的实战经验。

6.熟悉主流 DEX（Uniswap V2 / V3、Curve、Raydium、Orca 等）的池子模型、价格计算与状态维护。

7.具备聚合器（如 1inch、Jupiter、OKX 等）的实际开发经验，主导或深度参与过路由算法、报价聚合或交易执行链路的设计与落地。

8.主导过中大型后端系统从 0 到 1 的架构设计与落地。

9.具备较强的学习能力，能快速跟进新技术、新公链、新协议，并判断其在业务中的实际价值与落地路径。

二、AI 工程能力

1.日常使用 AI Coding Agent 开发，并有相应工程沉淀。

2.具备搭建 Agent Harness、编写 Skills / Prompts 的实践经验。

3.了解 MCP、Tool Use、RAG、Eval 等概念及其工程落地边界。

【加分项】

1.有做市商系统、报价引擎、订单管理（OMS）相关的开发经验。

2.有 MEV、Mempool 监听、Bundle 提交（如 Flashbots、Jito）等相关经验。

3.有跨链桥、跨链交易、Intent-based 交易（CoW、UniswapX、Across 等）相关的开发经验。

4.有围绕 AI Coding 的内部工具、Skill 库、Agent 工作流等沉淀经验。

5.有开源社区贡献或技术博客输出。

  • 具备较强的合规风险意识，能主动识别并解决产品中的合规问题。
  • 熟悉产品全生命周期管理，能独立撰写PRD并推动产品落地。
  • 具备良好的跨部门沟通与协作能力，能与法务、风控、技术、运营团队紧密合作。

jobs.excerpt: At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.
jobs.description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.

We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.

We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Data Developer (Analytics Engineer) who serves as a bridge between business and technology — someone who not only masters the technical stack but also brings strategic vision, deep understanding of business logic, and a proactive approach to solution design.

This professional will own the complete lifecycle of data products — from ingestion and modeling through final delivery — ensuring that data is structured, validated, and ready for consumption in AI and analytics environments. We need someone who communicates confidently with business stakeholders (both technical and non-technical), deeply understands the requirements behind requests, and translates them into robust, scalable technical solutions.

Responsibilities:

  • Business Translation & Requirements Definition: Actively engage with business stakeholders to understand context, challenges, and underlying needs; translate complex requirements into clear, detailed technical specifications that enable effective use of AI and analytics platforms.

  • End-to-End Product Ownership: Take full responsibility for the data products you build — from ingestion through modeling, transformation, validation, to final delivery and ongoing monitoring.

  • Data Quality Assurance & Validation: Implement and maintain rigorous validation processes, automated testing, and quality checks; act as guardian of data accuracy and integrity, ensuring metrics and KPIs accurately reflect business reality.

  • Data Modeling & Transformation: Design and implement data transformation layers that pre-aggregate business information, apply consistent business rules, and deliver datasets ready for consumption in dashboards and AI applications.

  • AI Enablement & Data Structuring: Collaborate with AI teams to specify and prepare structured data, data dictionaries, and models that enable AI platforms and intelligent reporting capabilities.

  • Full-Stack Data Development: Build and maintain data ingestion pipelines from multiple sources, implement transformations in SQL and Python, and ensure performance and scalability of solutions.

  • Proactive Problem Solving: Go beyond fulfilling requirements — proactively identify improvement opportunities, anticipate internal customer needs, propose innovative solutions, and challenge approaches when necessary.

  • Agile & High-Quality Delivery: Deliver reliable data solutions with speed and precision, balancing the need for rapid iteration with the highest quality standards.

  • Stakeholder Communication: Articulate technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences; facilitate alignments, present solution proposals, and document modeling and architecture decisions.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience in a Data Engineering or Analytics Engineering role at senior level

  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python for data analysis, transformation, and validation

  • Solid experience in data modeling and data warehouse design

  • Hands-on experience working with BigQuery (or other cloud-based data warehouse platform)

  • Demonstrated ability to understand complex business logic and validate results from a business perspective, not just technical

  • Strong sense of ownership and proactive mindset — a professional who proposes improvements, challenges requirements when necessary, and doesn't wait to be asked to act

  • Experience specifying and preparing data requirements for AI or machine learning applications

  • Advanced/fluent English (reading, writing, and conversation) — constant communication with international stakeholders is required

  • Track record of delivering high-impact projects quickly and with quality

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with dbt (data build tool) for transformation and orchestration of analytical pipelines

  • Familiarity with data ingestion tools such as Airbyte or Airflow

  • Knowledge of automated testing best practices and CI/CD for data pipelines

  • Prior experience in Supply Chain, Retail, or Consumer Goods industries

  • Experience in projects involving data preparation for consumption via generative AI or conversational analytics platforms

  • Experience building business-oriented analytical reports (web reporting, custom visualizations)

Our benefits include:

- Premium Healthcare
- Meal voucher
- Maternity and Parental leaves
- Mobile services subsidy
- Sick pay-Life insurance
- CI&T University
- Colombian Holidays
- Paid Vacations
And many others.
Collaboration is our superpower, diversity unites us, and excellence is our standard.
We value diverse identities and life experiences, fostering a diverse, inclusive, and safe work environment. We encourage applications from diverse and underrepresented groups to our job positions.

jobs.description:
【岗位职责】

一、钱包账户体系

1.负责钱包账户系统的架构设计与演进，统一管理助记词、私钥、硬件、MPC、托管（Turnkey 等）、机器人钱包、保险箱等多类账户形态。

2.主导异构账户体系的融合与抽象，沉淀统一的账户模型与 Web3 ID 能力，支撑钱包及其他业务方的接入需求。

3.设计对外可接入的钱包能力，对其他业务线开放标准化的账户、签名、交易接口，避免业务方重复自建。

二、钱包核心服务

1.负责钱包核心后端服务的设计与开发，覆盖资产管理、代币列表、交易历史、上链广播、Gas 策略等关键链路。

2.负责大规模钱包数据（账户、资产、交易历史等亿级数据量）的存储设计、查询性能与版本兼容性。

3.负责钱包与中台基础能力（行情、Token、节点 RPC、资产）的集成与解耦，推动公共能力下沉、钱包业务上浮。

三、多链支持与上链

1.负责钱包多链支持的接入与维护，覆盖 EVM、Solana 及其他主流公链。

2.负责交易构造、签名、广播、状态追踪的完整链路，保障在网络拥堵、Nonce 冲突等场景下的稳定性。

【任职要求】

一、技术基础

1.5 年以上后端开发经验，3 年以上 Golang 实战经验，精通并发模型（Goroutine / Channel）、标准库及主流框架（Gin / Go-zero / Gorm）。

2.熟练掌握微服务架构与分布式系统设计（消息队列、分布式锁、熔断限流、幂等设计等）。

3.精通 SQL / NoSQL 数据库优化，熟悉 Redis 缓存设计及 Kafka 异步处理；具备亿级数据量场景下的存储设计与查询优化经验。

4.主导过中大型后端系统从 0 到 1 的架构设计与落地，具备账户、订单、资产等核心域的建模经验。

5.至少 3 年 Web3 开发经验，理解区块链基本原理，熟悉交易流程与合约交互机制。

6.熟悉主流公链交互机制，要求熟悉 EVM 与 Solana；熟悉 Move / Sui 者优先。

7.熟悉交易构造、签名、广播、Nonce 管理、Gas 策略等链上交易全链路，具备主网钱包或交易系统的实战经验。

8.具备较强的学习能力，能快速跟进新技术、新公链、新协议，并判断其在业务中的实际价值与落地路径。

二、钱包专项

1.熟悉主流钱包账户体系，包括助记词 / 私钥 / 硬件钱包 / MPC / 托管钱包等的原理与差异，理解各类账户的安全模型与使用场景。

2.具备钱包后端的实际开发经验，主导或深度参与过账户系统、资产模块、交易历史等核心模块的设计与落地。

3.具备多账户体系融合、抽象与对外开放能力建设的经验，或对此方向有清晰的方法论。

三、AI 工程能力

1.日常使用 AI Coding Agent 开发，并有相应工程沉淀。

2.具备搭建 Agent Harness、编写 Skills / Prompts 的实践经验。

3.了解 MCP、Tool Use、RAG、Eval 等概念及其工程落地边界。

【加分项】

1.有 MPC / TSS 钱包后端的开发经验，或熟悉 Turnkey、Fireblocks、Privy 等托管钱包方案。

2.有 AA 智能合约钱包（EIP-4337 / EIP-7702、Safe、Biconomy 等）相关的开发经验。

3.有亿级数据量下的数据迁移、版本兼容、双写切换等实战经验。

4.有钱包安全相关经验（密钥管理、签名风控、欺诈检测等）。

5.有围绕 AI Coding 的内部工具、Skill 库、Agent 工作流等沉淀经验。

6.有开源社区贡献或技术博客输出。

【公司简介】

我们是全球最早也是最成熟的数字资产平台之一，服务于全球数千万用户。我们始终位列全球Top交易所之列，提供涵盖数千种数字资产的全面交易和财富管理产品。我们拥有遍布全球主要金融中心的数千名员工，秉持远程优先、高度自主的企业文化，吸引着那些在快节奏、高挑战性环境中蓬勃发展的优秀人才。

【岗位职责】

1、核心研发：研发和优化核心交易组件，包括撮合模块、订单处理、订单簿数据结构和低延迟服务链路。

2、高并发与性能调优：深入代码逻辑、内存管理、并发模型（线程/协程）、网络 IO 及操作系统行为，攻克高吞吐与极低延迟场景下的性能瓶颈。

3、高可用与稳定性：落地与完善高可用机制，保障系统在极端行情、硬件故障下的故障切换、恢复、降级及业务连续性。

4、提升工程质量，完善测试、可观测性、日志、指标、链路追踪、文档和故障复盘机制。

【任职要求】

1、5 年以上后端经验（技术栈不限），且近几年专注于高并发高可用的核心系统

2、精通 Linux 网络编程（Socket、TCP/IP或异步 IO 模型），深入理解多线程/多进程/协程并发编程与内存模型

3、能精准定位并解决内存布局/垃圾回收（GC）、CPU Cache、网络路径及系统限制带来的性能瓶颈

4、在突发故障或极端行情高压下保持冷静，具备严谨的排障思路、谨慎的发布习惯与完善的可观测性意识

【加分项】

1、业务背景：有撮合引擎、订单簿、行情系统、券商系统、高频交易（HFT）开发经验

1、熟悉无锁（Lock-Free）结构、NUMA 架构、用户态网络栈（DPDK/Kernel Bypass）或硬件加速。
