About Us:

CALSTART is now Catalyst Mobility. We are a mission-driven industry organization focused on transportation decarbonization and clean air for all.

For over 30 years, it’s been Catalyst Mobility’s mission to develop, assess, and implement large-scale, zero-emission transportation solutions to mitigate climate change and support economic growth. Catalyst Mobility works with businesses, organizations, governments, and communities to create real-life impact toward clean air and equitable access to clean transportation for all. Catalyst Mobility provides scientific, technical and policy support for regulatory development and clean technology and infrastructure acceleration.

About The Role

​​CALSTART is seeking a Salesforce Administrator/Developer to support an exciting organization-wide centralization initiative following the acquisition of Forth. This role will help bring two Salesforce environments together, leading the migration of data and supporting the configuration and development needed to establish Membership Services and Business Development workflows within CALSTART’s Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud environment.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is comfortable working across Salesforce administration, development, data migration, and solution configuration. You’ll work closely with CALSTART’s Platform/Technology team and business stakeholders to translate existing processes into scalable Salesforce solutions, configure and build workflows and automation, support data mapping and migration, and help ensure the new centralized environment is secure, maintainable, and ready for long-term use across the organization.​

Duties & Responsibilities:

    ​​* Help lead a major Salesforce centralization initiative, bringing Forth’s existing Salesforce data and processes into CALSTART’s Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud environment and helping establish a strong foundation for future organizational growth.
    * Plan and execute the Salesforce-to-Salesforce data migration, including data mapping, cleansing, validation, migration execution, and reconciliation to ensure critical organizational and historical data is transitioned accurately.
    * Configure and develop Membership Services and Business Development workflows, using Salesforce automation, objects, permissions, reporting, and custom development where needed to create scalable, intuitive solutions for our teams.
    * Partner closely with business stakeholders and CALSTART’s Platform/Technology team to understand current processes, identify opportunities for improvement, and translate requirements into practical Salesforce solutions.
    * Support testing, deployment, documentation, and stabilization of the new centralized environment, helping ensure the solution is secure, maintainable, well-documented, and ready for long-term organizational use.​

What You'll Bring to the Table:

    * A builder’s mindset with a designer’s perspective — someone who can take a business need, think through the best solution, and then roll up their sleeves and build it.
    * Ownership and curiosity, with the ability to take on a significant project, ask the right questions, identify gaps, and help drive the work forward rather than waiting for detailed instructions.
    * Creative problem-solving balanced with Salesforce best practices, helping us build solutions that meet today’s needs without creating unnecessary complexity or technical debt.
    * Strong partnership and communication skills, with the ability to work directly with business stakeholders, understand how teams operate, and translate those needs into thoughtful Salesforce solutions.
    * A consultative approach, bringing recommendations and lessons learned to the table and helping CALSTART make informed decisions about configuration, data structure, automation, migration, and long-term platform design.

Desired Qualifications:

    * Hands-on experience with Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud, including designing and configuring solutions for nonprofit business processes. Nonprofit Cloud experience is a key qualification for this role; experience limited primarily to Sales Cloud will not be sufficient.
    * Demonstrated experience working across both Salesforce administration and development, including Flow, automation, data modeling, permissions/security, reporting, integrations, and custom development where appropriate.
    * Experience planning and executing Salesforce-to-Salesforce migrations, including data mapping, transformation, cleansing, migration, validation, and reconciliation.
    * Experience designing Salesforce solutions for areas such as membership, fundraising/philanthropy, constituent or relationship management, and business development strongly preferred.
    * Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Administrator, Platform App Builder, Platform Developer, or relevant Nonprofit Cloud credentials are preferred, along with demonstrated knowledge of Salesforce architecture and implementation best practices.

We understand that not everyone will match the above qualifications 100%. If your background isn't perfectly aligned but you feel you would be a great addition to the team, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Account Manager Dakpannen
jobs.excerpt: Bouw mee aan de verdere groei van Randers Tegl in NederlandRanders Tegl is een internationaal familiebedrijf met een historie die teruggaat tot 1911.
jobs.description:
Bouw mee aan de verdere groei van Randers Tegl in Nederland

Randers Tegl is een internationaal familiebedrijf met een historie die teruggaat tot 1911. Vanuit Scandinavië en Duitsland is de organisatie uitgegroeid tot een toonaangevende leverancier van keramische gevel- en dakproducten, met klanten op zes continenten.

De Nederlandse markt heeft daarbij een bijzondere plek. De geschiedenis van Laumans – waarvan de oorsprong teruggaat tot 1896 – is sterk verbonden met Nederland. De naam Laumans heeft hier door de jaren heen een stevige reputatie opgebouwd op het gebied van hoogwaardige, premium dakpannen. Sinds 2025 is Laumans volledig onderdeel van de Randers Tegl Group.

Voor de verdere ontwikkeling van de Nederlandse markt zoeken we een ervaren Accountmanager Dakpannen.

Een commerciële professional die de bouw- en dakensector kent, weet hoe de distributieketen werkt en energie krijgt van het uitbouwen van een bestaande marktpositie. Je krijgt daarbij veel vrijheid om zelf richting te geven aan je markt, maar staat er niet alleen voor. Je werkt nauw samen met een collega in Nederland en met de commerciële organisatie in Duitsland.

Jouw uitdaging

In Nederland is Randers Tegl al een gevestigde naam en wordt momenteel circa €3 miljoen omzet gerealiseerd. Samen met je Nederlandse collega krijg je de verantwoordelijkheid om deze positie verder uit te bouwen.

De strategie kent daarbij twee kanten. Enerzijds versterk je de positie binnen het bestaande distributienetwerk van groothandels en distributeurs. Anderzijds creëer je vraag in de markt door rechtstreeks contact te onderhouden met partijen als dakdekkers, aannemers en architecten.

Je kent de markt, weet wie de relevante spelers zijn en ziet waar commerciële kansen ontstaan. Die kansen vertaal je naar concrete acties en uiteindelijk naar omzet en marktaandeel.

Dit is daarmee nadrukkelijk geen functie waarin je alleen bestaande klanten beheert. Je krijgt een bestaande basis mee en wordt verantwoordelijk voor de verdere ontwikkeling daarvan.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Ontwikkelen van de Nederlandse markt: je identificeert commerciële kansen, volgt marktontwikkelingen en bepaalt waar en hoe Randers Tegl verder kan groeien.
  • Uitbouwen van relaties en distributie: je beheert en ontwikkelt relaties met distributeurs, groothandels en andere partijen in de bouwketen, waaronder aannemers, dakdekkers en architecten.
  • Genereren en realiseren van new business: je creëert zelfstandig nieuwe leads, volgt kansen actief op en voert onderhandelingen van eerste contact tot deal.
  • Sturen op sales en resultaat: je beheert de salesfunnel, werkt gestructureerd met CRM en houdt grip op prospects, offertes, pipeline en forecast.
  • Samenwerken aan de commerciële strategie: je werkt nauw samen met je Nederlandse collega en de organisatie in Duitsland en brengt jouw marktkennis in bij marketing, category management en het jaarlijkse salesplan.

Veel vrijheid

Je werkt vanuit je eigen home office en bent veel onderweg bij klanten, distributeurs en andere marktpartijen. Je hebt daarmee veel vrijheid om je eigen agenda en commerciële aanpak te bepalen.

Tegelijkertijd ben je onderdeel van een internationale commerciële organisatie. Iedere week heb je online salesoverleg met je Nederlandse collega en de Group Head of Strategic Business Development, die vanuit Duitsland verantwoordelijk is voor de commerciële aansturing. Samen bespreek je onder meer de salesfunnel, orderpipeline, marktontwikkelingen en commerciële prioriteiten.

Je werkt daarnaast samen met collega's binnen Marketing, Back Office en Category Management. Zij ondersteunen onder andere bij leadgeneratie, offertes, orders, leveringen en voorraad.

De Duitse organisatie is daarmee niet alleen de plek waar je naar rapporteert, maar een belangrijk onderdeel van je dagelijkse commerciële samenwerking. Af en toe ben je dan ook aanwezig op de Duitse locatie in Brüggen.

Jouw talent

We zoeken een ervaren salesprofessional die gewend is om zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor een markt of klantgebied. Affiniteit met de bouw en kennis van de dynamiek tussen fabrikanten, groothandels, aannemers en uitvoerende partijen zijn essentieel.

  • minimaal 7 jaar commerciële ervaring, bij voorkeur met distributiepartners of groothandels;
  • minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen de bouwmaterialenbranche of een vergelijkbare klantomgeving;
  • HBO werk- en denkniveau, vanuit een commerciële, bedrijfskundige of technische achtergrond;
  • ervaring met het ontwikkelen van new business én het uitbouwen van bestaande accounts;
  • ervaring met prospecting, onderhandelen, deal closing en salesfunnelmanagement;
  • een goed begrip van de Nederlandse bouw- en distributiemarkt;
  • een zelfstandige en ondernemende manier van werken: je organiseert je eigen werk, ziet kansen en komt in actie;
  • een resultaatgerichte instelling, zonder de relatie met de klant uit het oog te verliezen;
  • uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands en goede beheersing van het Duits of Engels.

Onze belofte

  • Een zelfstandige commerciële positie. Je werkt grotendeels vanuit huis en bent zelf verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling van jouw markt.
  • Een bestaande markt om verder uit te bouwen. Je start niet vanaf nul. Randers Tegl heeft een gevestigde naam, een bestaand distributienetwerk en een Nederlandse omzet van circa €3 miljoen.
  • Directe invloed op de koers. Je hebt korte lijnen met de Group Head of Strategic Business Development en jouw inzichten uit de Nederlandse markt worden gebruikt voor de commerciële strategie.
  • Een internationale organisatie achter je. Je opereert zelfstandig in Nederland, maar werkt nauw samen met collega's in Duitsland op het gebied van sales, marketing, back office en category management.
  • Een sterk product. De dakpannen van Randers Tegl worden geproduceerd uit Tegelen klei en combineren natuurlijke uitstraling met technische kwaliteit. De collectie onderscheidt zich door uiteenlopende kleuren en oppervlakken, van extra mat tot hoogglans.
  • Een familiebedrijf met lange historie. Respect, samenwerking, kwaliteit en innovatie zijn belangrijke waarden binnen de organisatie.

Arbeidsvoorwaarden:

  • bruto jaarsalaris van circa €60.000 – €70.000, afhankelijk van ervaring;
  • eindejaarsbonus en aanvullende bonusregeling;
  • pensioenbijdrage;
  • leaseauto, ook voor privégebruik;
  • 30 vakantiedagen;
  • vergoeding voor internet en zakelijke kosten;
  • werken vanuit een eigen home office.

Dit is slechts een selectie van het aanbod voor de functie van Accountmanager, gebaseerd op een fulltime werkweek. Een gedetailleerd overzicht van het arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket wordt op verzoek door Talentable verstrekt.

Het sollicitatieproces

Dien je sollicitatie in via onze website of neem direct contact met ons op!

  • Voor inhoudelijke vragen over de functie en vragen over de sollicitatieprocedure kun je rechtstreeks contact opnemen met Hjalmar Wewerinke-van Marle via telefoon (+31 6 155 251 94) of e-mail ().
  • Selectieprocedure: deze bestaat uit twee interviews en mogelijk een online assessment.
  • Privacy: wij respecteren je privacy en behandelen de door jou gedeelde informatie strikt vertrouwelijk.

We kijken uit naar jouw sollicitatie!

We're not looking for generalists who dabble across the stack — we're looking for someone with deep backend craft who can move fast, build with AI as a core part of how they work, and take genuine ownership of what they ship.

We're hiring for a number of roles across both of our Technology teams: new product development and customer delivery. We'd love to talk to you about both teams, understand what excites you, and place you into the team where we think you'll thrive best.

What you’ll do

Backend engineering and architecture
  • Design, build, and own backend services and APIs that power our product — from data models to infrastructure to production reliability
  • Make sound architectural decisions that balance shipping speed against long-term maintainability and scale
  • Take ownership of significant technical areas — from identifying the right approach to shipping and iterating in production
Building and shipping with AI
  • Use AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, or equivalent) as a core, daily part of how you write and ship code — not an occasional add-on
  • Build working backend prototypes fast — good enough to validate with real usage, not over-engineered before it's proven
  • Know when a rough implementation is right for the moment and when production-grade engineering is needed — and apply that judgment confidently
  • Ship, measure, learn, iterate — kill what isn't working, double down on what is
Product and stakeholder collaboration
  • Work closely with product, design, and commercial stakeholders to translate customer problems into technical solutions
  • Act as a credible engineering voice in cross-functional discussions, pilot programmes, and technical scoping conversations
  • Partner with Customer Support, Program Management, and Demand Generation to understand how customers find, adopt, and stay with ev.energy
Raising the bar
  • Share what you learn openly, challenge how things are built, and raise the technical bar for the engineers around you
  • Model what AI-native backend engineering looks like in practice — not in theory
  • Contribute to a culture of experimentation, velocity, and commercial impact

Our tech stack
  • Python and Django for our core platform
  • Django REST Framework for our APIs
  • React, React Native and TypeScript for our web and mobile app
  • PostgreSQL, Redis and DynamoDB for data storage
  • AWS for hosting, with infrastructure managed as code using Terraform
  • Claude (via the Anthropic API) features to power AI

What we're looking for

Must-haves
  • Strong Python experience (5+ years), with a clear track record of building and shipping production backend systems
  • Experience building backend services with a Python framework (e.g Django, FastAPI or Flask)
  • Strong experience building with AI — you've taken AI-powered features or products from concept through to production, and use AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, or equivalent) as a genuine daily practice, not just occasionally
  • Solid understanding of backend fundamentals — APIs, data modelling, databases, system design, and production reliability
  • Experience leading technical decisions and influencing direction without relying on hierarchy
  • Strong communication skills — written, verbal, and technical — credible with engineers, product, and commercial stakeholders
  • High bias for action and comfort with ambiguity — you make good technical decisions with incomplete information
Nice to haves
  • Experience in energy, utilities, cleantech, or adjacent domains
  • Experience with Django
  • Familiarity with EV fleet operations, home energy management, or grid services
  • Front-end or full-stack capability that lets you prototype independently without blocking on others
  • A portfolio of backend systems, tools, or products that prove how you work
  • Direct customer conversation experience that's shaped what you've built

Salary, benefits & how we work

The salary range for this role is $169,000-$207,000 CAD.

Key benefits include:
  • Equity, in the form of share options (granted as a % of your salary)
  • Healthcare provided by Canada Life (Premium plan)

  • L&D allowance of $1,800 CAD per year
You can find out more about our full range of perks and benefits here.

Location & how we work
This role is fully remote in Canada, but we're specifically looking for someone based in EST.
The majority of people at ev.energy work on a fully remote basis, with a small number of roles based on-site in our testing sites.
This means that most of our people work from home, but we're happy to provide co-working subscriptions if you'd like to spend time at a WeWork (or other co-working space close to you).
We balance our remote set up by getting everyone together once a year for an offsite, as we know that spending time together IRL is super important.

Belonging at ev.energy

jobs.excerpt: OverviewFINANCE OPERATIONS CONTROLLERWe're not hiring a CFO.
jobs.description:
Overview

FINANCE OPERATIONS CONTROLLER

We're not hiring a CFO. We're not hiring a spreadsheet builder. We're not hiring someone who needs a team of five to do the work of one.

We need a Finance Operator. Someone who walks into organised chaos, rolls up their sleeves, oversees the right people and processes, and doesn't leave until it's a machine.


ABOUT AI ACQUISITION

AI Acquisition is the global category leader in AI service-provider enablement. We connect AI agencies with enterprise opportunities at scale through a hybrid PaaS and AI marketplace model. We operate across multiple entities, currencies, and geographies. We move fast, we spend big on ads, and our financial infrastructure needs to match the pace of the business.

We are not a 9-to-5 business. We are building something that matters and we need people who build with us.


THE ROLE

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will report directly to and support our Director of Finance, freeing them from the operational grind so they can focus on strategy and growth.

You will inherit a multi-entity structure with real operational complexity: live cash flow pressure, a payment infrastructure in transition, manual processes that need to be automated, and financial data that needs to be turned into clean, actionable systems.

Your mandate is simple: stabilize, systematize, and automate. You will oversee the people and processes that execute this work, and where needed, you will get into the detail yourself.

This role also demands genuine scale experience. We are looking for someone who has operated finance functions with high transaction volume and real operational complexity — not a controlled, low-volume environment — and who naturally approaches problems by building repeatable systems rather than one-off fixes.

Requirements

THIS IS NOT FOR YOU IF

  • You can only work independently and struggle to lead or direct others
  • You prefer building models over building systems
  • You manage from a distance rather than having genuine operational grip
  • You treat SOPs as someone else's job
  • You wait for direction instead of creating clarity
  • You call something "done" when it's documented but not implemented
  • You've only worked in low-volume, low-complexity finance environments

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Cash Flow & Treasury Oversight & Execution

  • Own the daily cash cycle across multiple entities.
  • Oversee and manage high-volume USD revenue flows from Whop into UAE bank accounts
  • Ensure seamless daily funding of GBP/AED corporate cards for Meta ad spend — ad accounts do not pause on your watch
  • Build a live cash visibility system so the Founding team sees the position at a glance, not after a request

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Ad accounts never pause because of cash flow
  • Payment infrastructure is fully transitioned and running without manual intervention
  • Every financial process has an SOP. Every SOP is being followed
  • The Director of Finance has more time to think because you handle the execution and oversight
  • Xero is clean, current, and trusted across all entities
  • Weekly reporting takes minutes to produce because the systems are built
  • Manual work is replaced by automated, tracked data — not spreadsheets, real systems

WHO YOU ARE

You've been in both the operational and leadership seat inside a fast-growing digital, e-commerce, or performance marketing business, ideally one with significant scale — high transaction volume, high daily cash movement, multiple currencies and entities running in parallel. You understand how cash actually moves, not theoretically, but operationally. You default to systems thinking: when something breaks, your instinct is to diagnose the root cause and build a process or automation that prevents it from recurring, not to patch it manually. You know how to build the systems and lead the people that keep them running. You know what it feels like when an ad account pauses at 2am because a card wasn't topped up, and you've built the infrastructure to make sure that never happens.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in a finance operations, treasury, or senior finance execution role — not advisory, not modelling, not investment banking
  • Direct experience operating in a high-volume, high-transaction-count environment — comfortable with real operational scale, not just a well-organized small-entity setup
  • A demonstrated systems-first approach to problem solving: builds repeatable processes and automations rather than one-off manual fixes
  • Experience leading or overseeing finance operations teams, external partners, or cross-functional processes
  • Direct hands-on experience managing high-volume, multi-currency cash flows (USD, GBP, AED)
  • Proven track record building and implementing SOPs in finance operations
  • Experience managing external bookkeeping or accounting firms and holding them to a standard
  • Strong working knowledge of Xero, Wise, Whop, and corporate card platforms (Pleo, Qashio or similar)
  • Someone who builds systems, not reports, and executes before being asked twice

Highly Desirable:

  • Experience with UAE corporate structures, specifically DMCC entities
  • Background in performance marketing businesses with high daily ad spend
  • Experience managing entity wind-downs or cross-border entity restructuring
  • Familiarity with Series A / early-scale finance environments — you know how to bring structure without bureaucracy

Benefits

OUR CULTURE — READ THIS BEFORE YOU APPLY

We are a high-performance, remote-first team operating in one of the fastest-moving sectors in the world. We do not have time for:

  • Vague updates and no ownership
  • Problems that get buried instead of surfaced
  • People who wait to be told what to do
  • Complexity that exists to impress rather than to solve

We do have time for:

  • People who see a mess and immediately start building the solution
  • Direct, clear communication even when it's uncomfortable
  • Operators who take ownership and don't need hand-holding
  • Anyone who can simplify the complex, lead others effectively, and automate the repetitive

You will work closely with the Director of Finance and have direct visibility into the executive layer. The people at the top of this company are operators. They expect the same from everyone around them.


WHY THIS ROLE, WHY NOW

We are scaling aggressively. Our ad spend is significant, our entity structure is multi-layered, and our financial operations need to match the ambition of the business. The Director of Finance needs a true operator and leader by their side, not a subordinate waiting for tasks, but someone who identifies what needs to be done, directs the right people, and gets it done.

If you are the person who walks into complexity and leaves behind systems and a team that runs them, this is your role.

If you need structure handed to you, this isn't for you.


Benefits

Why Join Us

  • Operate at the front line of AI-powered business building
  • Work directly with ambitious founders globally
  • Apply real-world experience, not theory or scripts
  • Fully remote, senior-level role with autonomy and ownership
  • Founder-led environment that values judgment over bureaucracy

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Implementation Managers to scope and sequence data work within broader project timelines
  • Coordinate with Data Operations on load specifications, environment readiness, and production deployment
  • Support Product and Engineering with data-informed feedback on schema changes, import tool capabilities, and customer-facing data features

Automation, ETL Awareness & Continuous Improvement

  • Contribute knowledge and expertise to the team's ETL pipeline and automation initiatives (pipeline orchestration, schema-as-code, automated validation)
  • Identify repetitive or manual work and build (or help build) scripts, templates, and workflows to reduce it

  • Maintain awareness of modern data engineering practices and tools that can improve migration delivery at scale

Qualifications:

  • In-depth experience writing SQL from scratch, including complex joins, CTEs, subqueries, window functions, and output validation
  • In-depth understanding of relational databases, structured data formats, and data modeling concepts
  • Demonstrated ability to manage Enterprise-level customer relationships from a detailed, technical perspective
  • Demonstrated experience serving as the go-to technical voice with customers, translating complex data topics into clear, actionable guidance
  • Proficiency mentoring and coaching others on SQL, data practices, and migration methodology
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Power Query, conditional formatting, data cleansing)
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent complex projects
  • Clear, professional written and verbal communication

Preferred Qualifications:

Sales Development Representative - Join Our Talent Community for Future Opportunities!

Join Our Talent Community for Future Opportunities!
Thank you for your interest in joining our team. By submitting your information, you’ll be added to our talent pool for consideration as new roles become available.

What to Expect:
  • Please fill out the general application and provide your resume
  • Your information will be reviewed and kept on file
  • We’ll reach out if a position becomes available that matches your skills and experience
Note: This is not an active job opening, but a way to express interest in future roles.

About the Role

You are the client’s first impression of Pushpay, representing yourself as a passionate, personable and professional individual who will be able to connect our prospects business needs to our service. In this role, you make outbound calls to potential clients who appear to be strong potential customers based upon our general market focus.

Named as one of BuiltIn ‘Best Places to Work’ in Seattle, Denver and Dallas for 2025; ranked number 10 by Seattle Business Magazine in the ‘Washington’s 100 Best Companies to Work For’ list in the large companies category for 2024; named as a 2025 'Best Places to Work for Women' by Best Companies Group.

Benefits and Compensation

We have a passion for making all employees feel supported. In addition to having a genuine interest in helping you do your best work and drive your career, we offer:

  • 100% employer-paid premiums for Medical HDHP Plan, Dental, and Vision for employee
  • 70% employer-paid premiums for Medical PPO Plan for employees, and Medical, Dental, and Vision for dependents
  • 401K match
  • Flexible working program
  • 12 paid company holidays
  • 2 paid Volunteer Time Off days
  • 15 days PTO to start, increases with tenure and seniority
  • Paid parental and adoption leave
  • Pay Range: $24.04 hourly + $20k variable = $70k OTE

The following states are approved as remote work locations for this position: AR, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IA, IL, IN, MD, MI, MN, MO, NC, OH, OK, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA, WA. All other states are not in consideration for this role at this time.

What You'll Do

  • Call Center environment, metric driven role, constant monitoring on performance.
  • Make outbound calls, emails and text messages to qualify churches and nonprofits.
  • Work with a team of driven individuals in a specialized account based sales environment.
  • Must make at least 70 cold outbound calls to potential customers a day.
  • Schedule 1-2 in person or zoom appointments per day between prospects and Account Executives.
  • Prospecting 5-10 accounts a day and maintaining a healthy pipeline.
  • Have meaningful conversations with our prospects to understand the challenges they face engaging their community.
  • Delve into prospect needs through value-based discovery and effectively articulate the unique value proposition of Pushpay.
  • Use best-in- class software like Salesforce and Outreach.io to build pipeline and manage follow-ups.
  • Blueprint accounts and update them with 3 accurate contacts along with phone and email.
  • Build revenue pipeline by setting introductory meetings with target influencers and key decision makers.
  • Invite church leaders to webinars, events, and other educational experiences.

What You'll Bring

  • A high school graduate (or holder of an equivalent degree).
  • 1+ years of inside sales experience, but none required.
  • Strong computer skills, proficient on; Mac OSX, Google Platforms, Salesforce.
  • Excellent communication and great listening skills including the ability to ask thoughtful questions in order to have meaningful conversations with our prospects to understand the challenges they face engaging their community.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Able to connect business needs to solutions.
  • Positivity and resilience with your team and customers.
  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Speaking on the phone.

Pushpay is committed to equal opportunity. We value and embrace diversity and inclusion of all Team Members. Pushpay uses E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility. Head to our career page to learn more.

If you have a disability under the Americans with Disabilities Act or similar law, or you require religious accommodation, and you wish to discuss potential accommodations related to applying for employment at Pushpay, please contact .

About Pushpay

Pushpay helps organizations and communities come to gather & stay connected, strengthening community, connection, and belonging through our suite of mobile apps, management software, and giving technology. Our 550 Pushpay teammates support 10,000+ customers as they drive social good, and we’re honored to have processed over $15 billion in charitable giving. We’re growing fast, including some exciting acquisitions in recent years, and we need driven talent. Join Pushpay and grow with us!

**Applications will be taken on an ongoing basis

jobs.title: Content Coordinator (1-Month Contract)
jobs.excerpt: About the Role:As a Content Coordinator, you’ll power BWZ’s content engine—the core of our business— by directly producing new content and updates using our in-house AI and automation technology.
jobs.description:
About the Role:

As a Content Coordinator, you’ll power BWZ’s content engine—the core of our business— by directly producing new content and updates using our in-house AI and automation technology.

This is a full-time contract position open to international hires outside of Canada, with an initial term of 1 month, and the possibility to extend to 3–6 months based on business needs and performance.

We are looking for a contributor to help with the production of new "best software" roundup content to help readers choose the right software, and another contributor to help with publishing software buyer's guide content that helps readers navigate purchasing decisions across a wide range of business topics on our 15-site portfolio.

Reporting to the assigned SEO Content Manager, you’ll work inside systems to generate, refine, and QA content across multiple publications, ensuring every piece is accurate, helpful, SEO-optimized, and delivered on schedule. You’ll translate Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), templates, and format standards into consistently excellent output at scale, while supporting freelance contributors when needed.

Beyond day-to-day production, you’ll help evolve the systems behind our content by identifying edge cases, surfacing recurring issues, and sharing insights that improve prompts, templates, and workflows. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in structured processes, loves creating clear and engaging content, and is excited to help shape the next generation of AI-native editorial operations.

What You’ll Be Doing (Responsibilities):

Produce New Content

  • Produce high-quality across BWZ publications using in-house automations, SOPs, templates, and formats.
  • Maintain strong output velocity while upholding accuracy, clarity, and SEO requirements.
  • Identify recurring issues, edge cases, or blockers and surface them to the Content Manager.

Own Content Quality

  • QA all assigned content—new and upgraded—to ensure accuracy, readability, SEO alignment, and brand consistency.
  • Ensure visuals, CTAs, internal links, and structural elements are implemented correctly.
  • Collaborate with the SEO Content Manager to improve the usefulness and performance of each content format and implement improvements at scale.
  • Ensure content is useful, helpful, and relevant to the reader and goes above and beyond competing articles.

How Your Success Will Be Measured:

  • Content Production & Velocity: The volume and consistency of new content and updates you produce—measured by your ability to meet or exceed publishing targets for your assigned formats.
  • Content Quality: The quality of the content you produce and upgrade—measured by adherence to editorial, SEO, and formatting standards, while minimizing revisions and QA issues.

Your Skillset Includes:

  • 2+ years of experience in content production, content coordination, editorial operations, or a similar role.
  • Strong writing, editing, and QA skills with attention to accuracy, clarity, and structure.
  • Background in SEO principles and on-page best practices (SEO writing, content marketing, or operational editorial work).
  • Experience working with or writing about SaaS products is an asset.
  • Ability to follow detailed SOPs, templates, and workflows with consistency and precision.
  • Comfort using AI tools as part of a structured editorial process.
  • Experience with WordPress.
  • Highly organized, reliable, and able to manage multiple pieces of content simultaneously.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience using SEO tools like Ahrefs (SEO research) and Clearscope (SEO optimization)
  • Experience using project management tools like Airtable.

About Us:

We’re a rapidly growing, independent media tech company headquartered in Vancouver, B.C. Canada. Since 2012, our portfolio of influential digital publications has been helping millions of people succeed at work.
Our brands cover thought leadership for executives in project management, people management, product management, tech, marketing and many others - with the goal of connecting people with knowledge, skills and tools they need to succeed professionally in the age of AI.
We got our start in 2011 as The Digital Project Manager blog, founded by our CEO Ben Aston. Since then, we’ve grown into an international team of 70+ creators, strategists, and innovators with a portfolio of more than 15 online publications. We enjoy an impact-driven environment that combines the agility of a startup with the creativity of an agency and the diversity of a global company.
We’ve previously ranked #30 in The Globe and Mail’s Fastest Growing Companylist as well as Deloitte'sFast 50 program, received a CMI award for Best Digital Publication for The Digital Project Manager—and we’re listed in both Canada's Top Small & Medium Employers, and Best Employers in BC!
All of this growth is driven by our commitment to our mission: In a world of evolving skills, practices, and technology, we’re creating a playbook for the future of work and empowering communities to create it with us.
Want to learn more?Watch this video to learn why the team love working at BWZ!

Diversity Equity and Inclusion:

Black and White Zebra is an equal opportunity employer and considers all candidates for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, age, disability, marital status, military or veteran’s status (including protected veterans, as may be required by federal law), sexual orientation or any other category protected by law. We celebrate all backgrounds and attributes that continue to help make our team impactful, iterative, adaptable, and fun!

jobs.title: Senior Financial Data Reconciliation Analyst
jobs.excerpt: Mercury is building a complete finance stack for startups.
jobs.description:
Mercury is building a complete finance stack for startups. We work hard to create the easiest and safest banking* experience possible to simplify entrepreneurs' and business owners' financial lives.

Underneath Mercury’s products is a network of banking partners, internal systems, payment rails, and funds flows that enable a powerful, streamlined customer experience. The Financial Data Reconciliation team enables the Mercury system by ensuring end-to-end tracking of transactions across partner banks and internal systems, protecting customer funds through timely, rigorous, and efficient reconciliation. The team owns the full reconciliation lifecycle — from building the data pipelines that transform and enrich transaction data, to matching and investigating exceptions, to reporting on reconciliation health across the business.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

We’re looking for a Senior Financial Data Reconciliation Analyst who will help operationalize, standardize, and scale reconciliation across Mercury’s banking partners and internal systems. As a senior member of the team, you’ll lead cross-functional initiatives from design through delivery and help other analysts grow. You’ll collaborate with internal and external partners to account for, reconcile, and investigate edge cases in the underlying money movements that power Mercury’s financial products.

You will:

  • Own the design and implementation of end-to-end reconciliations for new and existing products and funds flows, setting standards that other analysts can build against
  • Develop and maintain data transformations, enrichment logic, and matching rules that support accurate and scalable reconciliation across internal and external systems
  • Monitor and investigate reconciliation exceptions, leading root-cause analysis and coordinating with Product, Engineering, Finance, and banking partners to resolve complex breaks and implement durable fixes
  • Build monitoring, alerting, and reporting that surface reconciliation risks, trends, and improvement opportunities across the team’s portfolio
  • Define reconciliation requirements and technical specifications for new products and funds flows, partnering with Product, Engineering, Data, and Finance early in the design process
  • Partner with Accounting to support month-end close and audit readiness by preparing timely reconciliation analyses, summaries, and supporting documentation
  • Shape and execute the reconciliation control roadmap, leading cross-functional initiatives and representing the Reconciliation team’s perspective as product coverage and operational complexity grow
  • Mentor other analysts through hands-on coaching, helping them strengthen their technical and investigative skills

You have:

  • 6+ years of experience working with complex transactional and financial data in fintech or financial services, including areas such as reconciliation, settlement, payment operations, and accounting
  • Working knowledge of banking payment rails and card networks, such as ACH, wire transfers, RTP, FedNow, Visa, and Mastercard, with an understanding of transaction flows, clearing, settlement, returns, and exception handling
  • Advanced SQL skills and hands-on experience developing and maintaining data transformation pipelines (e.g., dbt or similar)
  • Strong analytical skills, with a background investigating and resolving complex financial data discrepancies
  • Familiarity with enterprise reconciliation or matching tools (e.g., Blackline) or similar platforms
  • Experience building monitoring or BI dashboards to communicate operational and financial metrics using tools such as Omni, Looker, or Tableau
  • A track record of leading cross-functional initiatives and driving alignment across technical and non-technical partners
  • Experience mentoring or developing other analysts, and a genuine interest in helping others grow
  • Experience supporting audits, regulatory reporting, or financial-control testing

Mercury values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or special needs. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

Total Rewards
The total rewards package at Mercury includes base salary, equity (stock options/RSUs), and benefits.

Our salary and equity ranges are highly competitive within the SaaS and fintech industry and are updated regularly using the most reliable compensation survey data for our industry. New hire offers are made based on a candidate’s experience, expertise, geographic location, and internal pay equity relative to peers.

Our target new hire base salary ranges for this role are the following:

US employees in New York City, Los Angeles, Seattle, or the San Francisco Bay Area:
$171,000—$213,700 USD
US employees outside of New York City, Los Angeles, Seattle, or the San Francisco Bay Area:
$153,900—$192,300 USD
Canadian employees (any location):
$161,600—$209,900 CAD

jobs.description:
Software Engineer, Reliability

Remote, US

About Nametag

Nametag is building the future of secure digital identity. Our mission is to make it easy for people and organizations to prove who they are online, safely and seamlessly. We're pioneering next-generation identity verification and account protection so that users can control their own identity, and companies can build trust without friction. By enabling trust at scale, we help enterprises reduce fraud, streamline onboarding, and deliver secure user experiences that customers love.

The Role

We're looking for a Software Engineer to own infrastructure, reliability, and platform engineering at Nametag. You'll design and scale the systems that keep our identity verification platform fast, secure, and always available, and build the tooling that makes our engineering team more productive and autonomous.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role. You'll work closely with engineering and product leadership to make critical decisions about how we build, deploy, and operate our systems, and then execute on them. If you've thrived in fast-moving environments and care deeply about uptime, correctness, and developer experience, we'd love to meet you.

What You'll Do

Infrastructure & Reliability

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable, cost-effective cloud infrastructure across AWS and Fly.io.
  • Own deployment strategy and service design across our monolith and microservices, including schema migrations and rollout safety.
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code (CloudFormation, Terraform or equivalent) for reproducible, auditable infrastructure.
  • Identify reliability risks, performance bottlenecks, and security gaps, and address them proactively.

Observability & Incident Response

  • Evolve our observability stack: logging, distributed tracing, metrics, and uptime monitoring.
  • Evolve on-call practices and incident response processes that keep us ahead of customer-impacting issues.
  • Champion a culture of reliability: postmortems, runbooks, and continuous improvement after incidents.

Developer Enablement

  • Manage and improve our CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) and establish deployment best practices.
  • Build internal platform tooling and abstractions that reduce toil and increase engineering velocity.
  • Partner with product engineers to make infrastructure easy to use correctly and hard to use incorrectly.

Data & ML Infrastructure

  • Design and operate data pipelines that support our ML-powered verification systems.
  • Evolve our MLOps infrastructure so models can be trained, evaluated, and deployed safely and repeatedly.

Collaboration & Leadership

  • Work closely with engineering and product leadership on technical roadmap decisions.
  • Review code, mentor peers, and help raise the bar on security, reliability, and operational discipline.
  • Communicate infrastructure tradeoffs clearly across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Ideal Qualifications

Work Authorization (Required): Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without current or future need for visa sponsorship. This is a firm requirement. The technical qualifications below are guidelines.

We know that no candidate will perfectly match every requirement, and that's okay. If you're passionate about what we're building and have most of the skills below, we'd love to hear from you.

  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience managing and securing cloud infrastructure. AWS required; Fly.io or similar a plus.
  • Infrastructure-as-Code: Production experience with Terraform or equivalent tools.
  • Databases: Deep experience with PostgreSQL, including schema design, migrations, and query performance tuning.
  • CI/CD: Strong experience designing and managing pipelines, GitHub Actions preferred.
  • Languages: Proficiency in modern, type-safe languages. Go strongly preferred.
  • Observability: Experience building and operating logging, tracing, and metrics systems in production.
  • MLOps & Data Pipelines: Prior experience shipping ML infrastructure into production, not just experimentation.
  • Startup experience: You've worked at an early-stage company and know what it means to move fast without compromising the things that matter.
  • Security: Security-minded by default. You design with the threat model in mind, not as an afterthought.

What We Value

  • Intellectual horsepower. Quickly grasping complex technical and business concepts.
  • Kindness and integrity. Earning trust is central to how we build relationships with customers and colleagues.
  • Bias for action. We move quickly to deliver impact and protect our customers against fast-moving threats.
  • Ownership mindset. You care about uptime and stability the way a founder cares about the product.

Compensation

The base salary range for this full-time position is $120,000 to $190,000, plus equity and benefits.

Nametag is a founding member of the Open Imperative, publicly committed to pay equity in the technology industry. We post positions with ranges to encourage people of different backgrounds and experiences to apply. Every offer is benchmarked against market data to ensure fairness and consistency.

Final compensation is determined by role, level, and additional factors such as skills, experience, and education. Your recruiter or hiring manager can share more details during the hiring process.

Culture & Perks

At Nametag, we believe trust starts with how we treat each other. We're a remote-first team that values autonomy, inclusivity, and collaboration, with regular in-person time to stay connected and innovate together.

  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere in the US. Our team spans Seattle, San Francisco, Ann Arbor, Denver, New York City, and beyond.
  • Off-sites: We bring the team together once per quarter for in-person collaboration, often off-site in new places.
  • Flexible schedules: Work in your own time zone; we align key meetings across a shared window.

We Offer

  • Competitive salary
  • Meaningful equity ownership
  • Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Quarterly team off-sites and travel support
  • New computer hardware and equipment
  • An inclusive environment where your voice has impact and your work drives change

jobs.description:
As the Principal II, Compensation, you are a strategic subject matter expert on Rocket's Total Rewards team, drawing on a wide range of skills and deep functional expertise to solve Rocket's most complex compensation challenges — partnering directly with business leaders and People Business Partners on senior hires, promotions, org design, and internal equity. Rather than executing an established process, this role provides thought leadership and expert guidance on how Rocket approaches pay, and supports the design and execution of Rocket's annual compensation programs, including merit, bonus, and equity cycles. Reporting to the VP, Compensation, this role is a trusted advisor on compensation approach across the business.

About the role

Compensation Consulting

  • Serve as a compensation advisor to senior business leaders and People Business Partners, providing data-driven recommendations on promotions, internal equity, offers, and pay exceptions.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition and hiring leaders to structure competitive offers for senior-level candidates, including base, bonus, and equity.
  • Lead job evaluation and leveling reviews, calibrating roles consistently against Rocket's job architecture and external market benchmarks.
  • Advise on the compensation implications of org design changes, reorganizations, and role redesigns, partnering with People Business Partners and business leaders throughout.
  • Lead market pricing analysis while translating market data into clear, actionable pay recommendations.
  • Advise on compensation approach for AI and other emerging technical roles, and evaluate how AI tools can be applied to improve compensation modeling, market pricing, and pay equity analysis.
  • Act as a subject matter expert on pay equity, compensation philosophy, and compensation approach, resolving complex, first-of-a-kind issues for which no established process or precedent exists.
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to compensation analysts, raising the rigor and consistency of consulting work across the team.
  • Represent Compensation on cross-functional initiatives such as M&A, or business restructuring, assessing pay implications and recommending an integration approach.

Annual Compensation Programs

  • Support the design and execution of Rocket's annual merit, bonus, and equity review cycles, including modeling, budget guidance, and manager enablement materials.
  • Partner with Compensation leadership to build and adjust annual salary structures, geographic differentials, and range movements based on market trends.
  • Lead year-end compensation planning and calibration sessions, helping ensure consistent, defensible pay decisions across the business.
  • Conduct pay equity analysis as part of each annual cycle, identifying disparities and partnering with People Business Partners and business leaders to resolve them before decisions are finalized.
  • Prepare program outcome summaries and recommendations for senior leadership, highlighting spend, market positioning, and areas of risk.
  • Identify and lead process or tooling improvements that help annual compensation programs scale as the business grows.

About you

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 10+ years of progressive compensation experience, including substantial experience in a compensation consulting or advisory capacity
  • Strong working knowledge of job architecture, market pricing methodology, and compensation survey data (e.g., Radford, Mercer)
  • Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills, with the ability to translate data into clear recommendations
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to advise senior leaders confidently and influence pay decisions
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Sound judgment and discretion when handling sensitive and confidential compensation data
  • Demonstrated expertise applying AI tools and techniques to compensation modeling, market pricing, and pay equity analysis
  • Demonstrated experience advising on compensation matters in M&A, or business integration transactions

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certified Compensation Professional (CCP) certification
  • Experience in fintech, financial services, or the mortgage industry
  • Experience with compensation and HRIS platforms (e.g., Workday, PayScale, Radford)
  • Experience partnering with senior leadership in a fast-paced, matrixed organization
  • Familiarity with SQL or other data querying tools to support compensation analytics
  • Experience navigating pay transparency and pay equity regulations across multiple states or jurisdictions
  • Global compensation experience, particularly supporting Canada and India

What you’ll get

Our team members fuel our strategy, innovation and growth, so we ensure the health and well-being of not just you, but your family, too! We go above and beyond to give you the support you need on an individual level and offer all sorts of ways to help you live your best life. We are proud to offer eligible team members perks and health benefits that will help you have peace of mind. Simply put: We’ve got your back. Check out our full list of Benefits and Perks.

About us

jobs.description:
About Us:

CALSTART is now Catalyst Mobility. We are a mission-driven industry organization focused on transportation decarbonization and clean air for all.

For over 30 years, it’s been Catalyst Mobility’s mission to develop, assess, and implement large-scale, zero-emission transportation solutions to mitigate climate change and support economic growth. Catalyst Mobility works with businesses, organizations, governments, and communities to create real-life impact toward clean air and equitable access to clean transportation for all. Catalyst Mobility provides scientific, technical and policy support for regulatory development and clean technology and infrastructure acceleration.

About The Role:

The OEMs & Equipment Project Manager supports our Dealer Training & Engagement Team by managing vehicle, equipment, manufacturer, and dealer related activities across the on road and off road Voucher Incentive Programs that we administer. Reporting to the Deputy Director of Dealer Training & Engagement, this role works closely with original equipment manufacturers, dealers, internal program teams, and government partners to coordinate vehicle and equipment additions, updates, removals, deactivations, eligibility changes, dealer affiliations, and other catalog related functions. The position helps ensure that program systems, public facing information, and internal records remain accurate, current, and aligned with program requirements.

The ideal candidate brings experience with commercial vehicles, zero emission technologies, or on and off road equipment, along with strong project management, data management, analytical, and communication skills. Daily responsibilities include tracking approval and eligibility documentation, maintaining records in Salesforce and website authoring platforms, analyzing vehicle and equipment data, preparing reports, supporting process improvements, and developing clear procedures for recurring workflows. This role will also help streamline and automate vehicle and equipment intake, year end vehicle deactivation, OEM notifications, reporting, and related administrative processes. The position offers an opportunity to work directly with emerging clean transportation technologies, build productive relationships with manufacturers and dealers, and improve the systems and processes that support transition to zero emission vehicles and equipment.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Manage vehicle, equipment, OEM, and dealer related workflows across CALSTART administered on road and off road Voucher Incentive Programs, including additions, removals, deactivations, eligibility updates, dealer affiliations, and other program changes.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for original equipment manufacturers and participating dealers, providing clear, accurate, and timely communication regarding program processes, documentation requirements, system updates, and next steps.
  • Review and track vehicle and equipment approval or eligibility documentation, coordinate required follow up, and ensure information is accurately reflected across Salesforce, public facing websites, internal tracking tools, and related program systems.
  • Lead projects to standardize, streamline, and document recurring OEM and equipment workflows, including approval letter intake, catalog updates, OEM notifications, year end vehicle deactivation, and dealer or manufacturer change processes.
  • Maintain and analyze vehicle, equipment, OEM, and dealer data to identify trends, monitor workflow status, support decision making, and prepare recurring or ad hoc reports for program leadership and internal partners.
  • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, process maps, templates, trackers, and training materials that improve accuracy, consistency, efficiency, and continuity across Voucher Incentive Programs.
  • Partner with the Dealer Training & Engagement Team to translate policy, equipment, and system changes into clear guidance, training resources, and communications for dealers and OEM representatives.
  • Collaborate closely with Voucher Processing, Policy, Technology, Data & Analytics, Marketing and Communications, program leadership, and government agency partners to resolve issues and ensure coordinated implementation of program changes.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual work and improve data quality through automation, system enhancements, and improved use of platforms such as Salesforce, website authoring software, Monday.com, and other program management tools.
  • Support the successful launch and ongoing administration of new Voucher Incentive Programs, vehicle categories, equipment types, technologies, and program requirements by coordinating readiness activities across internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects and time sensitive requests while maintaining organized records, clear priorities, dependable follow through, and consistent communication with stakeholders.
  • Contribute to organizational goals by improving the accuracy of public facing program information, strengthening OEM and dealer relationships, reducing processing delays, and supporting the adoption of zero emission vehicles and equipment.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in transportation, engineering, environmental studies, business administration, public policy, project management, data analytics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • At least five years of relevant experience in transportation, vehicle or equipment manufacturing, clean energy, incentive program administration, project management, or a related field, including experience independently managing projects and stakeholder relationships.
  • Working knowledge of on road vehicles, off road equipment, commercial fleets, original equipment manufacturers, dealerships, or zero emission transportation technologies.
  • Strong project management, data management, and analytical skills, including the ability to manage multiple workstreams, maintain accurate records, identify trends or discrepancies, track deliverables, and prepare clear reports.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce or a comparable customer relationship management system, along with experience using website authoring or content management software, project management platforms, spreadsheets, and other data tracking tools.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, organization, judgment, and problem solving skills, with the ability to interpret technical or program requirements, communicate clearly with internal and external stakeholders, work independently, and improve complex or manual processes.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree or professional certification in transportation, engineering, environmental studies, public policy, business administration, project management, data analytics, or a related field.
  • Experience administering government funded incentive, rebate, grant, or voucher programs, particularly programs supporting clean transportation, commercial vehicles, or off road equipment.
  • Familiarity with zero emission vehicle and equipment technologies, including battery electric, fuel cell electric, charging, hydrogen fueling, or related infrastructure considerations.
  • Experience working directly with original equipment manufacturers, dealers, fleets, regulatory agencies, or public sector partners in a transportation or equipment focused environment.
  • Advanced experience with Salesforce, website content management systems, Monday.com, Microsoft Excel, data visualization tools, workflow automation, or system integration projects.
  • Experience leading process improvement initiatives, developing technical or dealer facing training resources, and translating regulatory or technical requirements into clear operational procedures.
  • Ability and willingness to travel occasionally for meetings, trainings, industry events, vehicle or equipment demonstrations, and other program related activities. The role may require extended periods working at a computer and occasionally moving or handling materials used for meetings or events.

We understand that not everyone will match the above qualifications 100%. If your background isn't perfectly aligned but you feel you would be a great addition to the team, we'd love to hear from you.

We're a tight-knit team of world-class innovators, business minds, and change agents who believe passionately in our mission and put our team ahead of self. We are committed to the continued development and growth of our employees and invest in your success!

We care about your personal well being as much as your professional success and offer generous benefits to full time employees including: 100% company paid comprehensive health benefits for Medical, Dental, Vision, Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability and Life Insurance, Retirement plan with generous company contributions, FSA for Health and Dependent Care, 3 weeks of vacation time in the first year of employment, 11 paid company holidays, paid sick time, paid family leave, and more!

Our inclusive environment focuses on making decisions based on merit without regard to race, color, hair texture, gender, religion, age, nationality, social or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, LGBTQIA+ status, marital status, pregnancy, disability, genetics, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

All legitimate communication from our recruitment team will come from an official or email address via email, we will not text you about a role you have not applied to or shown interest in. We will not perform any interviews via text or Zoom chat.

Overview:

The Senior Director, Global Pharmacovigilance Quality Assurance Lead provides executive leadership and independent quality oversight of Alnylam’s global pharmacovigilance quality system. Reporting to the Vice President, R&D Quality, the role sets the strategic direction for the GVP QA function and provides independent assurance and escalation regarding the effectiveness of PV procedures, systems, and governance. As Alnylam continues to expand its global portfolio and organizational complexity, the Senior Director will lead the continued evolution of the PV Quality Assurance function, strengthening independent oversight, governance, risk-based assurance, quality-system performance monitoring, and inspection-readiness capabilities to support sustainable growth, operational excellence, and long-term regulatory compliance.

This role can be based in Cambridge, MA or Philadelphia, PA in a hybrid work arrangement, or remotely within the United States.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provides strategic leadership for Alnylam’s global Pharmacovigilance (PV) Quality Assurance function, including long-term strategy, operating model, organizational design, talent development, and quality culture grounded in integrity, transparency, and continuous improvement.
  • Leads and evolves the PV QA governance framework, overseeing compliance risk management, quality metrics, trend analysis, management reviews, and escalation of significant quality and regulatory risks.
  • Serves as the independent QA authority for the pharmacovigilance quality system, providing oversight of quality events, CAPAs, compliance assessments, and remediation activities to ensure regulatory compliance and effectiveness.
  • Owns the risk-based GVP audit strategy and PV assurance program. Partners with enterprise audit operations to conduct robust, risk-based audits of internal processes, vendors, and delegated partners while driving continuous improvement and risk mitigation across the PV ecosystem.
  • Provides independent assurance over computerized systems supporting pharmacovigilance, including validation, data integrity, and change control, and oversees GVP QA contributions to the Pharmacovigilance System Master File (PSMF).
  • Leads PV Quality Assurance inspection readiness in partnership with key enterprise stakeholders. Serves as a key representative during global health authority inspections, ensuring effective preparation, response management, and remediation oversight, including independent review of responses and remediation actions.
  • Partners broadly across Safety, Quality, Regulatory, Clinical, Commercial, and enterprise functions to enable compliant execution, strengthen governance, align quality processes, and maintain independent QA decision-making and escalation authority.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, healthcare, or related discipline; advanced degree such as MSc, PharmD, or PhD preferred.
  • 12-15+ years of experience in pharmacovigilance quality assurance, regulated pharmacovigilance, or a related quality/compliance function, including substantial leadership experience.
  • Thorough knowledge of international GVP regulations and guidance, including FDA requirements, EMA GVP Modules, Health Canada requirements, and applicable ICH guidance; working knowledge of GCP interfaces is expected.
  • Demonstrated success strengthening, scaling, or transforming an independent PV Quality Assurance function, operating model, governance framework, risk-based assurance program, audit strategy, quality metrics, and continuous-improvement capabilities in a matrixed environment.
  • Proven experience with risk-based GVP audits and health-authority inspections, including QPPV and PSMF-related scope.
  • Executive presence and demonstrated ability to align operational, embedded compliance, and independent Quality Assurance stakeholders while preserving clear decision rights and escalation authority.
  • Excellent problem-solving, decision-making, negotiation, communication, and conflict-resolution skills.

Über HappyOps

HappyOps entwickelt moderne Softwarelösungen für mittelständische Industrieunternehmen in Europa. Unsere Kunden kommen aus unterschiedlichen Branchen, darunter der Glas, Metall, Kunststoff und Maschinenbauindustrie. Wir sind ein profitables, eigenfinanziertes Softwareunternehmen mit einem vollständig remote arbeitenden Engineering Team. Unsere Kultur ist geprägt von Eigenverantwortung, direkter Kommunikation und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.

Über die Rolle

Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Senior Full Stack Softwareentwickler (f/m/d) mit verhandlungssicheren Deutsch und Französischkenntnissen (mindestens C1 in beiden Sprachen).

In dieser Rolle entwickelst du nicht nur Software, sondern arbeitest eng mit unseren Kunden zusammen, verstehst ihre Prozesse und setzt gemeinsam mit unserem Team moderne Lösungen für die produzierende Industrie um. Du begleitest Projekte von der ersten Anforderung bis zum produktiven Einsatz und verbindest technische Exzellenz mit pragmatischer Problemlösung.

Aufgaben

  • Entwicklung, Weiterentwicklung und Betrieb individueller Softwarelösungen für Kunden aus der produzierenden Industrie. Du verantwortest, was du entwickelst. You build it, you run it.
  • Umsetzung komplexer Businesslogik mit modernen Technologien und Softwarearchitekturen sowie kontinuierliche Optimierung bestehender Anwendungen.
  • Entwicklung intuitiver Web UIs, die komplexe Fertigungsprozesse einfach und effizient abbilden.
  • Entwicklung, Betrieb und Wartung skalierbarer Cloud und On Premise Anwendungen inklusive Monitoring, Logging und Fehleranalyse.
  • Entwicklung und Integration von Schnittstellen zu ERP Systemen, Manufacturing Software, Maschinensteuerungen, Sensoren und weiterer OT Infrastruktur.
  • Analyse technischer Anforderungen gemeinsam mit Projektmanagern und Kunden sowie Übersetzung dieser Anforderungen in robuste Softwarelösungen.
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden während des gesamten Projektverlaufs, von der Anforderungsaufnahme über die Implementierung bis zum produktiven Einsatz.
  • Kontinuierliche Verbesserung unserer Plattform, Entwicklungsprozesse und technischen Standards sowie aktive Mitgestaltung unserer Produkt und Technologie Roadmap.

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung als Full Stack Softwareentwickler*in in einem professionellen Entwicklungsumfeld.
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in TypeScript, React, Node.js, Express.js, modernen Webtechnologien sowie im Schreiben automatisierter Tests.
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch und Französischkenntnisse (mindestens C1) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
  • Erfahrung mit Cloud Architekturen, APIs und modernen Softwareentwicklungsprozessen. Kenntnisse im Bereich Industrial IoT, Maschinenkommunikation oder Industrieprotokolle sind ein Plus.
  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Lösungen und bringst Projekte zuverlässig zum Abschluss.
  • Du denkst pragmatisch, lernst schnell und hast Freude daran, komplexe technische Herausforderungen gemeinsam mit Kunden und dem Team zu lösen.
  • Du kannst technische Entscheidungen fundiert begründen, bringst eigene Ideen ein und bist gleichzeitig offen für neue Perspektiven und konstruktives Feedback.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, hast einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch und behältst auch in dynamischen Projekten den Überblick.
  • Du hast Freude an der engen Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden sowie mit unserem Gründungsteam und möchtest die technische Zukunft von HappyOps aktiv mitgestalten.

Benefits

  • Entwickle Software mit echtem Einfluss. Deine Lösungen werden täglich in Fabriken eingesetzt und helfen Unternehmen, produktiver, ressourcenschonender und wettbewerbsfähiger zu werden.
  • Arbeite an anspruchsvollen technischen Herausforderungen an der Schnittstelle zwischen Software, Maschinen, Daten und industriellen Prozessen.
  • Gestalte die technische und organisatorische Weiterentwicklung von HappyOps aktiv mit und bringe deine Ideen direkt ein.
  • Arbeite in einem kleinen, erfahrenen Engineering Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, hoher Eigenverantwortung und direktem Austausch mit den Gründern.

Die Gehaltsspanne für diese Position liegt, abhängig von Erfahrung und Qualifikation, zwischen 70.000 € und 100.000 € brutto pro Jahr.

Bei HappyOps zählen für uns Kompetenz, Motivation und Teamfit. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, sexueller Identität, ethnischer Herkunft, Religion oder einer Behinderung.

Klingt die Rolle spannend? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Auch wenn du nicht jede einzelne Anforderung erfüllst, möchten wir dich ausdrücklich ermutigen, dich zu bewerben. Sende uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf sowie deinen frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermin und deine Gehaltsvorstellung.

Kennst du jemanden, der perfekt zu uns passen könnte? Für jede erfolgreiche Empfehlung, die zu einer Einstellung führt, zahlen wir eine Empfehlungsprämie von 1.500 €.
