jobs.title: Senior Search Engineer - OpenSearch
jobs.excerpt: Search is how our users get their work done.  In OMS+, finding the right material, customer, order, or document in seconds can be the difference between a smooth order and a lost one.
jobs.description:
Search is how our users get their work done. In OMS+, finding the right material, customer, order, or document in seconds can be the difference between a smooth order and a lost one.Often across catalogs with millions of items and decades of enterprise history behind them.

We are looking for a Senior Search Engineer with OpenSearch expertise to join the team. The role is split between product and delivery: you will help design and build the search capabilities that ship with the platform, then work with customer data and customer teams to make them perform in their environments.

The focus throughout is search design and build: index and schema design, indexing pipelines fed from SAP source systems, relevance engineering, and the search APIs our TypeScript product stack consumes. What we need from this role is design judgement.Things like how indexes should be shaped, how queries should be written, and how to prove a relevance change

improved results.

Key Responsibilities

  • Help design index mappings, analyzers, and sharding strategies suited to large, high-cardinality enterprise catalogs.
  • Help build and maintain indexing pipelines that keep search
    in sync with SAP source systems, including full reindex and incremental update paths.
  • Design and tune queries: query DSL, scoring and boosting, synonyms, stemming, fuzzy and typo tolerance, faceting, and aggregations.
  • Contribute to relevance measurement.
  • Support delivery engagements: profile customer catalogs, tune index and query design, and work with implementation and solution engineering on customer-specific relevance requirements.
  • Diagnose and fix search performance problems: expensive queries, mapping and analyzer design, sharding choices, and data modeling.
  • Implement vector and hybrid search alongside lexical search where semantic matching measurably improves results.
  • Understand and specify platform needs: cluster sizing and configuration, index lifecycle policies, snapshot and upgrade requirements.
  • Help build clean, well-documented search APIs for the TypeScript product stack, and define the search health and quality signals the platform should surface.
  • Work with product management on roadmap search priorities, and with solution engineering on multi-tenant considerations.
  • Document search architecture and relevance decisions so the rest of engineering can reason about them.
  • Review search-related work from teammates and help raise the team's standards for query design and relevance rigor.

Required Qualifications

  • Deep, hands-on OpenSearch or Elasticsearch expertise, ideally with production search you designed and built yourself.
  • Command of the query DSL, mappings, analyzers, and aggregations, and a working mental model of the relevance levers each one gives you.
  • Proven relevance engineering: you have measurably improved search quality and can explain how you proved it.
  • A solid grasp of how index and cluster design choices drive performance: sharding, mapping design, query cost, Lucene fundamentals, etc.
  • Strong debugging ability for search problems: slow or expensive queries, mapping and analyzer mistakes, and results that are wrong in ways users notice before dashboards do.
  • Experience building high-throughput ingestion and indexing pipelines against systems of record.
  • Proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript and/or Python for building services, pipelines, and tooling.
  • Comfort working directly with customers and delivery teams.
  • Comfort working alongside a separate platform or IT team: specifying requirements, handing off cleanly, and collaborating on diagnosis rather than reaching for root access.
  • Clear communication and a habit of documenting decisions, particularly around relevance trade-offs.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Vector and semantic search experience: embeddings, the OpenSearch k-NN plugin, hybrid ranking, or learning-to-rank.
  • Familiarity with OpenSearch Dashboards, Data Prepper, Logstash, or Kafka-based ingestion.
  • Experience with SAP or ERP material master and catalog data, including part numbers, cross-references, and unit-of-measure complexity.
  • Query understanding: entity extraction, intent classification, spell correction, autocomplete.
  • Multi-tenant search architecture and tenant data isolation.
  • Experience in a customer-facing implementation, delivery, or professional services capacity.
  • Working knowledge of containers and Kubernetes.
  • Contributions to OpenSearch, Lucene, or other open source search projects.

jobs.excerpt: Sr Analyst Model Risk Management - KM07AEWe’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies.
jobs.description:
Sr Analyst Model Risk Management - KM07AE

We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future.

Sr Analyst Model Risk & AI, Data Science and Actuarial Model Validation


Overview of the Position

The Hartford’s Model Risk Management function seeks a Senior Analyst to join a talented and high-performing Model Risk Management team. The successful candidate will lead efforts for the review and validation of models across the enterprise. A variety of modeling methodologies are employed at The Hartford including advanced analytics and predictive models in Data Science and traditional Actuarial and business function methods. Models are used throughout The Hartford for a variety of purposes, including product pricing, asset pricing and valuation, risk management, reporting, economic capital, accounting, and operational functions.

The Model Risk Management team manages model risk across The Hartford by validating these models, implementing consistent policies and standards, and maintaining appropriate model oversight. As part of the team, this role will focus on validating models throughout The Hartford and reporting results to key internal stakeholders. Through the validation process, supplementary responsibilities include educating on modeling best practices and spreading model risk awareness across the enterprise. Additionally, this role will also support the maintenance of the enterprise model risk management framework, including policies, standards, procedures, and governance processes.

Responsibilities:

  • Perform model validations of critical models used across The Hartford’s functional areas and lines of business to ensure models are performing effectively and efficiently
    • Ensure model calculations are accurate and appropriate for intended use
    • Assess key data inputs and assumptions for accuracy and appropriateness
    • Review model outputs for accuracy and appropriate downstream usage
    • Deliver effective challenge to key modeling elements such as inputs, calculations, outputs, conceptual soundness, monitoring & controls, documentation, etc.
    • Identify findings and recommendations to mitigate model risk, compile clear, concise and well-structured model validation reports, perform in-depth assessments of model risk, perform governance accountabilities related to findings tracking, remediation testing, and validation
  • Perform governance accountabilities related to findings tracking, remediation testing, and validation
  • Strengthen partnerships with Data Science and Actuarial teams to keep model risk practices aligned with the proliferation and sophistication of modeling, promote proactive risk management, and share best practices.
  • Assist in improving The Hartford’s Model Risk Management function, by monitoring external environment, implementing best practices, recommending process improvements, and evolving standards/guidelines

Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree in Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Actuarial Science, Computational Science, Quantitative Economics, Engineering, or similar applied analytical field
  • 5+ years of P&C, Group, Life or related insurance product experience
  • ACAS/ASA or FCAS/FSA designation and/or CFA preferred
  • Familiarity with different programming languages/technology platforms including Excel/VBA,
  • R, Python, SAS/SQL, C++, Java
  • Practical experience with predictive modeling / data science techniques preferred
  • Project management skills an important plus
  • Familiarity with Supervisory Guidance on Model Risk Management (SR 11-7/ SR 26-2, PRA SS1/23) viewed as favorable
  • Ability to act independently with proactive self-directed accountability and demonstrated experience and consistency in meeting deadlines while adapting to shifting priorities
  • Strong analytical, critical and investigative thinking skills
  • Demonstrated commitment to lifelong learning with a strong desire for continuous development to keep pace with evolving modeling techniques and AI technologies.
  • Solution oriented creativity, innovative thinking, and challenging the status quo.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders across the enterprise.

Compensation

The listed annualized base pay range is primarily based on analysis of similar positions in the external market. Actual base pay could vary and may be above or below the listed range based on factors including but not limited to performance, proficiency and demonstration of competencies required for the role. The base pay is just one component of The Hartford’s total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include short-term or annual bonuses, long-term incentives, and on-the-spot recognition. The annualized base pay range for this role is:

$108,000 - $162,000
